rules.rule_name: Program Initialization on First Access
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary screen is accessed for the very first time with no prior session, the system initializes all processing flags, clears all messages, and prepares the screen with default values ready for Account ID entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1:Program Initialization
Init flags, clear messages,
set default screen values

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user accesses the Pending Authorization Summary screen for the first time with no existing session (communication area length is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program detects no prior session data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the error flag to OFF, (2) set the end-of-file indicator to NOT-EOF, (3) set the next-page indicator to NO, (4) set the send-erase flag to YES, (5) clear all screen messages to spaces, (6) initialize the entire communication area to default values, (7) set the destination program to the Authorization Summary program, (8) set the program re-enter flag to TRUE, (9) clear the screen output area to LOW-VALUES, and (10) position the cursor on the Account ID input field

rules.rule_name: First-Time Screen Display with Full Erase
rules.rule_description: On first access, the Authorization Summary screen is sent to the terminal with a full screen erase to present a clean blank screen for Account ID entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
32:Authorization Summary
Screen Display - Send with ERASE

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed initialization for a first-time access with no prior session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is ready to display the Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must send the Authorization Summary screen (map COPAU0A from mapset COPAU00) with a full ERASE command and cursor positioning, presenting a blank screen with the Account ID field ready for input

rules.rule_name: Screen Entry Point Detection - First Navigation from Another Program
rules.rule_description: When the program is invoked with an existing session, the system determines whether this is the first navigation from another program or a returning user interaction, to decide the appropriate processing path.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Screen Entry Point Detection
Check if re-entering or
first navigation from another program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is invoked with an existing communication area (EIBCALEN greater than zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the program re-enter flag in the communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the re-enter flag is NOT set (first navigation from another program), the system must set the re-enter flag to TRUE for subsequent interactions and proceed to populate the Account ID from the communication area and gather account details; if the re-enter flag IS already set (returning user), the system must proceed to receive and process user input from the screen

rules.rule_name: Account ID Display Setup from Communication Area
rules.rule_description: When the screen is first navigated to from another program, the Account ID stored in the shared communication area is validated and pre-populated on the screen display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:Account ID Display Setup
Populate Account ID from
shared communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary screen is being displayed for the first time after navigation from another program, and the communication area contains an Account ID value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID in the communication area is numeric, the system must copy it to both the working storage Account ID field and the screen Account ID display field; if the Account ID in the communication area is NOT numeric, the system must set the screen Account ID display field to SPACE and set the working storage Account ID to LOW-VALUES

rules.rule_name: Card Cross-Reference Lookup by Account ID
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the Customer ID and Card Number associated with a given Account ID by reading the Card Cross-Reference file using the Account ID as the lookup key.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9:Card Cross-Reference Lookup
Retrieve Customer ID & Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid numeric Account ID has been entered or pre-populated on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a lookup on the Card Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX) using the Account ID as the key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the account is found, the system must store the associated Customer ID and Card Number from the cross-reference record into the session communication area for use in subsequent lookups; if the account is NOT found in the cross-reference file, the system must display the message 'Account: [Account ID] not found in XREF file' and position the cursor on the Account ID field; if a system error occurs, the system must set the error flag to 'Y' and display an appropriate system error message

rules.rule_name: Account Master Data Retrieval
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the account's financial limits by reading the Account Master file using the Account ID obtained from the cross-reference lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10:Account Master Data Retrieval
Retrieve Credit Limit & Cash Limit

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Customer ID and Card Number have been successfully retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Account Master file (ACCTDAT) using the Account ID from the cross-reference record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the account record is found, the system must retain the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit values for display; if the account is NOT found in the Account Master file, the system must display the message 'Account: [Account ID] not found in ACCT file' and position the cursor on the Account ID field; if a system error occurs, the system must set the error flag to 'Y' and display an appropriate system error message

rules.rule_name: Customer Master Data Retrieval
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the customer's personal information by reading the Customer Master file using the Customer ID obtained from the cross-reference lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11:Customer Master Data Retrieval
Retrieve Name, Address, Phone

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Customer ID has been successfully retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT) using the Customer ID as the key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the customer record is found, the system must retain the customer's first name, middle name, last name, address lines, state code, ZIP code, and primary phone number for display; if the customer is NOT found in the Customer Master file, the system must display the message 'Customer: [Customer ID] not found in CUST file' and position the cursor on the Account ID field; if a system error occurs, the system must set the error flag to 'Y' and display an appropriate system error message

rules.rule_name: Customer Information Display Formatting
rules.rule_description: The system formats and displays the customer's personal information on the screen header, combining multiple fields into readable display formats.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12:Customer Information Display
Format name, address, city/state/zip, phone

acceptance_criteria.Given: Customer data has been successfully retrieved from the Customer Master file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header with customer information
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display: (1) the Customer ID, (2) the full customer name formatted as 'First-Name [space] Middle-Initial [space] Last-Name' with leading spaces trimmed from first and last name, (3) Address Line 1 and Address Line 2 combined with a comma separator (trimming trailing spaces using double-space delimiter), (4) Address Line 3, State Code, and first 5 digits of ZIP code combined with comma separators, and (5) the primary phone number

rules.rule_name: Account Financial Summary Display
rules.rule_description: The system formats and displays the account's financial limit information on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13:Account Financial Summary Display
Credit limit, cash limit, balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: Account data has been successfully retrieved from the Account Master file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header with account financial information
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the Credit Limit formatted as a 12-digit display amount and the Cash Credit Limit formatted as a 9-digit display amount on the screen header

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Statistics Display
rules.rule_description: When an authorization summary segment exists for the account, the system displays aggregate authorization statistics including counts and amounts for approved and declined authorizations.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
14:Authorization Summary Statistics Display
Approved/Declined counts and amounts

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) has been successfully retrieved for the account from the IMS database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header with authorization statistics
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display: (1) the count of approved authorizations formatted as a display count, (2) the count of declined authorizations formatted as a display count, (3) the current credit balance formatted as a 12-digit display amount, (4) the current cash balance formatted as a 9-digit display amount, (5) the total approved authorization amount formatted as a 9-digit display amount, and (6) the total declined authorization amount formatted as a 9-digit display amount

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Not Found - Display Zeros
rules.rule_description: When no authorization summary segment exists for the account in the IMS database, all authorization statistics fields on the screen are set to zero.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
34:Authorization Summary Not Found
Display zeros for all counts/amounts

acceptance_criteria.Given: A lookup of the Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) for the account in the IMS database returns no record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen header authorization statistics section
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set all six authorization statistics display fields to zero: approved authorization count, declined authorization count, credit balance, cash balance, approved authorization amount, and declined authorization amount

rules.rule_name: IMS PSB Scheduling for Database Access
rules.rule_description: Before accessing the IMS authorization database, the system schedules the required Program Specification Block (PSB) to establish database connectivity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
15:IMS PSB Scheduling
Schedule PSBPAUTB for IMS access

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system needs to access the IMS authorization database (either for summary or detail records)
acceptance_criteria.When: The PSB scheduling is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must schedule the PSB for IMS access; if the PSB is already scheduled (scheduled more than once), the system must first terminate the existing PSB schedule and then re-schedule it; if scheduling succeeds, the system must set the IMS-PSB-SCHD flag to TRUE; if scheduling fails, the system must set the error flag to 'Y' and display the message 'System error while scheduling PSB: [error code]'

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Segment Retrieval from IMS
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the Authorization Summary root segment from the IMS database for a specific account to obtain aggregate authorization statistics.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
16:Authorization Summary Segment Retrieval
Get aggregate counts and amounts

acceptance_criteria.Given: The IMS PSB has been successfully scheduled and an Account ID is available in the session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a Get Unique (GU) call on the IMS database for the Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) using the Account ID as the search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the segment is found, the system must set the FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG flag to TRUE and retain the summary data; if the segment is not found, the system must set the NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG flag to TRUE; if a database error occurs, the system must set the error flag to 'Y' and display the message 'System error while reading AUTH Summary: [error code]'

rules.rule_name: Authorization List Row Initialization
rules.rule_description: Before populating the authorization list with records, all five display rows are cleared to ensure no stale data from a previous page is shown.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
17:Authorization List Initialization
Clear all five authorization rows

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display a new page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization list initialization is performed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must clear all five authorization display rows (rows 1 through 5) by: (1) setting each row's selection field attribute to protected (DFHBMPRO) to prevent input, and (2) setting each row's Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields to SPACES

rules.rule_name: Forward Page Navigation - PF8 Key Processing
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 to advance to the next page of authorization records, the system repositions the database cursor and loads the next set of up to 5 authorization records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18:Forward Page Navigation PF8
Advance to next page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Summary screen and presses the PF8 key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the PF8 forward navigation request
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) schedule the IMS PSB, (2) retrieve the Authorization Summary segment, (3) if the last displayed authorization key is blank or LOW-VALUES, clear the saved key; otherwise save the last displayed key and reposition the IMS cursor to that key, (4) set the send-erase flag to NO (overlay, not full erase), (5) if the next-page flag is YES, initialize all five display rows and load the next page of records; if the next-page flag is NO, display the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' without changing the display

rules.rule_name: Backward Page Navigation - PF7 Key Processing
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 to go back to the previous page of authorization records, the system decrements the page counter and reloads the previous page using saved page keys.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19:Backward Page Navigation PF7
Navigate to previous page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Summary screen and presses the PF7 key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the PF7 backward navigation request
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the current page number is greater than 1, the system must: (1) decrement the page number by 1, (2) retrieve the saved first-record key for the new (decremented) page number, (3) schedule the IMS PSB, (4) retrieve the Authorization Summary segment, (5) set the send-erase flag to NO, (6) set the next-page flag to YES, (7) initialize all five display rows, (8) reposition the IMS cursor to the saved page key, and (9) load up to 5 authorization records starting from that key; if the current page number is 1 (already at first page), the system must display the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' and set the send-erase flag to NO without changing the display

rules.rule_name: Top-of-List Detection
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate backward beyond the first page, the system detects this boundary condition and informs the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
20:Top-of-List Detection
Already at first page message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF7 (backward navigation) while the current page number is 1
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether backward navigation is possible
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' and set the send-erase flag to NO, keeping the current page display unchanged

rules.rule_name: Bottom-of-List Detection
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate forward beyond the last page, the system detects this boundary condition and informs the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
21:Bottom-of-List Detection
Already at last page message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 (forward navigation) and the next-page flag is set to NO (no more records exist beyond the current page)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether forward navigation is possible
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and keep the current page display unchanged

rules.rule_name: Authorization Records Paging - Load Up to 5 Records
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves authorization detail records from the IMS database sequentially, loading up to 5 records per page display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
22:Authorization Records Paging
Retrieve up to 5 auth detail records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization list display rows have been initialized and the IMS cursor is positioned at the correct starting record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs sequential Get Next within Parent (GNP) calls on the IMS database for Authorization Detail segments (PAUTDTL1)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must loop retrieving records until either 5 records have been retrieved, end-of-data is reached, or an error occurs; for each record retrieved: populate the corresponding display row and save the authorization key as the last key on the page; on the second record retrieved, increment the page number by 1 and save that record's authorization key as the first key of the new page for backward navigation; if a database error occurs, the system must set the error flag to 'Y' and display the message 'System error while reading AUTH Details: [error code]'

rules.rule_name: Authorization Record Repositioning in IMS
rules.rule_description: The system repositions the IMS database cursor to a specific authorization record using a saved authorization key, enabling accurate page navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23:Authorization Record Repositioning
Reposition IMS cursor to saved page key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A saved authorization key exists for the target page position (either the first key of a previous page for PF7, or the last displayed key for PF8)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a Get Next within Parent (GNP) call on the IMS database for the Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1) with a WHERE clause specifying the saved authorization key (PAUT9CTS = saved key)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the record is found, the system must set the AUTHS-NOT-EOF flag to TRUE and proceed with sequential retrieval; if the record is not found or end-of-database is reached, the system must set the AUTHS-EOF flag to TRUE; if a database error occurs, the system must set the error flag to 'Y' and display the message 'System error while repos. AUTH Details: [error code]'

rules.rule_name: Next Page Availability Check
rules.rule_description: After loading 5 records for the current page, the system peeks at the next record to determine whether a subsequent page of authorization records is available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24:Next Page Availability Check
Peek at next record for next-page flag

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully loaded up to 5 authorization records for the current page and has not reached end-of-data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs one additional Get Next within Parent (GNP) call on the IMS database after filling the 5 display rows
acceptance_criteria.Then: If an additional record is found (AUTHS-NOT-EOF and no error), the system must set the next-page flag to YES (enabling PF8 forward navigation); if no additional record exists (AUTHS-EOF), the system must set the next-page flag to NO (disabling PF8 forward navigation)

rules.rule_name: Page Key Tracking for Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: The system maintains a history of the first authorization key for each page to enable accurate backward navigation using PF7.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
25:Page Key Tracking
Save first record key of each page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records for a new page and has just retrieved the second record (row index = 2)
acceptance_criteria.When: The second record is successfully populated into the display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) increment the page number counter by 1, and (2) save the authorization key of the second record as the first-record key for the current page number in the page key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by the current page number)

rules.rule_name: Authorization Record Population into Display Row
rules.rule_description: Each retrieved authorization detail record is formatted and populated into the corresponding display row on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
26:Authorization Record Population
Populate transaction ID, date, time,
type, status, match, amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database and the current row index (1 through 5) is known
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the display row corresponding to the current row index
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must populate the following fields for the matching row (1-5): (1) save the authorization key to the session key array at the corresponding index position, (2) Transaction ID, (3) formatted Date (MM/DD/YY), (4) formatted Time (HH:MM:SS), (5) Authorization Type, (6) Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), (7) Match Status, (8) formatted Approved Amount, and (9) set the selection field attribute to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) to allow user input; if the row index is outside 1-5, no action is taken

rules.rule_name: Authorization Date and Time Formatting
rules.rule_description: Raw date and time values stored in the authorization record are reformatted into user-friendly display formats.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27:Authorization Date and Time Formatting
Convert YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY
Convert HHMMSS to HH:MM:SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved containing the original authorization date in YYMMDD format and the original authorization time in HHMMSS format
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the date and time for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) convert the authorization date from YYMMDD format to MM/DD/YY display format by mapping positions 1-2 (YY) to the year field, positions 3-4 (MM) to the month field, and positions 5-6 (DD) to the day field, then assembling as MM/DD/YY; (2) convert the authorization time from HHMMSS format to HH:MM:SS display format by mapping positions 1-2 to hours (positions 1-2 of display), positions 3-4 to minutes (positions 4-5 of display), and positions 5-6 to seconds (positions 7-8 of display)

rules.rule_name: Approval Status Derivation from Response Code
rules.rule_description: The authorization approval status displayed on screen is derived from the authorization response code stored in the detail record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
28:Approval Status Derivation
Response code 00=Approved
Other=Declined

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved containing an authorization response code
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines the approval status for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization response code equals '00', the system must set the approval status display value to 'A' (Approved); if the authorization response code is any value other than '00', the system must set the approval status display value to 'D' (Declined)

rules.rule_name: Return to Main Menu via PF3
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3, the system transfers control back to the main menu program, preserving the session state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
29:Return to Main Menu
Transfer to COMEN01C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Summary screen and presses the PF3 key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the PF3 return navigation request
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the destination program to the main menu program (WS-PGM-MENU), (2) if the destination program is LOW-VALUES or SPACES, default to the sign-on program 'COSGN00C', (3) record the current transaction ID as the originating transaction, (4) record the current program (Authorization Summary) as the originating program, (5) set the program context to zero, and (6) transfer control to the destination program passing the full communication area

rules.rule_name: Invalid Key Handling
rules.rule_description: When the user presses any key other than the supported function keys (ENTER, PF3, PF7, PF8), the system displays an error message indicating the key is not valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
30:Invalid Key Handling
Display unsupported key message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Summary screen and presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the pressed key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the error flag to 'Y', (2) position the cursor on the Account ID field, and (3) display the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Screen Header Population
rules.rule_description: Before every screen send, the system populates the standard screen header fields with current system information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
31:Screen Header Population
Title, Transaction ID, Program Name,
Date, Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Authorization Summary screen to the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen header population routine is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must populate the following header fields: (1) Title line 1 from the application title constant, (2) Title line 2 from the application title constant, (3) Transaction Name from the current CICS transaction ID, (4) Program Name from the Authorization Summary program name, (5) Current Date formatted as MM/DD/YY using the current system date, and (6) Current Time formatted as HH:MM:SS using the current system time

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Screen Display
rules.rule_description: The system sends the populated Authorization Summary screen to the terminal, choosing between a full erase or overlay based on the current send-erase flag.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
32:Authorization Summary
Screen Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header has been populated and all data fields are ready for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen (map COPAU0A from mapset COPAU00)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the send-erase flag is YES, the system must send the screen with a full ERASE command and cursor positioning; if the send-erase flag is NO, the system must send the screen with cursor positioning only (overlay, no erase); in both cases the current error message from WS-MESSAGE must be displayed in the error message field

rules.rule_name: Session State Persistence
rules.rule_description: At the end of each program execution cycle, the system preserves all session state information in the communication area so it is available on the next user interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
35:Session State Persistence
Save page number, page keys,
last auth key, next-page flag

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed processing and is about to return control to CICS
acceptance_criteria.When: The CICS RETURN command is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must return to CICS specifying the current transaction ID and passing the full communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) which contains: the current page number, the page key history array for all visited pages, the last displayed authorization key, the next-page availability flag, the Account ID, the Customer ID, the Card Number, and all other session state variables

rules.rule_name: Enter Key - Account ID Blank Validation
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER, the Account ID field is validated to ensure it has been entered.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Enter Key Processing
Validate Account ID:
not blank, must be numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses the ENTER key on the Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system validates the Account ID input field
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID field contains only SPACES or LOW-VALUES, the system must: (1) set the working storage Account ID to LOW-VALUES, (2) set the error flag to 'Y', (3) display the message 'Please enter Acct Id...', and (4) position the cursor on the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Enter Key - Account ID Numeric Validation
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER with a non-blank Account ID, the system validates that the Account ID contains only numeric characters.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Enter Key Processing
Validate Account ID:
not blank, must be numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses the ENTER key and the Account ID field is not blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The system validates the numeric format of the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID is NOT numeric, the system must: (1) set the working storage Account ID to LOW-VALUES, (2) set the error flag to 'Y', (3) display the message 'Acct Id must be Numeric ...', and (4) position the cursor on the Account ID field; if the Account ID IS numeric, the system must save it to both the working storage Account ID field and the session communication area Account ID field and proceed with selection processing

rules.rule_name: Authorization Record Selection Capture
rules.rule_description: When a valid Account ID is entered, the system checks all five selection fields to capture which authorization record the user has chosen to act upon.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:Authorization Record Selection
Capture selected auth key
and selection flag

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid numeric Account ID has been entered and the system is processing the ENTER key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the five selection input fields (SEL0001 through SEL0005) in order from row 1 to row 5
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must evaluate each selection field in order (1 through 5); for the FIRST field that is not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES, the system must: (1) save the selection value entered to the session selection flag (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG), and (2) save the corresponding authorization key from the session key array (CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS at the matching index) to the session selected authorization field (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED); if NO selection field contains a value, the system must set both the selection flag and the selected authorization field to SPACES

rules.rule_name: Navigate to Authorization Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: When a user selects an authorization record with the value 'S', the system transfers control to the Authorization Detail program passing the selected authorization key.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Navigate to Authorization Detail
Transfer to COPAUS1C with
selected authorization key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid authorization record has been selected (selection flag and selected authorization key are both non-blank and non-LOW-VALUES) and the selection value is 'S' or 's'
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the valid selection
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the destination program to the Authorization Detail program (WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL), (2) record the current transaction ID as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), (3) record the Authorization Summary program as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), (4) set the program context to 0, (5) set the program entry flag to ENTER mode, and (6) immediately transfer control to the Authorization Detail program passing the full communication area via XCTL

rules.rule_name: Invalid Selection Value Handling
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a selection value other than 'S' for an authorization record, the system rejects the selection and displays an error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7:Invalid Selection Handling
Display error: Valid value is S

acceptance_criteria.Given: A selection has been made (selection flag and selected authorization key are both non-blank and non-LOW-VALUES) but the selection value is neither 'S' nor 's'
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the selection value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' and position the cursor on the Account ID field, then proceed to refresh the authorization list data

rules.rule_name: Gather Account Details Orchestration
rules.rule_description: The system orchestrates the complete sequence of data retrievals needed to populate the screen header and authorization list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8:Gather Account Details
Orchestrate data retrieval
for screen header

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID is available (either entered by the user or pre-populated from the communication area)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the account details gathering process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) position the cursor on the Account ID field, (2) reset the page number to 0, (3) if the Account ID is not LOW-VALUES, execute in sequence: Card Cross-Reference lookup, Account Master retrieval, Customer Master retrieval, and Authorization Summary retrieval; (4) if the Authorization Summary segment is found, initialize the authorization list rows and load the first page of authorization records; (5) if the Account ID IS LOW-VALUES, skip all data retrieval and display an empty list

key_functionalities.title: Program Initialization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Program Start\nNo Prior Session Detected]) 
    B[Initialize Communication Area\nClear all session variables\nand stored values]
    C[Set Current Program Identity\nto Authorization Summary Screen]
    D[Set Screen Re-Entry Flag\nMark program as ready\nfor user interaction]
    E[Clear All Screen Output Fields\nReset entire screen\ndisplay area to blank]
    F[Set Cursor Position\nPlace cursor on\nAccount ID input field]
    G[Display Authorization\nSummary Screen\nPresent blank screen\nto user for first time]
    H([Await User Input])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H

rules.rule_name: Initialize Session Data on First Program Entry
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary screen is accessed for the very first time with no prior session, all session variables and stored values in the communication area must be cleared and initialized to their default state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize Communication Area
Clear all session variables
and stored values

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary screen program is invoked and no prior communication area exists (no active session data is present from a previous interaction)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program detects that this is a brand new session with no prior context
acceptance_criteria.Then: The entire communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is initialized, clearing all previously stored session variables including account ID, customer ID, card number, page numbers, authorization keys, program context flags, and all other session-level data fields

rules.rule_name: Set Current Program Identity in Session
rules.rule_description: During first-time initialization, the session must record that the Authorization Summary screen is the active destination program so that navigation and return routing are correctly established.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Current Program Identity
to Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The communication area has just been initialized for a new session
acceptance_criteria.When: The program sets up its identity within the session context
acceptance_criteria.Then: The destination program identifier in the session (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) is set to the Authorization Summary program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY), establishing this screen as the current active program in the navigation chain

rules.rule_name: Mark Program Ready for User Interaction
rules.rule_description: After initialization, the program must set a re-entry flag to indicate that on the next invocation, the program should process user input rather than perform another initialization sequence.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Screen Re-Entry Flag
Mark program as ready
for user interaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: The session has been initialized and the program identity has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to display the screen for the first time
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) is set to TRUE, ensuring that when the user submits input and the program is re-invoked, it will process the user's input rather than re-initializing the session

rules.rule_name: Clear All Screen Display Fields Before First Presentation
rules.rule_description: Before presenting the Authorization Summary screen to the user for the first time, all screen output fields must be reset to ensure no residual or stale data is displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear All Screen Output Fields
Reset entire screen
display area to blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is preparing to display the Authorization Summary screen for the first time in a new session
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen output area is being prepared for initial display
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen output fields in the Authorization Summary screen output map (COPAU0AO) are set to LOW-VALUES, ensuring the screen is presented completely blank with no residual data from any prior display

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account ID Input Field
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary screen is first displayed, the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Account ID input field to guide the user to enter the required account information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Cursor Position
Place cursor on
Account ID input field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen output fields have been cleared and the screen is ready for first-time display
acceptance_criteria.When: The cursor position is being set for the initial screen presentation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor length attribute for the Account ID input field (ACCTIDL in COPAU0AI) is set to -1, which directs the system to place the cursor on the Account ID field when the screen is rendered, prompting the user to enter an Account ID

rules.rule_name: Display Blank Authorization Summary Screen on First Access
rules.rule_description: On first access, the Authorization Summary screen must be presented to the user as a fully cleared screen with the full screen erase option, displaying only the screen header information and awaiting Account ID input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Authorization
Summary Screen
Present blank screen
to user for first time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The session is newly initialized, all screen fields are cleared, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, and the send-erase flag is set to YES
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A from mapset COPAU00) to the user's terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is sent with the ERASE option (full screen clear) and CURSOR positioning active, displaying the screen header (title lines, transaction name, program name, current date, and current time) with all data fields blank, and the cursor placed on the Account ID input field, awaiting the user's first input

key_functionalities.title: Screen Entry Point Detection
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Screen Entry Point Detection])
    B{Does a session\nexist?\nEIBCALEN = 0}
    C[First Time Entry\nInitialize new session\nwith default values]
    D[Display blank\nAuthorization Summary Screen]
    E[Restore previous\nsession data from\ncommunication area]
    F{Is user navigating\nhere from\nanother program?}
    G[First Navigation Entry\nMark screen as active\nLoad account details\nand authorization data]
    H[Display populated\nAuthorization Summary Screen]
    I[Returning User Entry\nReceive updated\nscreen input from user]
    J{Which action\ndid the user take?}
    K[Process ENTER Key\nValidate Account ID\nand handle selections]
    L[Return to\nMain Menu PF3]
    M[Scroll Backward\nPF7]
    N[Scroll Forward\nPF8]
    O[Display Invalid\nKey Message]
    END([Route to\nappropriate processing])

    A --> B
    B -->|No session exists\nFirst time on screen| C
    C --> D
    D --> END
    B -->|Session exists\nReturning user| E
    E --> F
    F -->|Navigated from\nanother program| G
    G --> H
    H --> END
    F -->|Already active\non this screen| I
    I --> J
    J -->|ENTER| K
    J -->|PF3| L
    J -->|PF7| M
    J -->|PF8| N
    J -->|Any other key| O
    K --> END
    L --> END
    M --> END
    N --> END
    O --> END

rules.rule_name: Detect First-Time Screen Entry and Initialize Session
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the user is accessing the Authorization Summary screen for the very first time (no active session) and initializes a fresh session with default values.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does a session exist? EIBCALEN = 0

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user navigates to the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: No prior session exists (communication area length is zero, indicating first-time entry)
acceptance_criteria.Then: A new session is initialized with all default values cleared, the destination program is set to the Authorization Summary program, the screen is marked as active for re-entry, the screen output area is cleared to low values, and the cursor is positioned on the Account ID input field

rules.rule_name: Display Blank Authorization Summary Screen on First Entry
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry with no existing session, the system presents a blank Authorization Summary screen to the user, ready for Account ID input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First Time Entry - Initialize new session with default values / Display blank Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new session has been initialized because no prior session existed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen for first-time display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A) is sent to the user with the ERASE option (full screen clear), the screen header is populated with current date, current time, transaction name, and program name, and the cursor is placed on the Account ID field awaiting user input

rules.rule_name: Restore Existing Session Data on Return Entry
rules.rule_description: When a user returns to the Authorization Summary screen with an active session, the system restores all previously saved session context from the communication area before any further processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Restore previous session data from communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user accesses the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: An active session exists (communication area length is greater than zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: All session data is restored from the communication area into the working session, including the account ID, customer ID, card number, current page number, saved authorization page keys, selected authorization key, selection flag, and program navigation context

rules.rule_name: Detect Navigation from Another Program and Trigger Data Load
rules.rule_description: After restoring session data, the system determines whether the user has just navigated to this screen from a different program (e.g., the main menu), as opposed to already being active on this screen, and routes processing accordingly.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is user navigating here from another program?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active session has been restored from the communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The session context indicates the screen has not yet been marked as active for re-entry (program re-enter flag is not set)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies this as a first navigation entry from another program, marks the screen as active for subsequent interactions by setting the re-enter flag, clears the screen output area, and proceeds to load account details and authorization data before displaying the screen

rules.rule_name: Pre-Populate Account ID When Navigating from Another Program with Valid Account
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates to the Authorization Summary screen from another program and a valid numeric Account ID is already stored in the session, the system pre-populates the Account ID field on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First Navigation Entry - Mark screen as active / Load account details and authorization data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has navigated to the Authorization Summary screen from another program and the screen is being loaded for the first time in this session
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID stored in the session communication area is a valid numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The stored Account ID is copied to both the working Account ID field and the screen Account ID display field, and the system proceeds to load and display all account details and authorization data for that account

rules.rule_name: Clear Account ID When Navigating from Another Program with Invalid Account
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates to the Authorization Summary screen from another program but the stored Account ID is not a valid numeric value, the system clears the Account ID field rather than displaying an invalid value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First Navigation Entry - Mark screen as active / Load account details and authorization data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has navigated to the Authorization Summary screen from another program and the screen is being loaded for the first time in this session
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID stored in the session communication area is not numeric (contains spaces, letters, or special characters)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen Account ID display field is set to spaces and the working Account ID is set to low values, effectively clearing the field so the user must enter a valid Account ID manually

rules.rule_name: Display Populated Authorization Summary Screen After Navigation from Another Program
rules.rule_description: After loading account and authorization data when navigating from another program, the system displays the fully populated Authorization Summary screen with a full screen erase.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display populated Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: Account details and authorization data have been gathered following navigation from another program
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is ready to present the Authorization Summary screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A) is sent with the ERASE option (full screen refresh), displaying all loaded account information, financial summary, and authorization list, with the cursor positioned on the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Receive Screen Input for Returning Active User
rules.rule_description: When the user is already active on the Authorization Summary screen and submits input, the system receives and captures all updated screen field values before processing the user's action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Returning User Entry - Receive updated screen input from user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is already active on the Authorization Summary screen (re-enter flag is set) and has submitted input
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the returning user's interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen input data is received from the Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A map, COPAU00 mapset) into the input area, capturing the Account ID entered, any selection field values (rows 1 through 5), and the function key pressed, before routing to the appropriate action handler

rules.rule_name: Route to Account ID Validation and Selection Processing on ENTER Key
rules.rule_description: When the user presses the ENTER key on the Authorization Summary screen, the system routes processing to validate the Account ID and handle any authorization row selections made by the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Which action did the user take? / Process ENTER Key - Validate Account ID and handle selections

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is active on the Authorization Summary screen and has submitted screen input
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the ENTER key (DFHENTER)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the Enter Key processing routine to validate the Account ID and process any authorization row selections, then updates the Account ID display field (showing the entered value if valid, or spaces if low-values), and refreshes the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Route to Main Menu on PF3 Key Press
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Authorization Summary screen, the system navigates the user back to the main menu program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Which action did the user take? / Return to Main Menu PF3

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is active on the Authorization Summary screen and has submitted screen input
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key (DFHPF3)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The destination program is set to the main menu program, the current program is recorded as the originating program in the session, and control is transferred to the main menu program passing the full session communication area; if no destination program is recorded in the session, the system defaults to the Sign-On screen

rules.rule_name: Route to Backward Pagination on PF7 Key Press
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 on the Authorization Summary screen, the system routes processing to scroll the authorization list backward to the previous page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Which action did the user take? / Scroll Backward PF7

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is active on the Authorization Summary screen and has submitted screen input
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF7 key (DFHPF7)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the PF7 backward pagination processing routine to navigate to the previous page of authorization records, and then refreshes the Authorization Summary screen with the updated page content

rules.rule_name: Route to Forward Pagination on PF8 Key Press
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 on the Authorization Summary screen, the system routes processing to scroll the authorization list forward to the next page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Which action did the user take? / Scroll Forward PF8

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is active on the Authorization Summary screen and has submitted screen input
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF8 key (DFHPF8)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the PF8 forward pagination processing routine to navigate to the next page of authorization records, and then refreshes the Authorization Summary screen with the updated page content

rules.rule_name: Display Invalid Key Message for Unsupported Key Press
rules.rule_description: When the user presses any function key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8, the system rejects the action and displays an error message informing the user that the key pressed is not valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Which action did the user take? / Display Invalid Key Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is active on the Authorization Summary screen and has submitted screen input
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error flag is set to 'Y', the cursor is repositioned to the Account ID field, the error message 'Invalid key' is displayed on the screen, and the Authorization Summary screen is refreshed showing the error message without any data changes

key_functionalities.title: Account ID Display Setup
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Navigates from\nAnother Program]) 
    B{Is Account ID\nin shared area\nnumeric?}
    C[Populate Account ID field\non Authorization Summary Screen\nfrom shared communication area]
    D[Clear Account ID field\non Authorization Summary Screen]
    E[Retrieve and Display\nAccount Details on Screen]
    F([Display Authorization\nSummary Screen])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Valid Account ID| C
    C --> E
    B -->|No - Invalid or Blank\nAccount ID| D
    D --> E
    E --> F

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID Passed from Calling Program
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary screen is invoked by another program, the system must validate that the Account ID passed through the shared communication area is a numeric value before using it to populate the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID in shared area numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has been navigated to the Pending Authorization Summary screen from another program, and the shared communication area contains an Account ID value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the Account ID stored in the shared communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is a numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID is numeric, it is accepted as valid and used to populate the screen; if the Account ID is non-numeric or blank, it is rejected and the Account ID field is cleared

rules.rule_name: Populate Account ID Field from Shared Communication Area
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID passed from the calling program is valid (numeric), the system pre-populates the Account ID field on the Authorization Summary screen so the user does not need to re-enter it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Account ID field on Authorization Summary Screen from shared communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has been navigated to the Pending Authorization Summary screen from another program, and the Account ID in the shared communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the incoming navigation request
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID from the shared communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is copied into both the internal working Account ID field (WS-ACCT-ID) and the Account ID display field on the Authorization Summary screen (ACCTIDO), so the account is pre-populated for the user

rules.rule_name: Clear Account ID Field When Passed Value Is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID passed from the calling program is not numeric (invalid or blank), the system clears the Account ID field on the Authorization Summary screen and resets the internal Account ID, preventing any data lookup with an invalid identifier.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear Account ID field on Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has been navigated to the Pending Authorization Summary screen from another program, and the Account ID in the shared communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is non-numeric or blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the incoming navigation request
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID display field on the Authorization Summary screen (ACCTIDO) is set to spaces (blank), and the internal working Account ID field (WS-ACCT-ID) is cleared to low-values, ensuring no invalid account data is used for any subsequent lookup

rules.rule_name: Retrieve and Display Account Details on Navigation
rules.rule_description: After the Account ID field has been set or cleared based on the value passed from the calling program, the system automatically retrieves and displays all associated account, customer, and authorization details on the Authorization Summary screen without requiring any additional user action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve and Display Account Details on Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has been navigated to the Pending Authorization Summary screen from another program, and the Account ID field has been either populated with a valid numeric Account ID or cleared due to an invalid value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the Account ID field setup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system automatically invokes the account detail retrieval process (GATHER-DETAILS), which fetches and displays the customer information, account financial details, authorization summary counts and amounts, and the list of pending authorization records associated with the account

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Summary Screen with Full Screen Refresh on First Entry
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary screen is displayed for the first time after being invoked from another program, the screen must be fully erased and redrawn to ensure a clean presentation of all retrieved account and authorization data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has been navigated to the Pending Authorization Summary screen from another program, and account details have been retrieved and prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is sent with a full ERASE instruction (SEND-ERASE-YES is set to TRUE), clearing any previously displayed content and presenting a fresh, complete view of the Authorization Summary screen with all account, customer, and authorization data populated

rules.rule_name: Account ID Blank Validation on Enter Key
rules.rule_description: When the user presses the Enter key on the Pending Authorization Summary screen, the system must verify that the Account ID field has been populated before proceeding with any lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID Blank or Empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and presses the Enter key
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field is blank or contains no value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must reject the input, set an error indicator, display the message 'Please enter Acct Id...', and return the cursor focus to the Account ID field without performing any account lookup

rules.rule_name: Account ID Numeric Format Validation on Enter Key
rules.rule_description: After confirming the Account ID is not blank, the system must verify that the entered Account ID contains only numeric characters before proceeding with any authorization lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-blank value in the Account ID field and pressed the Enter key
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Account ID contains non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must reject the input, set an error indicator, display the message 'Acct Id must be Numeric ...', and return the cursor focus to the Account ID field without performing any account lookup

rules.rule_name: Accept and Save Valid Account ID to Session
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID passes all validations (non-blank and numeric), the system accepts the value and saves it to the current working session and the shared communication area for use in subsequent lookups and screen navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Accept Account ID and Save to Session

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-blank, numeric Account ID and pressed the Enter key
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID passes both the blank and numeric validation checks
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must save the entered Account ID to the current session working storage and to the shared session communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) so it is available for account detail retrieval and cross-screen navigation

rules.rule_name: Capture User Selection from Authorization List
rules.rule_description: After a valid Account ID is entered, the system checks whether the user has entered a selection value against any of the five displayed authorization records. The first non-blank selection (scanning rows 1 through 5 in order) is captured along with its corresponding authorization record key. If no selection is made, the selection fields are cleared.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Has user entered a selection flag against any of the 5 displayed records?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and the screen is displaying up to 5 pending authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The user has entered a value in one or more of the selection fields (rows 1 to 5) alongside the displayed authorization records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must capture the selection value entered by the user and the unique authorization record key associated with the first non-blank selection field found (scanning from row 1 to row 5 in order). If no selection field contains a value, both the selection flag and the selected authorization key must be cleared to spaces

rules.rule_name: Validate Authorization Record Selection Value
rules.rule_description: When the user has entered a selection value against an authorization record and the corresponding authorization key is available, the system must validate that the selection value is the letter 'S' (uppercase or lowercase) before allowing navigation to the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Value Valid? S or s

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a selection value against one of the displayed authorization records and the corresponding authorization record key has been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the captured selection value
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the selection value is 'S' or 's', the system proceeds to navigate to the Authorization Detail screen. If the selection value is any other character, the system must display the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' and return the cursor to the Account ID field, then proceed to refresh the account and authorization summary data

rules.rule_name: Navigate to Authorization Detail Screen on Valid Selection
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a valid selection value of 'S' or 's' against an authorization record, the system transfers control to the Authorization Detail screen, passing the selected authorization record key and full session context so the detail screen can display the complete authorization information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Navigate to Authorization Detail Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered 'S' or 's' as the selection value against one of the displayed authorization records and the corresponding authorization record key has been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The selection value is confirmed as valid ('S' or 's') and the authorization record key is not blank
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the destination program to the Authorization Detail program, record the current program and transaction as the originating source in the session communication area, set the program context to initial entry mode, and transfer full control to the Authorization Detail program passing the complete session communication area

rules.rule_name: Display Error for Invalid Authorization Selection Value
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a selection value other than 'S' or 's' against an authorization record, the system must reject the selection and inform the user of the only valid selection value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error: 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a selection value against one of the displayed authorization records and the corresponding authorization record key has been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The selection value entered is any character other than 'S' or 's'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' and return the cursor focus to the Account ID field, then proceed to retrieve and refresh the account details and authorization summary information

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Account and Authorization Summary After Enter Key Processing
rules.rule_description: After Enter key processing completes (either no selection was made, or an invalid selection was entered), the system must retrieve and display the full account details, customer information, and authorization summary for the entered Account ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Account, Customer and Authorization Summary Information

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and either made no selection or entered an invalid selection value
acceptance_criteria.When: Enter key processing reaches the account detail retrieval step
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must invoke the account details gathering process which retrieves the card cross-reference data, account financial data (credit limit, cash credit limit), customer information (name, address, phone), and the pending authorization summary (approved count, declined count, credit balance, cash balance, approved amount, declined amount) for the entered Account ID, and populate all corresponding fields on the screen

rules.rule_name: Capture Row 1 Authorization Selection
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a value in the selection field of the first displayed authorization row, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding authorization key for that row to enable detail navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Field Row 1 entered? → Capture Row 1 Selection Flag / Capture Auth Key for Row 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and the Authorization Summary List screen is displaying up to five pending authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters a non-blank, non-empty value in the selection field of Row 1 (the first displayed authorization record)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the value entered in Row 1's selection field as the Selection Flag, and captures the Authorization Key associated with Row 1 (from the stored list of displayed authorization keys) as the Selected Authorization Key for further processing

rules.rule_name: Capture Row 2 Authorization Selection
rules.rule_description: When Row 1 has no selection entered but the user enters a value in the selection field of the second displayed authorization row, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding authorization key for Row 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Field Row 2 entered? → Capture Row 2 Selection Flag / Capture Auth Key for Row 2

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, the Authorization Summary List screen is displaying up to five pending authorization records, and the selection field for Row 1 is blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters a non-blank, non-empty value in the selection field of Row 2 (the second displayed authorization record)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the value entered in Row 2's selection field as the Selection Flag, and captures the Authorization Key associated with Row 2 (from the stored list of displayed authorization keys) as the Selected Authorization Key for further processing

rules.rule_name: Capture Row 3 Authorization Selection
rules.rule_description: When Rows 1 and 2 have no selection entered but the user enters a value in the selection field of the third displayed authorization row, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding authorization key for Row 3.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Field Row 3 entered? → Capture Row 3 Selection Flag / Capture Auth Key for Row 3

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, the Authorization Summary List screen is displaying up to five pending authorization records, and the selection fields for Row 1 and Row 2 are both blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters a non-blank, non-empty value in the selection field of Row 3 (the third displayed authorization record)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the value entered in Row 3's selection field as the Selection Flag, and captures the Authorization Key associated with Row 3 (from the stored list of displayed authorization keys) as the Selected Authorization Key for further processing

rules.rule_name: Capture Row 4 Authorization Selection
rules.rule_description: When Rows 1, 2, and 3 have no selection entered but the user enters a value in the selection field of the fourth displayed authorization row, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding authorization key for Row 4.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Field Row 4 entered? → Capture Row 4 Selection Flag / Capture Auth Key for Row 4

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, the Authorization Summary List screen is displaying up to five pending authorization records, and the selection fields for Rows 1, 2, and 3 are all blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters a non-blank, non-empty value in the selection field of Row 4 (the fourth displayed authorization record)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the value entered in Row 4's selection field as the Selection Flag, and captures the Authorization Key associated with Row 4 (from the stored list of displayed authorization keys) as the Selected Authorization Key for further processing

rules.rule_name: Capture Row 5 Authorization Selection
rules.rule_description: When Rows 1 through 4 have no selection entered but the user enters a value in the selection field of the fifth displayed authorization row, the system captures the selection indicator and the corresponding authorization key for Row 5.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Field Row 5 entered? → Capture Row 5 Selection Flag / Capture Auth Key for Row 5

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, the Authorization Summary List screen is displaying up to five pending authorization records, and the selection fields for Rows 1, 2, 3, and 4 are all blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters a non-blank, non-empty value in the selection field of Row 5 (the fifth displayed authorization record)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the value entered in Row 5's selection field as the Selection Flag, and captures the Authorization Key associated with Row 5 (from the stored list of displayed authorization keys) as the Selected Authorization Key for further processing

rules.rule_name: No Authorization Row Selected — Clear Selection State
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER without entering any value in any of the five selection fields, the system clears the selection flag and the selected authorization key, indicating no authorization record has been chosen for detail navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Selection Made / Clear Selection Flag / Clear Selected Auth Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and the Authorization Summary List screen is displaying up to five pending authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and all five selection fields (Row 1 through Row 5) are blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears the Selection Flag to spaces and clears the Selected Authorization Key to spaces, indicating that no authorization record has been selected, and proceeds to refresh the account and authorization data without navigating to the detail screen

rules.rule_name: Validate Presence of Both Selection Flag and Authorization Key
rules.rule_description: After the selection capture step, the system determines whether a meaningful selection was made by verifying that both the Selection Flag and the Selected Authorization Key are non-blank and non-empty. Only when both are present does the system proceed to validate the selection value and navigate to the detail screen; otherwise it refreshes the authorization list without navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is a valid Selection Flag AND Auth Key captured? → Proceed to Validate Selection Value / Proceed to Gather Account Details No Navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed evaluating all five selection fields and has either captured a Selection Flag and Authorization Key from one of the rows, or cleared both to spaces because no row was selected
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the captured Selection Flag is non-blank and non-empty AND the captured Selected Authorization Key is non-blank and non-empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: If BOTH the Selection Flag and the Selected Authorization Key are present (non-blank, non-empty), the system proceeds to validate the selection value entered by the user (to confirm it is 'S' or 's') before navigating to the Authorization Detail screen; If EITHER the Selection Flag OR the Selected Authorization Key is blank or empty, the system bypasses detail navigation entirely and proceeds to gather and refresh the account and authorization summary data on the current screen

rules.rule_name: First Non-Blank Selection Row Takes Priority
rules.rule_description: The system evaluates selection fields in strict sequential order from Row 1 to Row 5. The first row with a non-blank, non-empty selection value is the only one processed. Subsequent rows are not evaluated once a selection is found, ensuring only one authorization record can be selected per ENTER action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Field Row 1 entered? → ... → Is Selection Field Row 5 entered?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and the Authorization Summary List screen is displaying up to five pending authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters values in more than one selection field across the five displayed rows and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system processes only the selection from the lowest-numbered row that contains a non-blank, non-empty value (Row 1 takes priority over Row 2, Row 2 over Row 3, and so on through Row 5); selection fields in higher-numbered rows are ignored once a selection is found in a lower-numbered row

key_functionalities.title: Navigate to Authorization Detail
