rules.rule_name: Capture First Non-Blank Row Selection from Authorization List
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a selection value against any of the 5 displayed authorization rows, the system identifies the first row (top to bottom, rows 1 through 5) that has a non-blank selection entry and captures both the selection flag value and the corresponding authorization key for that row. Only one selection is processed per ENTER action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is any selection flag entered for rows 1-5?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary List screen is displayed with up to 5 authorization records, and the user has entered a value in one or more selection fields (SEL0001 through SEL0005) alongside the displayed authorization rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER to submit the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system evaluates selection fields in order from row 1 to row 5 and captures the first non-blank, non-low-values selection entry: the entered selection value is stored as the Selection Flag (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG) and the Authorization Key corresponding to that row (CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS for that row index) is stored as the Selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED). If no selection field contains a value, both the Selection Flag and Selected Authorization Key are set to spaces and no further selection processing occurs.

rules.rule_name: Validate Authorization Row Selection Value
rules.rule_description: After a selection entry is captured from the authorization list, the system validates that the entered selection value is the letter 'S' (uppercase or lowercase). Any other value is considered invalid and results in an error message being displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is selection flag value = S?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A non-blank selection flag value and a non-blank authorization key have been captured from the user's input on the Authorization Summary List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the captured Selection Flag value
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Selection Flag is 'S' (uppercase) or 's' (lowercase), the selection is considered valid and the system proceeds to navigate to the Authorization Detail screen. If the Selection Flag is any other value, the selection is considered invalid, the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' is displayed on the screen, the cursor is repositioned to the Account ID field, and the system refreshes the Authorization Summary List without navigating away.

rules.rule_name: Set Authorization Detail as Destination Program
rules.rule_description: When a valid 'S' selection is confirmed, the system designates the Authorization Detail program as the next program to receive control, enabling the user to view the full details of the selected authorization record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Destination Program to Authorization Detail COPAUS1C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid selection value of 'S' or 's' against one of the displayed authorization rows on the Authorization Summary List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the valid selection
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program identifier (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) to the Authorization Detail program (WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL) so that control will be transferred to the Authorization Detail screen.

rules.rule_name: Record Authorization Summary as the Originating Program in Session
rules.rule_description: Before transferring to the Authorization Detail screen, the system records the current Authorization Summary program and transaction as the originating source in the shared session communication area. This enables the Authorization Detail screen to know where to return control when the user navigates back.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Current Program as Authorization Summary COPAUS0C in Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has confirmed a valid 'S' selection and has set the Authorization Detail program as the destination
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the session communication area for the program transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the current transaction identifier (WS-CICS-TRANID) as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the Authorization Summary program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY) as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), sets the program context to zero (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 0), and sets the program entry status flag to indicate a fresh entry (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER = TRUE) in the shared communication area.

rules.rule_name: Pass Selected Authorization Key to Authorization Detail Program
rules.rule_description: The authorization key of the row selected by the user is carried forward in the shared session communication area so that the Authorization Detail program can retrieve and display the correct authorization record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Pass Selected Authorization Key in Shared Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has selected a specific authorization row using 'S', and the corresponding authorization key for that row has been captured into the Selected Authorization Key field (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED) in the shared communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The system transfers control to the Authorization Detail program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The shared communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) containing the Selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED), the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM), the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), and the program context is passed in full to the Authorization Detail program, ensuring the correct authorization record is available for display.

rules.rule_name: Transfer Control to Authorization Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: After all session data is prepared, the system immediately transfers control to the Authorization Detail program so the user can view the complete details of the selected pending authorization record. This is a direct program-to-program transfer with no return to the Authorization Summary List unless the user explicitly navigates back.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer Control to Authorization Detail Program COPAUS1C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The destination program has been set to the Authorization Detail program, the originating program details have been recorded in the communication area, and the selected authorization key has been stored in the shared communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the program transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is immediately and unconditionally transferred to the Authorization Detail program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) with the full shared communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) passed along, and the Authorization Detail screen is displayed to the user. The Authorization Summary List program is suspended and does not continue processing.

rules.rule_name: Display Invalid Selection Error Message
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a selection value other than 'S' against an authorization row, the system rejects the selection and informs the user of the only valid selection value, keeping the user on the Authorization Summary List screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 7: Display Error Message Invalid selection - Valid value is S

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-blank value in one of the selection fields (SEL0001 through SEL0005) on the Authorization Summary List screen, and the entered value is neither 'S' nor 's'
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the system evaluates the selection flag value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' on the screen, repositions the cursor to the Account ID field, does not navigate to the Authorization Detail screen, and proceeds to refresh the Authorization Summary List with the current account's data so the user can correct their selection.

rules.rule_name: Account ID Blank Validation on ENTER
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER, the system must validate that the Account ID field has been populated before proceeding with any authorization lookup or selection processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID valid and numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and presses the ENTER key
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field is blank or contains no value (spaces or low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an error condition, displays the error message 'Please enter Acct Id...' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Authorization Summary screen without performing any account lookup or selection processing

rules.rule_name: Account ID Numeric Validation on ENTER
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER with a non-blank Account ID, the system must validate that the Account ID contains only numeric characters before proceeding with any account lookup or selection processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID valid and numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen, has entered a non-blank value in the Account ID field, and presses the ENTER key
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Account ID value contains non-numeric characters (letters, special characters, or mixed content)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an error condition, clears the internal Account ID working value, displays the error message 'Acct Id must be Numeric ...' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Authorization Summary screen without performing any account lookup or selection processing

rules.rule_name: Authorization Row Selection Detection
rules.rule_description: After a valid Account ID is confirmed, the system evaluates the five authorization row selection fields in order (row 1 through row 5) to determine whether the user has entered a selection value against any displayed authorization record. Only the first non-blank selection field encountered is processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is a selection flag entered for any of the 5 authorization rows?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and the Authorization Summary screen is displaying up to 5 authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the system evaluates selection fields for rows 1 through 5 sequentially
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies the first row (in order from row 1 to row 5) whose selection field is not blank and not low-values, captures the entered selection flag value and the corresponding authorization key for that row into the session; if no selection field among all 5 rows contains a value, both the selection flag and the selected authorization key are set to spaces and no selection processing occurs

rules.rule_name: Capture Selection Flag and Authorization Key for Selected Row
rules.rule_description: When a selection value is detected in one of the five authorization rows, the system captures both the user-entered selection flag value and the unique authorization key associated with that specific row, storing them in the session for subsequent validation and navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture the selection flag value and associated authorization key for the selected row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and has entered a value in one of the five authorization row selection fields (rows 1 to 5)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system identifies the first non-blank selection field among the five rows
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the entered selection flag value from that row into the session selection flag, and stores the authorization key associated with that row (from the internally maintained list of up to 5 authorization keys) into the session selected authorization key field; both values must be non-blank and non-low-values to proceed to selection validation

rules.rule_name: Valid Selection Navigates to Authorization Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user enters 'S' (uppercase or lowercase) as the selection value for an authorization record, the system transfers control to the Authorization Detail program, passing the selected authorization key and full session context, so the user can view the complete details of that authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 6: Navigate to Authorization Detail

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, has entered a selection value in one of the five authorization rows, and both the selection flag and the associated authorization key are non-blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The captured selection flag value is 'S' (uppercase) or 's' (lowercase)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Authorization Detail program, records the current transaction ID as the originating transaction, records the Authorization Summary program as the originating program, sets the program context to zero, sets the program entry flag to indicate a fresh entry, and immediately transfers control to the Authorization Detail program passing the full session communication area including the selected authorization key

rules.rule_name: Invalid Selection Value Error Handling
rules.rule_description: When the user enters any selection value other than 'S' or 's' for an authorization record, the system rejects the selection and displays a specific error message indicating the only valid selection value, keeping the user on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7: Invalid Selection Handling
Display error message:
Invalid selection.
Valid value is S

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, has entered a selection value in one of the five authorization rows, and both the selection flag and the associated authorization key are non-blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The captured selection flag value is any character other than 'S' (uppercase) or 's' (lowercase)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Authorization Summary screen without navigating to any other program; the account details and authorization list are refreshed via the gather details process

rules.rule_name: No Selection Made - Refresh Authorization Summary
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER with a valid Account ID but without entering any selection value against any of the five displayed authorization rows, the system refreshes the account details and authorization list for the entered Account ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No selection made
Proceed to refresh
account details

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Authorization Summary screen and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: None of the five authorization row selection fields (rows 1 through 5) contain a non-blank value, resulting in both the selection flag and selected authorization key being set to spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to gather and refresh all account details including customer information, account financials, authorization summary counts and balances, and reloads the first page of authorization records for the entered Account ID, then redisplays the Authorization Summary screen with the refreshed data

rules.rule_name: Look Up Card Cross-Reference by Account ID
rules.rule_description: When gathering account details, the system must look up the Card Cross-Reference data store using the entered Account ID to retrieve the associated Customer ID and Card Number before proceeding with further account data retrieval.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Look up Card Cross-Reference using entered Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered by the user on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the account detail gathering process and queries the Card Cross-Reference data store using the entered Account ID as the lookup key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Card Cross-Reference record associated with the Account ID, making the Customer ID and Card Number available for subsequent lookups

rules.rule_name: Account Not Found in Card Cross-Reference
rules.rule_description: When the entered Account ID does not exist in the Card Cross-Reference data store, the system must stop the account detail retrieval process and display an informative error message to the user identifying the account that was not found.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Account Not Found
Display error message to user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered an Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the system has queried the Card Cross-Reference data store
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Card Cross-Reference data store
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays an error message indicating the specific Account ID was not found in the cross-reference, sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account data retrieval — no authorization list is displayed

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Customer ID and Card Number from Cross-Reference
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Card Cross-Reference, the system retrieves and stores the associated Customer ID and Card Number from the cross-reference record to be used in subsequent customer and account data lookups.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Retrieve Customer ID
and Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account ID has been found in the Card Cross-Reference data store
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Cross-Reference record is successfully retrieved
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts and stores the Customer ID and Card Number from the cross-reference record, making them available for the Account Master and Customer Master lookups

rules.rule_name: Read Account Master Record by Account ID
rules.rule_description: After successfully retrieving the Customer ID and Card Number from the Card Cross-Reference, the system must read the Account Master record using the Account ID to retrieve financial account details such as Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Read Account Master Record
using Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Customer ID and Card Number have been successfully retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference for the entered Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system queries the Account Master data store using the Account ID as the lookup key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Account Master record containing the account's financial details including Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit

rules.rule_name: Account Not Found in Account Master
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID does not exist in the Account Master data store, the system must stop the account detail retrieval process and display an informative error message to the user identifying the account that was not found.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Account Not Found
in Account Master
Display error message to user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has queried the Account Master data store using the Account ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Account Master data store
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays an error message indicating the specific Account ID was not found in the Account Master, sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account data retrieval — no authorization list is displayed

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit from Account Master
rules.rule_description: When the Account Master record is successfully found, the system retrieves the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit values from the account record to be displayed in the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Retrieve Credit Limit
and Cash Credit Limit

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Master record has been successfully retrieved for the entered Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the Account Master record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit values from the Account Master record and prepares them for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen header

rules.rule_name: Read Customer Master Record by Customer ID
rules.rule_description: After successfully retrieving account financial details, the system must read the Customer Master record using the Customer ID obtained from the Card Cross-Reference to retrieve customer personal information including name, address, and phone number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Read Customer Master Record
using Customer ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Master record has been successfully retrieved and the Customer ID was previously obtained from the Card Cross-Reference
acceptance_criteria.When: The system queries the Customer Master data store using the Customer ID as the lookup key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Customer Master record containing the customer's personal details including name, address lines, state, ZIP code, and phone number

rules.rule_name: Customer Not Found in Customer Master
rules.rule_description: When the Customer ID does not exist in the Customer Master data store, the system must stop the account detail retrieval process and display an informative error message to the user identifying the customer that was not found.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Customer Not Found
Display error message to user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has queried the Customer Master data store using the Customer ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference
acceptance_criteria.When: The Customer ID is not found in the Customer Master data store
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays an error message indicating the specific Customer ID was not found in the Customer Master, sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account data retrieval — no authorization list is displayed

rules.rule_name: Format Customer Full Name for Display
rules.rule_description: When customer data has been successfully retrieved, the system must format the customer's full name by combining the first name, middle initial (first character of middle name only), and last name into a single display string for the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Customer Full Name
First + Middle Initial + Last

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Customer Master record has been successfully retrieved containing the customer's first name, middle name, and last name
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the customer name for display on the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs the full name by concatenating: First Name (trimmed of trailing spaces) + single space + first character of Middle Name + single space + Last Name (trimmed of trailing spaces), and displays the result in the customer name field on the screen

rules.rule_name: Format Customer Address Line 1 for Display
rules.rule_description: The system must format the customer's primary address by combining Address Line 1 and Address Line 2 into a single display string, separated by a comma, for the first address display field on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Address Line 1
Street Address

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Customer Master record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 1 and Address Line 2
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the first address line for display on the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs the first address display field by concatenating Address Line 1 (delimited by double spaces) + comma + Address Line 2 (delimited by double spaces), and displays the result in the first address field on the screen

rules.rule_name: Format Customer Address Line 2 for Display
rules.rule_description: The system must format the customer's secondary address information by combining Address Line 3 (city), State Code, and the first 5 digits of the ZIP code into a single display string, separated by commas, for the second address display field on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Address Line 2
City, State, Zip Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Customer Master record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 3, State Code, and ZIP code
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the second address line for display on the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs the second address display field by concatenating Address Line 3 (delimited by double spaces) + comma + State Code + comma + first 5 characters of ZIP code, and displays the result in the second address field on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Customer Phone Number, Credit Limit, and Cash Credit Limit
rules.rule_description: After formatting the customer address information, the system displays the customer's primary phone number, the account's Credit Limit, and the account's Cash Credit Limit in the screen header fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Phone Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Customer Master and Account Master records have been successfully retrieved and address formatting is complete
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the remaining header fields on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the customer's primary phone number in the phone field, the account Credit Limit formatted as a 12-digit amount in the credit limit field, and the account Cash Credit Limit formatted as a 9-digit amount in the cash limit field

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account
rules.rule_description: After populating customer and account header information, the system must retrieve the Pending Authorization Summary segment from the authorization database for the account to obtain aggregate counts, amounts, and balances for display on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Retrieve Authorization Summary
Approved & Declined Counts,
Amounts, and Balances

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer and account header information has been populated on the screen and the Account ID is available in the session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system queries the Pending Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID as the lookup key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the authorization summary record containing: Approved Authorization Count, Declined Authorization Count, Total Approved Authorization Amount, Total Declined Authorization Amount, Credit Balance, and Cash Balance — and sets the summary-found indicator accordingly

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Summary Counts, Amounts, and Balances When Found
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system displays all six summary financial figures — approved and declined counts, approved and declined amounts, credit balance, and cash balance — in the corresponding screen header fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Approved Count & Amount
Declined Count & Amount
Credit Balance & Cash Balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the following values from the Authorization Summary record: Approved Authorization Count in the approved count field, Declined Authorization Count in the declined count field, Credit Balance formatted as a 12-digit amount in the credit balance field, Cash Balance formatted as a 9-digit amount in the cash balance field, Total Approved Authorization Amount formatted as a 9-digit amount in the approved amount field, and Total Declined Authorization Amount formatted as a 9-digit amount in the declined amount field

rules.rule_name: Display Zero Values for Authorization Summary When Not Found
rules.rule_description: When no Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system must display zero values for all six authorization summary fields — approved count, declined count, approved amount, declined amount, credit balance, and cash balance — rather than leaving them blank or undefined.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Zero Values for
All Counts, Amounts
and Balances

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has queried the Pending Authorization Summary data store for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: No Authorization Summary record is found for the account
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets all six authorization summary display fields to zero: Approved Authorization Count = 0, Declined Authorization Count = 0, Credit Balance = 0, Cash Balance = 0, Total Approved Authorization Amount = 0, and Total Declined Authorization Amount = 0

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Summary Record by Account ID
rules.rule_description: When account details are being gathered, the system uses the Account ID to query the Authorization Summary database (PAUTSUM0 root segment) to retrieve the pending authorization summary for that account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Account ID to query Authorization Summary database PAUTSUM0 Root Segment

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID is available in the current session and account details are being gathered for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The system queries the Authorization Summary database using the Account ID as the search key against the PAUTSUM0 root segment
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Authorization Summary record for that Account ID, and the result is flagged as either Found or Not Found for subsequent processing

rules.rule_name: Determine Authorization Summary Record Existence
rules.rule_description: After querying the Authorization Summary database, the system determines whether a summary record exists for the given Account ID and routes processing accordingly — either to display actual values or to display zeros.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Authorization Summary Record Found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary database has been queried using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the database query
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Authorization Summary record is found for the Account ID, the system proceeds to retrieve and display the six actual summary values (Approved Count, Declined Count, Credit Balance, Cash Balance, Approved Amount, Declined Amount); if no record is found for the Account ID, the system sets all six summary values to zero and displays them on screen

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Approved Authorization Count from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total count of approved authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Approved Authorization Count

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Approved Authorization Count field (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count value is formatted and populated into the Approved Count display field (APPRCNTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Declined Authorization Count from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total count of declined authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Declined Authorization Count

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Declined Authorization Count field (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count value is formatted and populated into the Declined Count display field (DECLCNTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current Credit Balance from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the current credit balance from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current Credit Balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Credit Balance field (PA-CREDIT-BALANCE) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Credit Balance value is formatted as a 12-digit amount and populated into the Credit Balance display field (CREDBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current Cash Balance from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the current cash balance from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current Cash Balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Cash Balance field (PA-CASH-BALANCE) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Cash Balance value is formatted as a 9-digit amount and populated into the Cash Balance display field (CASHBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Total Approved Authorization Amount from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total monetary amount of all approved authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Total Approved Authorization Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Approved Authorization Amount field (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Total Approved Authorization Amount value is formatted as a 9-digit amount and populated into the Approved Amount display field (APPRAMTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Total Declined Authorization Amount from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total monetary amount of all declined authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Total Declined Authorization Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the Declined Authorization Amount field (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Total Declined Authorization Amount value is formatted as a 9-digit amount and populated into the Declined Amount display field (DECLAMTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Display All Six Authorization Summary Values When Record Found
rules.rule_description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, all six retrieved summary values are displayed together on the Authorization Summary screen, providing a complete financial and authorization activity overview for the account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display all six values on Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID and all six values — Approved Authorization Count, Declined Authorization Count, Current Credit Balance, Current Cash Balance, Total Approved Authorization Amount, and Total Declined Authorization Amount — have been retrieved from the summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen with the retrieved values
acceptance_criteria.Then: All six values are displayed on the Authorization Summary screen: Approved Count in APPRCNTO, Declined Count in DECLCNTO, Credit Balance in CREDBALO, Cash Balance in CASHBALO, Approved Amount in APPRAMTO, and Declined Amount in DECLAMTO

rules.rule_name: Set All Authorization Summary Values to Zero When No Record Found
rules.rule_description: When no Authorization Summary record exists for the given Account ID in the database, the system sets all six authorization summary display values to zero, ensuring the screen shows meaningful default values rather than blank or undefined data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set all six values to Zero: Approved Count = 0, Declined Count = 0, Credit Balance = 0, Cash Balance = 0, Approved Amount = 0, Declined Amount = 0

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary database has been queried using the Account ID and no Authorization Summary record was found for that Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines that no summary record exists for the account
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets all six summary display fields to zero: Approved Authorization Count (APPRCNTO) = 0, Declined Authorization Count (DECLCNTO) = 0, Current Credit Balance (CREDBALO) = 0, Current Cash Balance (CASHBALO) = 0, Total Approved Authorization Amount (APPRAMTO) = 0, and Total Declined Authorization Amount (DECLAMTO) = 0

rules.rule_name: Display Zero Values for Authorization Summary When No Record Found
rules.rule_description: When no Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the screen displays zero values for all six authorization summary fields, ensuring the user sees a complete and consistent screen layout with no blank or undefined fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display zeros for all Authorization Summary fields on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: No Authorization Summary record was found for the Account ID and all six summary fields have been set to zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen with the zero values
acceptance_criteria.Then: All six Authorization Summary fields on the screen display zero: Approved Count = 0, Declined Count = 0, Credit Balance = 0, Cash Balance = 0, Approved Amount = 0, and Declined Amount = 0, providing a complete screen display even in the absence of authorization activity for the account

rules.rule_name: Card Cross-Reference Lookup Using Account ID
rules.rule_description: When gathering account details, the system uses the entered Account ID as the search key to look up the Card Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX - VSAM Alternate Index) to find the associated customer and card information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use entered Account ID as search key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid numeric Account ID has been entered by the user and the system is about to retrieve account-related details
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates a lookup against the Card Cross-Reference file using the Account ID as the search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX) is searched using the Account ID to locate the corresponding cross-reference record containing the Customer ID and Card Number

rules.rule_name: Retrieve and Save Customer ID and Card Number from Cross-Reference
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system retrieves the associated Customer ID and Card Number and saves them in the session for use in subsequent lookups (Account Master and Customer data).
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Customer ID associated with Account / Retrieve Card Number associated with Account / Save Customer ID and Card Number for subsequent lookups

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a lookup against the Card Cross-Reference file using the Account ID as the search key
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is found in the Card Cross-Reference file and a matching cross-reference record is returned
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Customer ID (XREF-CUST-ID) from the cross-reference record and saves it to the session communication area (CDEMO-CUST-ID), and retrieves the Card Number (XREF-CARD-NUM) and saves it to the session communication area (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) for use in subsequent Account Master and Customer data lookups

rules.rule_name: Account Not Found in Card Cross-Reference File

rules.rule_description: The system constructs the customer's full display name by combining the first name, a single middle initial (first character of middle name), and the last name, each separated by a single space. rules.rule_name: Format Customer Address Line 1 for Display
rules.rule_description: The system constructs the first address display line by combining the customer's street address line 1 and address line 2, separated by a comma. Each address component is delimited by two consecutive spaces, meaning trailing double-spaces are used as the end-of-value marker.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Combine Street Address Line 1 with Address Line 2

acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs Address Display Line 2 as: Address Line 3 (truncated at double-space) + comma + full State Code + comma + first 5 characters of ZIP Code, and assigns the result to the second address display field on the screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has submitted a request to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and has received the access status
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the returned access status to determine if the Authorization Database was already scheduled and active from a prior session
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the database access was already active (scheduled more than once), the system proceeds to release the existing access and re-request it; if this is the first request, the system proceeds directly to evaluate whether access was granted

rules.rule_name: Release Existing Authorization Database Access Before Re-Scheduling
rules.rule_description: If the Authorization Database access is found to be already active from a prior session, the system must release (terminate) that existing access session before attempting to re-establish a fresh access session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Release existing database access

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) access is already active from a previous session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system releases (terminates) the existing active Authorization Database access session
acceptance_criteria.Then: The existing Authorization Database access session is fully released, and the system is ready to re-request fresh access to the Authorization Database

rules.rule_name: Re-Request Authorization Database Access After Release
rules.rule_description: After releasing the previously active Authorization Database session, the system must re-submit a fresh request to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) to ensure a clean and valid access session is established.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Re-request access to Authorization Database PSBPAUTB

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully released the previously active Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) access session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system re-submits a new request to schedule access to the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and captures the resulting access status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system has a new access status available for evaluation to determine whether the re-requested Authorization Database access was granted or failed

rules.rule_name: Mark Authorization Database as Active and Ready
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Database access request is granted successfully, the system marks the database session as active and ready so that subsequent authorization data retrieval operations can proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Authorization Database as Active and Ready

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has submitted a request (initial or re-request) to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and has received the access status
acceptance_criteria.When: The access status indicates that the Authorization Database access was granted successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the Authorization Database session as active and ready, enabling all subsequent authorization data retrieval operations (summary and detail lookups) to proceed for the current transaction

rules.rule_name: Handle Authorization Database Access Failure
rules.rule_description: If the Authorization Database access request fails for any reason, the system must set an error condition and display a system error message to the user, preventing any further authorization data retrieval from proceeding.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Flag Display system error message to user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has submitted a request (initial or re-request) to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and has received the access status
acceptance_criteria.When: The access status indicates that the Authorization Database access request failed (status is not successful)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', composes an error message reading 'System error while scheduling PSB: Code: [access status code]', positions the cursor on the Account ID field, and immediately displays the error message to the user on the Authorization Summary screen; no authorization data retrieval is attempted

rules.rule_name: Release Authorization Database Access Before Sending Screen to User
rules.rule_description: Before sending any screen response back to the user, if the Authorization Database access session is currently active, the system must commit and release the database access to ensure data consistency and proper resource management.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Release existing database access

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Authorization Summary screen back to the user and the Authorization Database access session is currently marked as active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to display the Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A) to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the Authorization Database session as inactive, commits the current unit of work (syncpoint), and then proceeds to send the Authorization Summary screen to the user; if the database session was not active, the screen is sent directly without any database release

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Pending Authorization Summary by Account ID
rules.rule_description: When account details are being gathered, the system uses the Account ID stored in the session to query the IMS Pending Authorization Summary database segment (PAUTSUM0) to retrieve aggregate authorization data for that account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Account ID as search key for IMS lookup / Search IMS database for Pending Authorization Summary matching the Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID is available in the current session (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and the system is gathering account details for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The system queries the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) using the Account ID as the search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Pending Authorization Summary record that matches the given Account ID, making aggregate authorization data available for further processing and display

rules.rule_name: Mark Authorization Summary as Found
rules.rule_description: When the IMS database successfully returns a Pending Authorization Summary record for the queried Account ID, the system marks the summary as found so downstream display logic can use the retrieved data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Summary as Found - Record is available for display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has queried the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Summary segment using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database returns a matching Pending Authorization Summary record for the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an internal indicator (FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG) to TRUE, signaling that authorization summary data is available for display on the screen

rules.rule_name: Mark Authorization Summary as Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the IMS database does not find a Pending Authorization Summary record for the queried Account ID, the system marks the summary as not found, indicating that no pending authorizations exist for this account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Summary as Not Found - No pending authorizations exist for this account

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has queried the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Summary segment using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database returns no matching Pending Authorization Summary record for the Account ID (segment not found or end of database)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an internal indicator (NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG) to TRUE, signaling that no pending authorization summary data exists for this account

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Summary Counts and Amounts When Summary Exists
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system extracts and displays six aggregate financial fields from the summary record on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Extract and display: Approved Authorization Count, Declined Authorization Count, Current Credit Balance, Current Cash Balance, Total Approved Amount, Total Declined Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database for the given Account ID (FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen with data from the retrieved summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the following six fields on the screen: (1) Approved Authorization Count (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT → APPRCNTO), (2) Declined Authorization Count (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT → DECLCNTO), (3) Current Credit Balance (PA-CREDIT-BALANCE → CREDBALO), (4) Current Cash Balance (PA-CASH-BALANCE → CASHBALO), (5) Total Approved Authorization Amount (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT → APPRAMTO), (6) Total Declined Authorization Amount (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT → DECLAMTO)

rules.rule_name: Display Zero Values for Authorization Summary When No Summary Exists
rules.rule_description: When no Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account in the IMS database, the system displays zero values for all six authorization summary fields on the screen, clearly indicating no pending authorization activity for the account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display zero values for: Approved Count, Declined Count, Credit Balance, Cash Balance, Approved Amount, Declined Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: No Pending Authorization Summary record was found in the IMS database for the given Account ID (NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays zero (0) for all six summary fields: (1) Approved Authorization Count (APPRCNTO = 0), (2) Declined Authorization Count (DECLCNTO = 0), (3) Current Credit Balance (CREDBALO = 0), (4) Current Cash Balance (CASHBALO = 0), (5) Total Approved Authorization Amount (APPRAMTO = 0), (6) Total Declined Authorization Amount (DECLAMTO = 0)

rules.rule_name: Clear All Authorization List Rows Before Fresh Data Population
rules.rule_description: Before displaying a new page of pending authorization records, all five rows of the authorization list on the screen must be completely cleared. Each row's Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields are reset to blank, and the selection field for each row is set to non-enterable (protected), ensuring no stale data from a previous page remains visible to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display a new page of pending authorization records for an account, and the authorization list screen currently contains data from a previous display or page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the authorization list initialization process for all five rows sequentially (Row 1 through Row 5)
acceptance_criteria.Then: For each of the five rows on the authorization list screen, the following fields must be set to blank: Transaction ID, Authorization Date, Authorization Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Approved Amount. Additionally, the selection input field for each row must be set to protected (non-enterable) so the user cannot interact with an empty row. All five rows must be cleared regardless of how many records were previously displayed, ensuring no residual data from a prior page remains on screen before fresh authorization data is populated.

rules.rule_name: Check Last Displayed Authorization Key Availability for Forward Navigation
rules.rule_description: Determines whether a last displayed authorization key exists to enable forward page navigation. If no key is available, the system skips repositioning and proceeds directly to clear and reload the list from the beginning.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Last displayed authorization key available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and presses PF8 to navigate forward
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is blank or low-values
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the last displayed authorization key is blank or low-values, the system clears the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and proceeds directly to clear and reload the authorization list rows without repositioning; if the last key exists, the system saves it to WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE and proceeds to retrieve the authorization summary and reposition to that key

rules.rule_name: Save Last Displayed Authorization Key for Repositioning
rules.rule_description: When a valid last displayed authorization key exists, the system saves it as the repositioning anchor before fetching the next page of authorization records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save last displayed authorization key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is not blank or low-values
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to navigate to the next page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) into the working save area (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the repositioning anchor for fetching the next set of authorization records

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Summary Before Forward Page Load
rules.rule_description: Before loading the next page of authorization records, the system retrieves the authorization summary segment for the account to ensure the IMS database session is active and the account context is current.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and a valid last displayed authorization key has been saved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition and load the next page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes GET-AUTH-SUMMARY to retrieve the pending authorization summary segment from the IMS database for the current account (CDEMO-ACCT-ID), scheduling the IMS PSB if not already active

rules.rule_name: Reposition to Last Displayed Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: The system repositions the IMS database cursor to the last displayed authorization record so that the next sequential read will retrieve the first record of the new page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Reposition to Last Displayed Authorization Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization summary has been retrieved and WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE contains the last displayed authorization key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the repositioning operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system moves WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE into PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY and issues an IMS GNP call on the PAUTDTL1 segment using the authorization key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) to position the database cursor at that specific authorization record; if the record is found, the not-end-of-file indicator is set; if not found or end of database, the end-of-file indicator is set

rules.rule_name: Determine Next Page Record Availability After Repositioning
rules.rule_description: After repositioning to the last displayed authorization key, the system checks whether the NEXT-PAGE flag indicates that additional records exist beyond the current page before proceeding to load the new page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Next page records available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has repositioned to the last displayed authorization record after PF8 is pressed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the NEXT-PAGE-YES/NEXT-PAGE-NO flag
acceptance_criteria.Then: If NEXT-PAGE-YES is set, the system proceeds to clear the authorization list rows and load the next page of records; if NEXT-PAGE-NO is set, the system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and does not change the displayed authorization list

rules.rule_name: Display Already at Bottom of Page Message
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate forward but no additional authorization records exist beyond the current page, the system informs the user they have reached the last page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 21: Display Message Already at bottom of page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and the NEXT-PAGE-NO flag is set, indicating no further authorization records exist beyond the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the next page availability
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' in the message area (WS-MESSAGE) and refreshes the screen without altering the currently displayed authorization records

rules.rule_name: Clear All Five Authorization List Rows Before Loading New Page
rules.rule_description: Before loading a new page of authorization records, the system clears all five display rows to ensure no stale data from the previous page remains visible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear all five authorization list rows

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to load a new page of authorization records (either next page records are available or no last key existed)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initializes the authorization display area
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system iterates through all five rows (index 1 to 5) and for each row sets the selection field to protected (DFHBMPRO) and clears the Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields to spaces

rules.rule_name: Load Up to Five Authorization Records for New Page
rules.rule_description: The system sequentially retrieves up to five pending authorization detail records from the IMS database to populate the current page of the authorization list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Load up to 5 Authorization Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization list rows have been cleared and the database cursor is positioned at the correct starting record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system loads records for the new page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system loops with a row index starting at 1, issuing an IMS GNP call on the PAUTDTL1 segment to retrieve the next pending authorization detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) sequentially; the loop continues until the row index exceeds 5, end-of-data is reached, or an error occurs

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Record Retrieval Success for Each Authorization Row
rules.rule_description: After each IMS read attempt, the system determines whether a valid authorization record was retrieved to decide whether to populate the row or stop loading.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record retrieved successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has issued an IMS GNP read for the next authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the IMS return status
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the status is OK (AUTHS-NOT-EOF is set), the system proceeds to populate the current row with the retrieved record data; if the status indicates segment not found or end of database (AUTHS-EOF is set), the system exits the loading loop and proceeds to check for additional records beyond the page

rules.rule_name: Populate Authorization Row with Transaction Details
rules.rule_description: Each successfully retrieved authorization record is formatted and displayed in the corresponding row on the screen, including all key transaction details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Row with Transaction ID, Date, Time, Type, Approval Status, Match Status, Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the corresponding display row (1 through 5) based on the current row index
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the row with: Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID), Authorization Date formatted as MM/DD/YY (derived from PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE where positions 1-2 are month, 3-4 are day, 5-6 are year), Authorization Time formatted as HH:MM:SS (derived from PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME where positions 1-2 are hours, 3-4 are minutes, 5-6 are seconds), Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE), Approval Status ('A' if PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals '00', otherwise 'D'), Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS), and Approved Amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT); the selection field for the row is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) to allow user input

rules.rule_name: Determine Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
rules.rule_description: The system derives the human-readable approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Row with Transaction ID, Date, Time, Type, Approval Status, Match Status, Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization detail record has been retrieved with a PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines the approval status to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: If PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals '00', the system sets the approval status indicator (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) to 'A' (Approved); for any other response code value, the system sets the approval status indicator to 'D' (Declined)

rules.rule_name: Identify First Record of New Page and Increment Page Number
rules.rule_description: When the second record of a page is loaded (row index = 2), the system recognizes this as the true first record of the new page and increments the page counter, saving the record's key as the page start key for backward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First record of new page?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating authorization rows and has successfully retrieved and populated a record
acceptance_criteria.When: The row index (WS-IDX) equals 2 after incrementing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system increments the page number counter (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM by 1) and saves the current authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) as the page start key for this page number in the page key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG at index CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) to enable accurate backward navigation

rules.rule_name: Save Page Start Key into Page Key History for Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: The system maintains a history of the first authorization key for each page visited, enabling the PF7 backward navigation to accurately reposition to the beginning of any previously viewed page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 25: Save Page Start Key into Page Key History for Backward Navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The row index equals 2 (indicating the first record of the new page has been identified) and the page number has been incremented
acceptance_criteria.When: The system records the page navigation history
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the current authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) into the page key history array at the position corresponding to the new page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)), so that PF7 backward navigation can retrieve the correct starting key for any previously viewed page

rules.rule_name: Save Last Displayed Authorization Key on Page
rules.rule_description: After each authorization record is successfully populated into a display row, the system saves that record's key as the last displayed key, which will be used as the repositioning anchor for the next forward page navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save as Last Displayed Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and its data has been populated into a display row
acceptance_criteria.When: The system updates the last displayed key tracker
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system saves the current authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) into CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST, overwriting any previously saved last key; this key represents the last authorization record currently visible on the screen

rules.rule_name: Check Whether More Rows Need to Be Filled
rules.rule_description: After populating each authorization row, the system checks whether the page has been fully filled (5 rows) or if more records should be loaded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: More rows to fill? Row count less than 5

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been populated into the current row and the row index has been incremented
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the page is complete
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the row index (WS-IDX) is 5 or less, the system continues the loop and attempts to retrieve the next authorization record; if the row index exceeds 5, the system exits the loading loop and proceeds to peek at the next record to determine if a further page is available

rules.rule_name: Peek at Next Record to Determine Further Page Availability
rules.rule_description: After filling up to five rows, the system attempts to read one additional authorization record to determine whether a next page of records exists, without displaying that record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Peek at Next Record to Check Availability

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has finished loading up to five authorization records (either five rows are filled or end-of-data was reached during loading)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks for additional records beyond the current page
acceptance_criteria.Then: If AUTHS-NOT-EOF and no error condition exists, the system issues one additional IMS GNP read on the PAUTDTL1 segment; if this peek read returns a record successfully (AUTHS-NOT-EOF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-YES to indicate a further page is available; if the peek read returns end-of-data or segment not found (AUTHS-EOF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-NO to indicate the current page is the last page

rules.rule_name: Set Next Page Available Indicator
rules.rule_description: Based on the peek read result, the system sets the appropriate next-page availability indicator to control PF8 navigation on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Another record exists beyond current page?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a peek read after filling the current page rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the peek read
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the peek read successfully retrieved a record (AUTHS-NOT-EOF and ERR-FLG-OFF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-YES to true, indicating PF8 forward navigation is available; if the peek read returned no record (AUTHS-EOF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-NO to true, indicating no further pages exist and PF8 forward navigation is not available

rules.rule_name: Display Updated Authorization Summary Screen
rules.rule_description: After completing the forward page navigation processing, the system sends the updated authorization summary screen to the user with the newly loaded page of records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 32: Display Updated Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The forward page navigation processing is complete, with either new records loaded or a bottom-of-page message set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with current date, time, transaction name, and program name; moves the current message (WS-MESSAGE) to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO); and sends the COPAU0A map from the COPAU00 mapset with cursor positioning; since SEND-ERASE-NO was set during PF8 processing, the screen is sent as an overlay (without ERASE) rather than a full screen refresh

sub_functionalities.title: Load up to 5 Authorization Records
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

    A([Start: Load Authorization Records])
    B[Set Row Counter to 1\nClear Last Authorization Key]
    C{Row Counter\n> 5 OR\nNo More Records?}
    D{Is this PF7\nand First Row?}
    E[23: Reposition Database Cursor\nto Saved Page Key]
    F[22: Fetch Next\nAuthorization Record]
