rules.rule_name: Initialize Authorization List Loading
rules.rule_description: Before loading authorization records onto the screen, the system initializes the row counter to 1 and clears the last displayed authorization key tracker to prepare for a fresh page load.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Row Counter to 1
Clear Last Authorization Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to load a page of pending authorization records for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization list loading process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row counter is set to 1 and the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is cleared to LOW-VALUES, ensuring no stale key references remain from a prior page

rules.rule_name: Authorization List Page Loading Loop Termination Condition
rules.rule_description: The system continues loading authorization records onto the screen until either 5 rows have been filled or there are no more authorization records available for the account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Row Counter
> 5 OR
No More Records?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is in the process of loading authorization records for the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: Each iteration of the loading loop is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The loop continues loading records only if the row counter is 5 or less AND more authorization records exist (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) AND no error condition has been raised (ERR-FLG-OFF); the loop terminates when the row counter exceeds 5, or no more records are available, or an error occurs

rules.rule_name: Backward Navigation Cursor Repositioning on First Row
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates backward (PF7) to a previous page, the system must reposition the database cursor to the saved starting key of that page before fetching records, but only on the very first row of the page load.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Is this PF7
and First Row?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records for a page
acceptance_criteria.When: The current action is a PF7 (backward navigation) request AND the row counter is at position 1 (first row)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system repositions the database cursor to the saved page key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) before fetching the first record; for all subsequent rows (row counter > 1) or for any action other than PF7, the system fetches the next sequential authorization record without repositioning

rules.rule_name: Reposition Database Cursor to Saved Page Key for Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: When navigating backward to a previous page, the system repositions the authorization record cursor to the specific authorization key that was saved as the starting point of that page, enabling accurate backward page navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23: Reposition Database Cursor
to Saved Page Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to navigate to a previous page AND the system is processing the first row of the page load
acceptance_criteria.When: The system repositions the database cursor using the saved page key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) as the search key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) against the pending authorization detail segment (PAUTDTL1)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the record matching the saved key is found, the system sets the record availability indicator to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) and proceeds to populate the row; if the record is not found or the end of data is reached, the system sets the indicator to 'no more records' (AUTHS-EOF)

rules.rule_name: Fetch Next Sequential Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: During normal forward page loading, the system sequentially fetches the next pending authorization detail record for the account from the authorization database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
22: Fetch Next
Authorization Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records for the current page AND the action is not a PF7 backward navigation on the first row
acceptance_criteria.When: The system fetches the next authorization record from the pending authorization detail segment (PAUTDTL1) using a sequential get-next-within-parent (GNP) database call
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a record is successfully retrieved, the system sets the record availability indicator to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) and the record data (transaction ID, dates, amounts, response codes, match status, auth type) is available for display; if no more records exist or end of data is reached, the system sets the indicator to 'no more records' (AUTHS-EOF)

rules.rule_name: Authorization Date Format Conversion
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format and the origination time stored in HHMMSS format must be reformatted into user-friendly display formats MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS respectively before being shown on screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27: Format Date
YYMMDD → MM/DD/YY
Format Time HHMMSS → HH:MM:SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved with an origination date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) in YYMMDD format and an origination time (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) in HHMMSS format
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the authorization data for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The date is reformatted by mapping positions 1-2 (YY) to the year portion, positions 3-4 (MM) to the month portion, and positions 5-6 (DD) to the day portion, producing a display date (WS-AUTH-DATE) in MM/DD/YY format; the time is reformatted by mapping positions 1-2 (HH) to hours, positions 3-4 (MM) to minutes, and positions 5-6 (SS) to seconds, producing a display time (WS-AUTH-TIME) in HH:MM:SS format

rules.rule_name: Derive Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
rules.rule_description: The system derives a single-character approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the database, translating it into a business-meaningful approved or declined status for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
28: Derive Approval Status
Response Code 00 = Approved
Any Other Code = Declined

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved with an authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the response code to determine the approval outcome
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the response code equals '00', the approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is set to 'A' indicating Approved; if the response code is any value other than '00', the approval status is set to 'D' indicating Declined

rules.rule_name: Populate Authorization Record Row on Screen
rules.rule_description: Each successfully retrieved authorization record is displayed in its corresponding row on the pending authorization summary screen, showing all relevant authorization details and enabling the row's selection field for user input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
26: Populate Row on Screen
Transaction ID, Date, Time,
Auth Type, Approval Status,
Match Status, Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and its date, time, and approval status have been formatted
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen row corresponding to the current row counter (WS-IDX, values 1 through 5)
acceptance_criteria.Then: For the row matching the current row counter, the system displays: Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID → TRNIDnn), formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE → PDATEnn), formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME → PTIMEnn), authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE → PTYPEnn), derived approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT → PAPRVnn), match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS → PSTATnn), and approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT → PAMTnnn); the authorization key is also saved to the session key array (CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(n)) for that row position; the selection field (SELnnnnA) for that row is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) allowing the user to enter a selection value

rules.rule_name: Track Last Displayed Authorization Key
rules.rule_description: After each authorization record is successfully displayed on screen, the system saves its authorization key as the last displayed key on the current page. This key is used to determine the starting point for the next page when the user navigates forward.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Save Authorization Key
as Last Displayed Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and populated onto the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes populating a row with authorization data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization key of the just-displayed record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved as the last displayed key on the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST), overwriting any previously saved last key; this key is updated after every successfully displayed row so it always reflects the key of the last record shown on the page

rules.rule_name: Save Page Start Key and Increment Page Number for Second Record
rules.rule_description: When the second authorization record on a page is successfully displayed, the system increments the page number and saves the authorization key of the first record on this page. This saved key enables accurate backward navigation (PF7) to return to the beginning of this page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
25: Save Page Key
Record first key of this page
for backward navigation
Increment Page Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: Authorization records are being loaded onto the screen and a record has just been successfully populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The row counter after incrementing equals 2 (meaning the record just displayed was the first record, and the second slot is now being prepared — i.e., WS-IDX = 2 after COMPUTE WS-IDX = WS-IDX + 1)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is incremented by 1, and the authorization key of the first record on this page (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved into the page key history array at the current page number position (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)), enabling the system to reposition to the start of this page during backward navigation

rules.rule_name: Advance Row Counter After Each Record Display
rules.rule_description: After each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the row counter is incremented by 1 to advance to the next available display row.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Advance Row
Counter by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and populated onto the current screen row
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes populating the current row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row counter (WS-IDX) is incremented by 1 (COMPUTE WS-IDX = WS-IDX + 1), moving the pointer to the next available row position for the subsequent record

rules.rule_name: Check Whether All Five Display Rows Are Filled
rules.rule_description: After the loading loop completes, the system determines whether all 5 display rows were filled with authorization records or whether the loop ended early due to no more records being available, in order to decide whether to check for additional pages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
All 5 Rows
Filled?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization record loading loop has completed either by filling all 5 rows or by exhausting available records
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the end-of-loop condition
acceptance_criteria.Then: If all 5 rows were filled (AUTHS-NOT-EOF is true and ERR-FLG-OFF is true after the loop), the system proceeds to peek at the next record to determine if more pages exist; if fewer than 5 rows were filled because no more records were available, the system skips the peek and proceeds directly to display the screen without setting a next-page indicator

rules.rule_name: Peek at Next Record to Determine Additional Pages Availability
rules.rule_description: After filling all 5 display rows, the system performs a lookahead fetch of the next authorization record to determine whether additional pages of data exist beyond the current page, without displaying that record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24: Peek at Next Record
Check if more records exist
beyond current page

acceptance_criteria.Given: All 5 authorization rows on the current page have been successfully populated AND no error condition exists
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a lookahead by fetching the next sequential authorization record from the pending authorization detail segment (PAUTDTL1)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fetch result is used solely to set the next-page availability indicator; the fetched record data is not displayed on screen; if a record is found, the next-page indicator is set to YES; if no record is found, the next-page indicator is set to NO

rules.rule_name: Set Next Page Indicator Based on Additional Records Availability
rules.rule_description: After the lookahead fetch, the system sets the next-page availability indicator to reflect whether the user can navigate forward to an additional page of authorization records using PF8.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
21: Set Next Page
Indicator = YES
More pages available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed a lookahead fetch after filling all 5 display rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the lookahead fetch
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the lookahead fetch successfully retrieved a record (AUTHS-NOT-EOF and ERR-FLG-OFF), the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES) is set to TRUE, indicating that PF8 forward navigation is available; if the lookahead fetch found no record or reached end of data, the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-NO) is set to TRUE, indicating that the current page is the last page and PF8 forward navigation is not available

sub_functionalities.title: Reposition to Last Displayed Authorization Record
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([PF8 Forward Page Requested])
    B{Is there a\nlast displayed\nauthorization key\nsaved?}
    C[No saved key available\nStart from beginning\nof authorization list]
    D[Copy last displayed\nauthorization key\nto reposition target]
    E[Request authorization records\nstarting from the\nsaved account ID]
    F[Search authorization records\nfor the saved key\nusing account ID match]
    G{Saved authorization\nrecord found?}
    H[Cursor positioned at\nlast displayed record\nReady to load next page]
    I[No more authorization\nrecords found\nEnd of list reached]
    J{Next page\nrecords available?}
    K[Proceed to load\nnext page of\nauthorization records]
    L[Display message:\nAlready at bottom\nof the page]

    A --> B
    B -->|No saved key\nSpaces or empty| C
    C --> L
    B -->|Saved key exists| D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G -->|Found - cursor\npositioned| H
    G -->|Not found -\nend of list| I
    I --> L
    H --> J

rules.rule_name: Determine If Forward Page Navigation Is Possible Based on Saved Authorization Key
rules.rule_description: When the user requests the next page of authorizations (PF8), the system checks whether a last-displayed authorization key was saved from the current page. This key is required to reposition the cursor in the authorization list to load the next set of records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is there a last displayed authorization key saved?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing a page of pending authorization records for an account and presses PF8 to navigate forward
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) to determine if it contains a valid saved key or is empty (spaces or low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the last displayed authorization key is spaces or low-values, the system clears the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and proceeds to check if a next page is available, which will result in displaying 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' message. If the last displayed authorization key contains a valid value, the system copies it to the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and proceeds to reposition the authorization list cursor.

rules.rule_name: Clear Reposition Target When No Last Authorization Key Is Available
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 and no last-displayed authorization key has been saved, the system clears the reposition target, indicating there is no valid position to navigate forward from, which will ultimately result in a 'bottom of page' message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No saved key available
Start from beginning
of authorization list

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is found to be spaces or low-values (no saved key exists)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to low-values, sets the screen send mode to overlay (no full erase), and since no next-page indicator is set, displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'

rules.rule_name: Copy Last Displayed Authorization Key as Reposition Target for Forward Navigation
rules.rule_description: When a valid last-displayed authorization key exists, the system copies it to the reposition target field so that the authorization list can be repositioned to the correct starting point for loading the next page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Copy last displayed
authorization key
to reposition target

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate forward and the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) contains a valid non-blank, non-empty value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition the authorization list cursor for forward page navigation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) into the reposition target key field (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the starting position for retrieving the next page of authorization records

rules.rule_name: Refresh Authorization Summary Before Repositioning for Forward Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before repositioning the authorization list cursor for forward page navigation, the system refreshes the authorization summary data for the account to ensure the most current summary information is available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Request authorization records
starting from the
saved account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and a valid last displayed authorization key has been saved and copied to the reposition target
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition the authorization list to load the next page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the authorization summary retrieval (GET-AUTH-SUMMARY) using the current account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) to refresh the authorization summary segment before repositioning the cursor in the authorization detail records

rules.rule_name: Reposition Authorization List Cursor to Last Displayed Record
rules.rule_description: The system repositions the authorization list cursor to the last record displayed on the current page by searching for the saved authorization key. This ensures the next page load begins immediately after the last record the user saw.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Search authorization records
for the saved key
using account ID match

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization summary has been retrieved and the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) contains the key of the last authorization record displayed on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes a search of the pending authorization detail records (PAUTDTL1 segment) using the saved authorization key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) to locate the exact last-displayed record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system positions the authorization list cursor at the matching record so that subsequent reads will retrieve records starting immediately after the last displayed record, enabling the next page to be loaded correctly

rules.rule_name: Determine Cursor Position Result After Repositioning to Last Displayed Authorization
rules.rule_description: After attempting to reposition the authorization list cursor to the last displayed record, the system evaluates whether the target record was found, setting the appropriate end-of-list indicator to control subsequent page loading.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Saved authorization
record found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the pending authorization detail records (PAUTDTL1) using the saved authorization key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the authorization record search
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization record matching the saved key is found, the system sets the 'authorizations not at end-of-file' indicator (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) to true, meaning the cursor is correctly positioned and the next page can be loaded. If the record is not found or the end of the authorization list is reached, the system sets the 'authorizations end-of-file' indicator (AUTHS-EOF) to true, meaning no further records are available.

rules.rule_name: Confirm Cursor Is Positioned and Ready to Load Next Page
rules.rule_description: When the authorization list cursor is successfully positioned at the last displayed record, the system is ready to proceed with loading the next page of authorization records for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Cursor positioned at
last displayed record
Ready to load next page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully repositioned the authorization list cursor by finding the saved authorization key in the pending authorization detail records
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization record search returns a successful match (AUTHS-NOT-EOF is set to true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to evaluate whether next-page records are available (NEXT-PAGE-YES indicator), and if so, initializes the authorization display rows and loads the next page of up to 5 authorization records

rules.rule_name: Handle End of Authorization List When Repositioning Fails
rules.rule_description: When the system cannot find the saved authorization key during repositioning, it means the end of the authorization list has been reached and no further records are available for forward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No more authorization
records found
End of list reached

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system attempts to reposition the authorization list cursor using the saved authorization key
acceptance_criteria.When: The search returns a 'segment not found' or 'end of database' result, meaning the saved key no longer exists or the list is exhausted
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the end-of-file indicator (AUTHS-EOF) to true, and since the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES) is not set, displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' to inform the user that no further authorization records are available

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Whether Next Page of Authorization Records Is Available
rules.rule_description: After repositioning the authorization list cursor, the system checks whether a next page of records is available before proceeding to load and display them, preventing unnecessary processing when already at the last page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Next page
records available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization list cursor has been repositioned to the last displayed record and the system is ready to load the next page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the next-page availability indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the next-page indicator is set to YES, the system initializes the five authorization display rows (clears all row fields) and proceeds to load the next page of authorization records (PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD). If the next-page indicator is not set to YES, the system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and does not change the displayed authorization list.

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Load Next Page of Authorization Records
rules.rule_description: When next-page records are confirmed to be available, the system clears the current authorization display rows and loads the next set of up to 5 authorization records for the account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Proceed to load
next page of
authorization records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization list cursor is positioned at the last displayed record and the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES) confirms more records exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The system proceeds with forward page navigation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system first initializes all five authorization display rows by clearing Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields for rows 1 through 5, then invokes PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD to read and populate the next page of up to 5 pending authorization records

rules.rule_name: Display Bottom-of-Page Message When No Further Authorization Records Exist
rules.rule_description: When forward page navigation is not possible because no further authorization records exist beyond the current page, the system informs the user that they have reached the last page of authorization records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display message:
Already at bottom
of the page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate forward in the authorization list
acceptance_criteria.When: Either no last-displayed authorization key was saved, the saved key could not be found during repositioning, or the next-page indicator is not set to YES
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' on the screen, sets the screen send mode to overlay (no full erase), and does not change the currently displayed authorization records

rules.rule_name: Validate Backward Navigation Eligibility
rules.rule_description: Determine whether the user can navigate to a previous page of authorization records. Navigation is only permitted when the user is not already on the first page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is current page greater than 1?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the current page number is tracked in the session
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the current page number is greater than 1, backward navigation proceeds; if the current page number is 1 or less, the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' is displayed and the screen is refreshed without any data change

rules.rule_name: Display Already at Top of List Message
rules.rule_description: Inform the user that no previous page exists when they attempt to navigate backward from the first page of authorization records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 20: Display Message: Already at top of list

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the current page number is 1
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message 'You are already at the top of the page...' is displayed on the screen, the screen is refreshed without erasing (overlay mode), and no authorization data is changed

rules.rule_name: Decrement Page Number for Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: Reduce the current page number by one to identify the target previous page when the user navigates backward through authorization records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Decrement page number by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on a page greater than 1 of the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current page number is decremented by 1 to identify the target previous page number

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Saved Page Start Key for Target Page
rules.rule_description: Retrieve the authorization key that was saved as the starting record of the target previous page, enabling accurate repositioning of the authorization record cursor.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve saved page key for the target page from page key history

acceptance_criteria.Given: The page number has been decremented to the target previous page number and a history of page start keys is maintained in the session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to load the previous page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The saved authorization key corresponding to the target page number is retrieved from the page key history and stored as the current navigation key to be used for repositioning

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account During Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: Re-fetch the Pending Authorization Summary segment for the account to ensure the database session is active and the authorization data context is current before loading the previous page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account

acceptance_criteria.Given: The target page key has been retrieved and the account ID is available in the session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to reload authorization records for the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary segment is retrieved from the database for the current account ID; if found, processing continues; if not found, summary fields are treated as unavailable

rules.rule_name: Clear All Five Authorization List Rows Before Reload
rules.rule_description: Reset all five authorization record display rows to blank before loading the previous page data, ensuring no stale data from the prior page remains visible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 17: Clear all five authorization list rows

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to load the previous page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization list rows are initialized prior to populating with new data
acceptance_criteria.Then: All five rows on the screen are cleared: Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields are set to spaces for each of the five rows, and each row's selection field is set to protected (non-enterable)

rules.rule_name: Reposition Authorization Cursor to Saved Page Key
rules.rule_description: Reposition the authorization record retrieval cursor to the specific authorization record identified by the saved page start key, so that the correct set of records is loaded for the previous page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Reposition authorization cursor to saved page key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The saved page start key for the target previous page has been retrieved and stored as the current navigation key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins loading authorization records for the previous page and the first row is being processed during a PF7 navigation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization record retrieval is repositioned to the authorization record matching the saved page start key; if the record is found, retrieval continues from that position; if the record is not found, the end-of-data condition is set

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Next Authorization Record Sequentially
rules.rule_description: Sequentially retrieve the next pending authorization detail record from the database for the current account to populate the next available row on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve next authorization record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization cursor is positioned at the correct starting record for the page being loaded
acceptance_criteria.When: The system retrieves authorization records to fill the display rows (rows 2 through 5, or all rows when not the first row of a PF7 navigation)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next authorization detail record is retrieved sequentially; if a record is found, it is available for display; if no more records exist, the end-of-data condition is set and the loop stops

rules.rule_name: Populate Authorization Row with Record Data
rules.rule_description: Populate each authorization display row with the retrieved record's details, including formatting the date and time and deriving the approval status from the authorization response code.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 26: Populate authorization row: Transaction ID, Date, Time, Type, Approval Status A or D, Match Status, Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the corresponding display row (1 through 5) on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are populated for the row: Transaction ID, Date formatted as MM/DD/YY (derived from the authorization origination date), Time formatted as HH:MM:SS (derived from the authorization origination time), Authorization Type, Approval Status set to 'A' if the authorization response code is '00' or 'D' for any other response code, Match Status, and Approved Amount; the row's selection field is set to unprotected (enterable by the user)

rules.rule_name: Derive Approval Status from Authorization Response Code
rules.rule_description: Determine the display approval status of each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 26: Populate authorization row: Transaction ID, Date, Time, Type, Approval Status A or D, Match Status, Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system derives the approval status for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization response code equals '00', the approval status is set to 'A' (Approved); for any other response code value, the approval status is set to 'D' (Declined)

rules.rule_name: Save First Record Key as Page Start Key
rules.rule_description: Record the authorization key of the first record on the new page into the page key history to enable accurate backward navigation in future PF7 presses.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 25: Save first record key as page start key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The second authorization record (row index = 2) has been successfully retrieved and populated on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the second row during page loading
acceptance_criteria.Then: The page number is incremented by 1 and the authorization key of the second record is saved into the page key history at the position corresponding to the new page number, establishing the start key for this page

rules.rule_name: Peek at Next Record to Determine Further Page Availability
rules.rule_description: After filling up to five authorization rows, attempt to retrieve one additional record to determine whether a further page of authorization records exists, enabling or disabling the PF8 forward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 24: Peek at next record to check if further pages exist

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has finished populating up to five authorization rows or has reached end-of-data before filling all five rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether additional authorization records exist beyond the current page
acceptance_criteria.Then: One additional authorization record retrieval is attempted; if a record is found, the Next Page Available indicator is set to indicate PF8 forward navigation is available; if no record is found, the No Further Pages indicator is set to indicate PF8 forward navigation is not available

rules.rule_name: Set Next Page Available Indicator
rules.rule_description: Mark that additional authorization records exist beyond the current page so that the user can navigate forward using PF8.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Next Page Available indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The peek retrieval after filling the current page has found an additional authorization record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether forward navigation should be enabled
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Next Page Available indicator is set to TRUE, signaling that PF8 forward navigation is available to the user

rules.rule_name: Set No Further Pages Indicator
rules.rule_description: Mark that no additional authorization records exist beyond the current page so that the user is informed there is no further forward navigation available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set No Further Pages indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The peek retrieval after filling the current page has found no additional authorization record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether forward navigation should be enabled
acceptance_criteria.Then: The No Further Pages indicator is set to TRUE, signaling that PF8 forward navigation is not available to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Updated Authorization Summary Screen After Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: Refresh the Pending Authorization Summary screen to display the reloaded previous page of authorization records or the top-of-list message to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 32: Display Updated Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward navigation processing is complete, either with the previous page loaded or the top-of-list message set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the updated screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Summary screen is displayed in overlay mode (without full screen erase), showing either the reloaded previous page of up to five authorization records with updated page navigation indicators, or the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' if the user was already on the first page

sub_functionalities.title: Reposition authorization cursor to saved page key
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Reposition Authorization Cursor])
    B[Retrieve saved page key for the\ntarget page from page-key history array]
    C[Set saved key as the\nauthorization search key]
    D[Search authorization records\nfor the matching key]
    E{Matching authorization\nrecord found?}
    F[Position cursor at the\nmatching authorization record\nReady to read forward from here]
    G[Mark end of authorization\nrecords reached\nNo records to display]
    H([End: Cursor Repositioned\nProceed to load page records])
    I([End: No Records Available\nPage will display empty])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E -->|Yes - Record Found| F
    F --> H
    E -->|No - Record Not Found\nor End of Records| G
    G --> I

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Saved Page Key from Page-Key History
rules.rule_description: When navigating backward (PF7) or forward (PF8) through authorization pages, the system retrieves the previously saved authorization key for the target page from the page-key history array to use as the repositioning anchor.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve saved page key for the target page from page-key history array

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is navigating between pages of the pending authorization list, and the system maintains a page-key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG) storing the first authorization key for each previously visited page, and a last-page key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) storing the last authorization key of the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: PF7 (page backward) is pressed, the system retrieves the saved first-authorization key for the decremented target page number from the page-key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by the new page number); OR when PF8 (page forward) is pressed, the system retrieves the last authorization key of the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The retrieved authorization key is stored in the working saved-key field (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the repositioning anchor for the subsequent authorization record search

rules.rule_name: Set Saved Authorization Key as Search Key for Repositioning
rules.rule_description: Before searching the authorization records database to reposition the cursor, the system sets the saved page key as the authorization record search key so the database query targets the correct starting position.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set saved key as the authorization search key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The saved page key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) has been populated with the target authorization key retrieved from the page-key history (either the first key of the target page for PF7, or the last key of the current page for PF8)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is about to reposition the authorization record cursor by invoking the REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The saved key value (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) is moved into the authorization record key field (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY), making it the active search key for the pending authorization details database query

rules.rule_name: Search Pending Authorization Records for Matching Key
rules.rule_description: The system searches the Pending Authorization Details database segment to locate the authorization record that matches the target key, positioning the database cursor at that record so subsequent sequential reads will retrieve records from that point forward.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search authorization records for the matching key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization record search key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) has been set to the target page anchor key, and the Pending Authorization database (IMS segment PAUTDTL1) is accessible via the scheduled Program Specification Block (PSB)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes a qualified Get Next within Parent (GNP) database call against the Pending Authorization Details segment (PAUTDTL1), searching for the record where the authorization key field (PAUT9CTS) matches the value in PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY
acceptance_criteria.Then: The database returns either the matching authorization record into the PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS data area, or a status indicating the record was not found or the end of available records was reached

rules.rule_name: Position Authorization Cursor at Matching Record
rules.rule_description: When the target authorization record is successfully located in the database, the system marks the authorization data stream as active and ready, so that subsequent sequential reads will retrieve records starting from this repositioned point forward.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Position cursor at the matching authorization record
Ready to read forward from here

acceptance_criteria.Given: A search for the target authorization key has been executed against the Pending Authorization Details database segment (PAUTDTL1)
acceptance_criteria.When: The database search returns a successful status (STATUS-OK), indicating the matching authorization record was found
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization end-of-data indicator to 'not end-of-file' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF = TRUE), signaling that the cursor is successfully positioned and the system is ready to read authorization records sequentially forward from this position to populate the page

rules.rule_name: Mark End of Authorization Records When Repositioning Target Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the target authorization key used for repositioning cannot be found in the database, or the end of the authorization records has been reached, the system marks the authorization data stream as exhausted so the page will be displayed as empty.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark end of authorization records reached
No records to display

acceptance_criteria.Given: A search for the target authorization key has been executed against the Pending Authorization Details database segment (PAUTDTL1)
acceptance_criteria.When: The database search returns a 'segment not found' status (SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND) indicating the target authorization key no longer exists in the database, OR returns an 'end of database' status (END-OF-DB) indicating no more authorization records are available
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization end-of-data indicator to 'end-of-file' (AUTHS-EOF = TRUE), signaling that no authorization records are available to display; the page will be rendered with empty authorization rows

sub_functionalities.title: Retrieve next authorization record
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Retrieve Next\nAuthorization Record])
    B[Request next authorization\ndetail record sequentially\nfrom IMS database]
    C{Record\nRetrieved\nSuccessfully?}
    D[Mark authorization\nrecord as available\nfor display]
    E{End of\nAuthorization\nRecords?}
    F[Mark end of\nauthorization list -\nno more records available]
    G([Return: Record\nAvailable for Display])
    H([Return: No More\nRecords Available])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C -->|Yes| D
    D --> G
    C -->|No| E
    E -->|Yes - No more records| F
    F --> H
    E -->|No - Unexpected condition| H

rules.rule_name: Sequential Retrieval of Next Pending Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the next pending authorization detail record in sequence for the current account from the authorization database. This is used to populate each row of the authorization list display, one record at a time, in the order they are stored.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Request next authorization detail record sequentially from IMS database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is in the process of building the authorization list for a given account, and a valid authorization summary segment has been found for that account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system requests the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database for the current account context
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next available pending authorization detail record (containing fields such as Authorization Key, Transaction ID, Approved Amount, Authorization Date, Authorization Time, Authorization Type, Response Code, Match Status) and makes it available for display on the authorization list screen

rules.rule_name: Mark Authorization Record as Available When Successfully Retrieved
rules.rule_description: When the authorization database successfully returns a pending authorization detail record, the system marks the record retrieval status as available, allowing the record's data to be used to populate a row on the authorization list screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark authorization record as available for display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has requested the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns the record successfully (retrieval status indicates success)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization list status to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF), indicating that a valid record has been retrieved and is ready to be populated into the current row of the authorization list display

rules.rule_name: Mark End of Authorization List When No More Records Exist
rules.rule_description: When the authorization database indicates that there are no more pending authorization detail records available for the current account — either because the specific segment was not found or the end of the available records has been reached — the system marks the authorization list as exhausted, stopping further retrieval attempts.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark end of authorization list - no more records available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has requested the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database indicates that either the requested authorization segment does not exist OR the end of all available authorization records for the account has been reached
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization list status to 'end of records' (AUTHS-EOF), which stops the page-building loop from requesting any further records and triggers evaluation of whether a next page indicator should be shown to the user

rules.rule_name: Handle Unexpected Condition During Authorization Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When an unexpected condition occurs during the retrieval of a pending authorization detail record — one that is neither a successful retrieval nor a normal end-of-records condition — the system raises an error flag, captures a descriptive error message, and immediately displays the authorization list screen with the error message, halting further record processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Unexpected condition

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has requested the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns an unexpected condition that is neither a successful retrieval nor a normal 'no more records' or 'segment not found' response
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y' (WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y'), constructs an error message reading 'System error while reading AUTH Details: Code: [database return code]', sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID field, and immediately sends the authorization list screen displaying the error message — stopping all further authorization record retrieval and page-building processing

key_functionalities.title: Top
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF7\nScroll Backward])
    B{Is current page\nnumber greater\nthan 1?}
    C[Display Message:\n'You are already at\nthe top of the page...']
    D[Refresh Current Screen\nwith Message - No Changes\nto Authorization List]
    E([Continue to\nBackward Navigation])

    A --> B
    B -->|No - Already on\nFirst Page| C
    C --> D
    D --> END([Return to User\nwith Informational Message])
    B -->|Yes - More pages\nexist before current| E

rules.rule_name: Detect First Page on Backward Scroll Attempt
rules.rule_description: When a user attempts to scroll backward through the Pending Authorization Summary list by pressing PF7, the system must first determine whether the user is already viewing the first page of results. This rule evaluates the current page number to decide whether backward navigation is possible or whether an informational message should be shown.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is current page number greater than 1?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary list screen with authorization records displayed, and the current page number is tracked in the session as CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to scroll backward through the authorization list
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system evaluates the current page number: if the current page number is greater than 1, backward navigation proceeds; if the current page number is 1 or less (already on the first page), the system suppresses backward navigation and triggers the top-of-list informational message instead

rules.rule_name: Display Top-of-List Message When Already on First Page
rules.rule_description: When a user presses PF7 to scroll backward but is already viewing the first page of the Pending Authorization Summary list, the system must inform the user that no further backward navigation is possible by displaying a specific informational message. The authorization list content remains unchanged and the screen is refreshed without erasing the existing display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: 'You are already at the top of the page...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary list screen and the current page number is 1 (i.e., CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM is not greater than 1), meaning the user is already on the first page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 attempting to scroll backward
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the informational message 'You are already at the top of the page...' on the screen, the authorization list content is not changed or reloaded, and the screen is refreshed using an overlay (non-erase) send so that the existing authorization records remain visible alongside the message

rules.rule_name: Preserve Authorization List Display When Top-of-List Reached
rules.rule_description: When the top-of-list condition is detected during a PF7 backward scroll attempt, the system must refresh the screen without altering the currently displayed authorization records. The screen is sent using an overlay mode (not a full erase), ensuring the existing list data remains intact and only the informational message is updated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Refresh Current Screen with Message - No Changes to Authorization List

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the user is already on the first page of the Pending Authorization Summary list (page number is not greater than 1) and the top-of-list message has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to send the screen back to the user after the failed PF7 backward scroll attempt
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is sent in overlay mode (SEND-ERASE-NO is set to TRUE, meaning no full screen erase is performed), the existing authorization list rows (up to 5 records) remain displayed without any reload or modification, and only the message area is updated with the top-of-list informational message

key_functionalities.title: Bottom
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF8\nScroll Forward])
    B{Last displayed\nauthorization key\navailable?}
    C[Retrieve Authorization\nSummary for Account]
    D[Reposition to Last\nDisplayed Authorization Record]
    E{More authorization\nrecords exist\nbeyond current page?}
    F[Load Next Page of\nAuthorization Records]
    G[21: Bottom-of-List Detection\nDisplay Message:\nYou are already at the\nbottom of the page...]
    H[32: Display Authorization\nSummary Screen with\nBottom-of-List Message]
    I([End])

    A --> B
    B -->|No last key -\nNo records loaded yet| G
    B -->|Last key exists| C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E -->|Yes - Next page exists| F
    F --> I
    E -->|No - Already on\nlast page| G
    G --> H
    H --> I

rules.rule_name: Determine If Forward Scrolling Is Possible Based on Last Displayed Authorization Key
rules.rule_description: When a user presses PF8 to scroll forward through the authorization list, the system checks whether a last-displayed authorization key exists to determine if any records have been previously loaded and if forward navigation is possible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Last displayed authorization key available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and presses PF8 to scroll forward
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is blank or contains low-values
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the last displayed authorization key is blank or low-values, the system clears the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and skips repositioning, proceeding directly to check if a next page is available; if the last displayed authorization key contains a valid value, the system saves it to WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE and proceeds to retrieve the authorization summary and reposition to that record

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account Before Forward Scroll
rules.rule_description: Before repositioning to the next page of authorizations, the system retrieves the current authorization summary segment for the account from the IMS database to ensure the session context is current.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and a valid last displayed authorization key exists for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system needs to navigate forward in the authorization list
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system schedules the IMS Program Specification Block (PSB) and retrieves the Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) for the current account ID; if the summary segment is found, the system sets the found-summary indicator to true and proceeds; if the summary segment is not found, the system sets the not-found indicator; the retrieved summary provides the context needed for repositioning within the authorization detail records

rules.rule_name: Reposition to Last Displayed Authorization Record for Forward Scroll
rules.rule_description: To load the next page of authorizations, the system repositions the database cursor to the last authorization record that was displayed on the current page, so that the next sequential records can be retrieved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Reposition to Last Displayed Authorization Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization summary has been retrieved and the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) contains the key of the last record displayed on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system needs to position to the correct starting point for the next page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system moves the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) into the authorization key field (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) and retrieves the authorization detail record (PAUTDTL1) from the IMS database using that specific key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY); if the record is found, the system sets the not-end-of-file indicator and is positioned at that record ready to read the next sequential records; if the record is not found or end of database is reached, the system sets the end-of-file indicator

rules.rule_name: Determine If Additional Authorization Records Exist Beyond the Current Page
rules.rule_description: After loading up to 5 authorization records for the current page, the system checks whether additional records exist beyond those displayed to determine if forward scrolling (PF8) should be enabled or if the user has reached the last page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: More authorization records exist beyond current page?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has finished loading up to 5 authorization records for the current page display
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the NEXT-PAGE indicator flag that was set during the page-forward processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the NEXT-PAGE indicator is set to YES (meaning an additional record was found beyond the 5 displayed), the system proceeds to load the next page of authorization records; if the NEXT-PAGE indicator is set to NO (meaning no additional records exist beyond the 5 displayed), the system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' to inform the user they have reached the last page

rules.rule_name: Load Next Page of Authorization Records
rules.rule_description: When additional authorization records exist beyond the current page, the system initializes the display rows and loads the next set of up to 5 authorization records into the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Load Next Page of Authorization Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The NEXT-PAGE indicator is YES, confirming more authorization records exist beyond the current page, and the database cursor is repositioned to the last displayed record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the forward page load
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system first clears all 5 authorization display rows (setting each row's Transaction ID, Date, Time, Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount to spaces, and setting each selection field to protected), then iterates through up to 5 authorization detail records (PAUTDTL1) sequentially; for each record retrieved, the system populates the corresponding row with: Transaction ID, Date formatted as MM/DD/YY, Time formatted as HH:MM:SS, Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' if response code is '00', 'D' for any other response code), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the authorization key for each row is saved in CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(1-5); the key of the first record on the new page is saved as the page-start key in CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG for backward navigation; the key of the last record displayed is saved in CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST

rules.rule_name: Bottom-of-List Detection - Inform User When Already on Last Page
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to scroll forward (PF8) but no additional authorization records exist beyond the currently displayed page, the system informs the user they have reached the end of the authorization list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
21: Bottom-of-List Detection
Display Message:
You are already at the
bottom of the page...

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and is on the last page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to scroll forward and either no last authorization key exists (no records were loaded) or the NEXT-PAGE indicator is set to NO after repositioning
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the message field (WS-MESSAGE) to 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and sets the screen send mode to overlay (SEND-ERASE-NO, meaning the screen is refreshed without a full erase), and the authorization list rows remain unchanged showing the current last page of records

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Summary Screen with Bottom-of-List Message
rules.rule_description: After determining the user is at the bottom of the authorization list, the system refreshes the screen displaying the bottom-of-list message to the user while preserving the current page content.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 32: Display Authorization Summary Screen with Bottom-of-List Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The bottom-of-list message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' has been set and the screen send mode is overlay (SEND-ERASE-NO)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Pending Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A from mapset COPAU00)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with current date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), current time (formatted as HH:MM:SS), transaction name, and program name; the error message area displays 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'; the screen is sent in overlay mode (without full erase) preserving the existing authorization list rows; the cursor is positioned at the Account ID field; the current page of authorization records remains visible to the user

key_functionalities.title: Authorization Records Paging
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Retrieve Authorization Records\nfor Current Page])
    B{Any errors\nor account\nnot found?}
    C([End: Skip - Error Already Displayed])
    D[Set Row Counter to 1\nClear Last Authorization Key]
    E{Row Counter > 5\nOR No More Records?}
    F{Is this PF7\nand first row?}
    G[Reposition to Saved\nPage Key Record]
    H[Read Next Authorization\nDetail Record]
    I{Record\nFound?}
    J[27: Format Authorization Date\nConvert YYMMDD → MM/DD/YY]

rules.rule_name: Skip Authorization Record Retrieval When Error Exists
rules.rule_description: If an error condition has already been raised (e.g., account not found, data retrieval failure) before the authorization list retrieval begins, the system skips the entire page-loading process, as an error message has already been displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Any errors or account not found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to retrieve authorization records for display on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: An error flag is active, indicating a prior error condition such as account not found or a data retrieval failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips all authorization record retrieval and page population steps entirely, since the error has already been communicated to the user

rules.rule_name: Initialize Page Row Counter and Last Authorization Key Tracker
rules.rule_description: Before retrieving authorization records for a new page, the system initializes the row counter to 1 and clears the tracker that holds the last authorization key displayed on the page, ensuring a clean state for page population.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Row Counter to 1
Clear Last Authorization Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: No active error condition exists and the system is ready to load authorization records for the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The page-forward process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row counter is set to 1 and the last authorization key tracker is cleared to low-values, preparing the system to populate up to 5 rows on the screen

rules.rule_name: Stop Retrieving Records When Page Is Full or No More Records Exist
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves authorization records one at a time and stops when either 5 records have been loaded (filling the page) or there are no more authorization records available for the account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Row Counter > 5
OR No More Records?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is in the process of retrieving and displaying authorization records for the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The row counter exceeds 5 OR the end-of-records condition is reached OR an error flag is raised
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system exits the record retrieval loop and proceeds to check whether additional records exist beyond the current page

rules.rule_name: Reposition to Saved Page Key on PF7 Navigation for First Row
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates backward using PF7, the system must reposition the database cursor to the saved start key of the target page before reading the first record, ensuring the correct page of records is displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Is this PF7
and first row?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 (page backward) and the system is about to retrieve the first record for the page
acceptance_criteria.When: The current action is a PF7 backward navigation AND the row counter is at position 1 (first row)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system repositions the authorization record cursor to the saved page start key before reading, so that the correct set of records is retrieved for the previous page

rules.rule_name: Read Next Authorization Detail Record Sequentially
rules.rule_description: For all rows other than the first row during PF7 navigation, the system reads the next authorization detail record sequentially from the database to populate the next row on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Read Next Authorization
Detail Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating authorization records for the current page and no repositioning is required
acceptance_criteria.When: The current action is not a PF7 first-row reposition (i.e., it is a normal sequential read)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the next available authorization detail record sequentially from the pending authorization database segment

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Authorization Records
rules.rule_description: After each read attempt, the system evaluates whether a record was successfully retrieved. If no record is found or the end of available records is reached, the retrieval loop is exited.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Record
Found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read an authorization detail record from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The read result indicates the record segment was not found or the end of the database has been reached
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the end-of-records indicator to true and exits the retrieval loop, stopping further record population for the current page

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Date from YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination date stored in the database uses a YYMMDD format. The system reformats this date into MM/DD/YY format for display on the authorization list screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27: Format Authorization Date
Convert YYMMDD → MM/DD/YY

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the authorization date for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization origination date is reformatted from YYMMDD storage format to MM/DD/YY display format, where positions 1-2 become the year (YY), positions 3-4 become the month (MM), and positions 5-6 become the day (DD), resulting in a MM/DD/YY formatted date

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Time from HHMMSS to HH:MM:SS
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination time stored in the database uses a compact HHMMSS format. The system reformats this time into HH:MM:SS format with separators for display on the authorization list screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27: Format Authorization Time
Convert HHMMSS → HH:MM:SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the authorization time for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization origination time is reformatted from HHMMSS storage format to HH:MM:SS display format, where positions 1-2 map to hours (HH) at display positions 1-2, positions 3-4 map to minutes (MM) at display positions 4-5, and positions 5-6 map to seconds (SS) at display positions 7-8, with colon separators inserted

rules.rule_name: Derive Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
rules.rule_description: The system derives a human-readable approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the database. A response code of '00' indicates an approved authorization, while any other response code indicates a declined authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
28: Derive Approval Status
Response Code 00 → Approved
Any Other Code → Declined

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved and contains an authorization response code
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code to determine the approval status
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the response code is '00', the approval status is set to 'A' (Approved); if the response code is any value other than '00', the approval status is set to 'D' (Declined)

rules.rule_name: Populate Authorization Row on Screen with All Required Fields
rules.rule_description: For each retrieved authorization record, the system populates the corresponding row on the authorization list screen with all required display fields. The row position (1 through 5) determines which set of screen fields is populated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
26: Populate Row on Screen
Transaction ID, Date, Time,
Type, Approval Status,
Match Status, Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved and its date, time, and approval status have been formatted
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen row corresponding to the current row counter value (1 through 5)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the following fields in the row matching the row counter position: Transaction ID, Authorization Date (MM/DD/YY), Authorization Time (HH:MM:SS), Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the selection field for that row is set to unprotected to allow user input; the authorization key for that row is saved in the session for later selection processing

rules.rule_name: Save Last Displayed Authorization Key for Forward Navigation
rules.rule_description: After each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the system saves that record's authorization key as the last key displayed on the current page. This key is used by the PF8 forward navigation to correctly position to the next page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Save Authorization Key
as Last Key Displayed

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully populated into a row on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system updates the page navigation tracking information
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization key of the most recently displayed record is saved as the last authorization key on the current page, enabling the PF8 forward navigation to correctly retrieve the next set of records

rules.rule_name: Increment Page Number and Save Page Start Key on Second Record
rules.rule_description: When the second authorization record on a page is populated, the system increments the page number counter and saves that record's authorization key as the start key for the current page. This saved key enables accurate backward navigation using PF7.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
25: Increment Page Number
Save this record's key as
Page Start Key for Back Navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has just populated the second authorization record (row counter = 2) on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The row counter equals 2 after populating a record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The page number counter is incremented by 1, and the authorization key of the second record is saved as the page start key for the current page number, enabling PF7 backward navigation to return to the beginning of this page

rules.rule_name: Advance Row Counter After Each Record Population
rules.rule_description: After each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the row counter is incremented by 1 to advance to the next available row position for the subsequent record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Advance Row Counter by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully populated into the current row on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes population of the current row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row counter is incremented by 1, advancing the position for the next authorization record to be populated

rules.rule_name: Check for Additional Records Beyond Current Page
rules.rule_description: After filling up to 5 rows on the current page, the system checks whether additional authorization records exist beyond the current page. This check determines whether the PF8 (next page) navigation option should be made available to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Still records
remaining after
5 rows filled?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed populating the current page with up to 5 authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieval loop exits after filling the page
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the end-of-records indicator is not set and no error exists, the system attempts to peek at the next record to determine if more records are available; if the end-of-records indicator is already set, the system proceeds directly to mark the next page as unavailable

rules.rule_name: Peek at Next Authorization Record to Determine Page Availability
rules.rule_description: After loading the current page, the system reads one additional authorization record beyond the last displayed record to determine whether a next page of records exists, without displaying that record on screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Peek at Next Record
to Check Availability

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current page has been fully populated and the end-of-records condition has not yet been reached
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a peek read of the next authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the next authorization record from the database solely to check its existence; the result determines whether the next page navigation flag is set to available or unavailable

rules.rule_name: Set Next Page Available When Additional Records Exist
rules.rule_description: If the peek read confirms that at least one more authorization record exists beyond the current page, the system marks the next page as available, enabling the user to navigate forward using PF8.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24: Set Next Page
Available Flag = YES

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a peek read after filling the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The peek read successfully retrieves an additional authorization record, confirming more records exist
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next page available flag is set to YES, indicating that the user may press PF8 to navigate to the next page of authorization records

rules.rule_name: Set Next Page Unavailable When No Additional Records Exist
rules.rule_description: If no additional authorization records exist beyond the current page (either confirmed by a failed peek read or by the end-of-records condition being set before the peek), the system marks the next page as unavailable, preventing PF8 navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24: Set Next Page
Available Flag = NO

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed loading the current page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.When: Either the end-of-records condition was already set before the peek attempt, OR the peek read returns no record (end of records or segment not found)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next page available flag is set to NO, indicating that the user is on the last page and PF8 forward navigation is not available; if the user presses PF8, the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' will be displayed
