rules.rule_name: Set Saved Authorization Key as Target for Repositioning
rules.rule_description: Before repositioning the authorization list cursor, the system must load the previously saved authorization key as the target search key so the database knows which record to locate.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Saved Authorization Key as the Target Search Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has navigated to a previous page and the system has a saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) stored from prior page navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates a repositioning operation to return to a specific page of the authorization list
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) as the active search key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) to be used as the target for locating the correct position in the authorization records

rules.rule_name: Search Authorization Detail Records Using Saved Key to Position Cursor
rules.rule_description: The system must query the Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key to reposition the database cursor to the correct starting point for the page being navigated to.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search Authorization Detail Records Using Saved Key to Position Database Cursor

acceptance_criteria.Given: The saved authorization key has been set as the target search key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) and the system is ready to reposition within the Pending Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes a database search using the saved authorization key as the search criterion (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) against the Authorization database (PCB PAUT-PCB-NUM)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the authorization detail record matching the saved key, positioning the database cursor at that specific record so subsequent sequential reads will return records starting from that position forward

rules.rule_name: Confirm Successful Cursor Positioning at Saved Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: When the authorization detail record matching the saved key is found, the system confirms the cursor is correctly positioned and marks the authorization list as active and ready for forward reading.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Cursor Successfully Positioned at Saved Authorization Record Ready to Read Forward

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has executed a search for the authorization detail record using the saved authorization key
acceptance_criteria.When: The database search returns a successful status (STATUS-OK), indicating the matching authorization record was found
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization list as not at end-of-file (AUTHS-NOT-EOF = TRUE), confirming the cursor is positioned at the saved authorization record and the system is ready to read subsequent authorization records sequentially in the forward direction

rules.rule_name: Mark Authorization List as Exhausted When Saved Record Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the saved authorization key no longer matches any existing record, or the end of the authorization list has been reached, the system must mark the authorization list as having no more available records to prevent further page navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Matching Record Found Mark Authorization List as End of Available Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has executed a search for the authorization detail record using the saved authorization key
acceptance_criteria.When: The database search returns either a 'Segment Not Found' status or an 'End of Database' status, indicating no matching authorization record exists at the saved key position
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization list as end-of-file (AUTHS-EOF = TRUE), indicating there are no available authorization records to display from that position, effectively preventing further forward page navigation

rules.rule_name: Extract Approved Amount from Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: When populating an authorization row on the summary screen, the system retrieves the approved amount from the pending authorization record and prepares it for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Approved Amount
from Authorization Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved from the authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is preparing to populate an authorization row on the summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the Approved Amount from the authorization record and stores it in the display amount field for subsequent formatting and screen population

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Time for Display
rules.rule_description: The raw authorization origination time stored as a 6-character HHMMSS string must be reformatted into a human-readable HH:MM:SS display format before being shown on the authorization summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Time:
Extract HH, MM, SS
from raw HHMMSS
into HH:MM:SS display format

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record contains an origination time stored in raw HHMMSS format (6 characters, positions 1-2 = hours, 3-4 = minutes, 5-6 = seconds)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the authorization time for display on the summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts hours from positions 1-2, minutes from positions 3-4, and seconds from positions 5-6 of the raw time field, and assembles them into the display format HH:MM:SS (with colon separators at positions 3 and 6)

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Date for Display
rules.rule_description: The raw authorization origination date stored as a 6-character YYMMDD string must be reformatted into a human-readable MM/DD/YY display format before being shown on the authorization summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Extract YY, MM, DD
from raw YYMMDD
into MM/DD/YY display format

acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the authorization date for display on the summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the year (YY) from positions 1-2, month (MM) from positions 3-4, and day (DD) from positions 5-6 of the raw date field, and assembles them into the display format MM/DD/YY (with slash separators)

rules.rule_name: Determine Authorization Approval Status

rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Response Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the response code equals '00', the system sets the Approval Status to 'A' (Approved); if the response code is any value other than '00', the system sets the Approval Status to 'D' (Declined)

rules.rule_name: Set Approval Status to Approved

rules.sub_graph_node_text:

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is being evaluated

rules.rule_name: Set Approval Status to Declined

rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Declined

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is being evaluated

    F[No more authorization records\navailable at or after\nthe requested position\nMark as End of Records]
    G([End: Cursor Repositioned\nPaging can continue accurately])
    H([End: No Records Found\nat Requested Position])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D -->|Record Found| E
    E --> G
    D -->|Record Not Found /\nEnd of Records| F
    F --> H

rules.rule_name: Use Saved Authorization Key as Reposition Target
rules.rule_description: When the system needs to reposition the authorization list cursor for paging purposes, it uses the authorization key that was previously saved in the paging context as the exact target position to search for in the Authorization Detail records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Take the saved authorization key from the current paging context as the target position

acceptance_criteria.Given: A paging operation (either backward via PF7 or forward via PF8) has been initiated and a saved authorization key exists in the current paging context (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition the Authorization Detail record cursor
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the search target to the saved authorization key from the paging context, so that the Authorization Detail records can be searched starting from that exact key position

rules.rule_name: Search Authorization Detail Records by Saved Key
rules.rule_description: The system queries the Pending Authorization Detail segment in the database using the saved authorization key as the search criterion to reposition the reading cursor to the correct location in the authorization list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search the Authorization Detail records in the IMS database for the record matching the saved authorization key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The saved authorization key has been set as the target position and the Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1) is accessible within the current account's pending authorization data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the Pending Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key as the match criterion
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Authorization Detail record whose authorization key matches the saved key, positioning the cursor at that record so that subsequent reads will proceed forward from that point

rules.rule_name: Cursor Successfully Positioned at Target Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: When the target authorization record is found during repositioning, the system marks the authorization data stream as active and available, enabling the page-forward process to continue reading records from that position.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Cursor is now positioned at the requested authorization record. Ready to read forward from this point

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key
acceptance_criteria.When: The target authorization record matching the saved key is found successfully in the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record stream as 'Not End of Records' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF), indicating that the cursor is correctly positioned and the page-forward process can proceed to read and display authorization records from this point

rules.rule_name: No Authorization Record Found at Requested Position
rules.rule_description: When the target authorization record is not found during repositioning — either because the specific record no longer exists or the end of the authorization data has been reached — the system marks the authorization stream as exhausted, preventing further page-forward attempts.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No more authorization records available at or after the requested position. Mark as End of Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key
acceptance_criteria.When: The target authorization record is not found (segment not found) OR the end of the authorization data has been reached (end of database)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record stream as 'End of Records' (AUTHS-EOF), indicating that no authorization records are available at or after the requested position, and the page-forward process will not attempt to display any records

rules.rule_name: Determine Saved Key Source for Backward Page Navigation (PF7)
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates backward (PF7), the system decrements the page number and retrieves the first authorization key that was saved when that page was originally loaded, using it as the reposition target to accurately redisplay that page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Take the saved authorization key from the current paging context as the target position

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 (page backward) and the current page number is greater than 1
acceptance_criteria.When: The system decrements the page number by 1 and prepares to reload the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the saved first-authorization-key for the decremented page number from the page key history (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by the new page number) and sets it as the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the reposition target

rules.rule_name: Determine Saved Key Source for Forward Page Navigation (PF8)
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates forward (PF8), the system uses the last authorization key displayed on the current page as the reposition target, so that the next page begins reading from the record immediately following the current page's last record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Take the saved authorization key from the current paging context as the target position

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 (page forward), the last authorization key on the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is not blank or low-values, and more pages are available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to load the next page of authorization records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to the last authorization key displayed on the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST), then retrieves the authorization summary and repositions the cursor to that key so that forward reading begins from that record

rules.rule_name: Trigger Repositioning Only on First Row During PF7 Page Load
rules.rule_description: During the page-forward loading loop, repositioning of the authorization cursor is performed only once — on the very first row iteration and only when the user pressed PF7 (backward navigation). For all other rows and all other navigation actions, the system simply reads the next sequential authorization record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search the Authorization Detail records in the IMS database for the record matching the saved authorization key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The page-forward loading loop is executing to populate up to 5 authorization rows on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The current row index is 1 (first row) AND the key pressed was PF7 (backward navigation)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs the reposition operation (REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS) to position the cursor at the saved authorization key before reading; for all other row iterations or when any key other than PF7 was pressed, the system reads the next sequential authorization record (GET-AUTHORIZATIONS) without repositioning

key_functionalities.title: Next Page Availability Check
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([After Current Page of 5 Records is Filled])
    B{Were all 5 records\nretrieved successfully\nwithout errors?}
    C[Attempt to Read\nOne Additional Record\nBeyond Current Page]
    D{Was an additional\nrecord found?}
    E[Set Next Page Indicator = YES\nMore authorization records\nare available]
    F[Set Next Page Indicator = NO\nCurrent page is the\nlast page]
    G[No peek needed -\nFewer than 5 records\nwere available]
    H([Next Page Availability\nDetermined])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Page fully populated| C
    B -->|No - Page partially filled\nor error occurred| G
    C --> D
    D -->|Record found| E
    D -->|No more records| F
    E --> H
    F --> H
    G --> H

rules.rule_name: Determine Eligibility to Peek for Next Page
rules.rule_description: After attempting to populate the current page with up to 5 authorization records, the system evaluates whether the page was fully and successfully populated before attempting to look ahead for additional records. A peek is only performed if all 5 records were retrieved without reaching the end of available data and without any processing errors.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Were all 5 records retrieved successfully without errors?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed the process of loading the current page of pending authorization records for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether all 5 authorization records were retrieved successfully — meaning the end-of-data indicator is NOT set AND the error flag is NOT set
acceptance_criteria.Then: If both conditions are met (no end-of-data and no error), the system proceeds to attempt reading one additional authorization record beyond the current page to determine if more records exist; otherwise, no peek attempt is made and next-page availability is left undetermined

rules.rule_name: Peek at Next Authorization Record Beyond Current Page
rules.rule_description: When the current page has been fully populated with 5 authorization records without errors, the system reads one additional authorization record from the pending authorizations data store. This read is solely to determine whether more records exist beyond the current page and does not display the record to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Attempt to Read One Additional Record Beyond Current Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current page of 5 pending authorization records has been fully populated without reaching end-of-data and without any errors
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the next sequential pending authorization record (PAUTDTL1 segment) for the account using a Get Next within Parent (GNP) database call
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system receives either a successful record retrieval (setting the not-end-of-data indicator) or an end-of-data/not-found response (setting the end-of-data indicator), which is then used to determine next-page availability

rules.rule_name: Set Next Page Indicator to YES When Additional Records Exist
rules.rule_description: After peeking at the record beyond the current page, if an additional authorization record is successfully found, the system marks that a next page of authorization records is available. This enables the PF8 (page forward) navigation option for the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Next Page Indicator = YES
More authorization records
are available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read one authorization record beyond the 5 records displayed on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The additional record is found successfully — meaning the end-of-data indicator is NOT set AND the error flag is NOT set after the peek read
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Next Page Indicator to YES, signaling that more pending authorization records are available and that the user may navigate forward to the next page using PF8

rules.rule_name: Set Next Page Indicator to NO When No Additional Records Exist
rules.rule_description: After peeking at the record beyond the current page, if no additional authorization record is found (end of available data is reached), the system marks that no further pages exist. This disables the PF8 (page forward) navigation option and informs the user they are on the last page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Next Page Indicator = NO
Current page is the
last page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read one authorization record beyond the 5 records displayed on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: No additional record is found — meaning the end-of-data indicator IS set OR the error flag IS set after the peek read
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Next Page Indicator to NO, signaling that the current page is the last page of pending authorization records and that PF8 forward navigation is not available; if the user attempts PF8, the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' is displayed

rules.rule_name: Skip Next Page Peek When Page is Partially Filled or Has Errors
rules.rule_description: If the current page was not fully populated with 5 records — either because the end of available authorization data was reached during page loading or because an error occurred — the system does not attempt to peek at an additional record. In this case, the current page is implicitly the last page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No peek needed -
Fewer than 5 records
were available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed the loop to load up to 5 pending authorization records onto the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The end-of-data indicator IS set (fewer than 5 records were available) OR the error flag IS set (a processing error occurred during page loading)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips the peek read entirely and does not attempt to retrieve any additional record; the Next Page Indicator remains unchanged (effectively indicating no further pages are available), and no 'next page exists' signal is set

key_functionalities.title: Page Key Tracking
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Loading Authorization Records\nfor Current Page])
    B{Is this the\n2nd record being\nloaded for this page?\nWS-IDX = 2}
    C[Increment Page Counter\nby 1]
    D[Save the Authorization Key of the\n1st Record on this Page into\nPage-Key History Array\nat current page number position]
    E[Continue Loading\nRemaining Records\nfor Current Page]
    F([Page Key Successfully\nTracked for Backward Navigation])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - 2nd record confirms\na new page has started| C
    C --> D
    D --> F
    F --> E
    B -->|No - Still on 1st record\nor beyond 2nd| E

rules.rule_name: Detect New Page Start When Second Authorization Record Is Loaded
rules.rule_description: When loading authorization records for display, the system must detect when a new page has been confirmed as started. A new page is confirmed only when the second authorization record for that page is successfully loaded, as the first record alone is insufficient to confirm a full page transition.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this the 2nd record being loaded for this page? WS-IDX = 2

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is in the process of loading authorization records for the current page, and a row index counter (WS-IDX) is being used to track how many records have been loaded so far for the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The row index counter equals 2, meaning the second authorization record for the current page has just been successfully retrieved and is ready to be populated on screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system confirms that a new page has started and proceeds to increment the page counter and save the page navigation key; if the row index is not equal to 2 (i.e., it is the 1st record or the 3rd through 5th record), no page tracking action is taken and loading continues normally

rules.rule_name: Increment Page Counter When New Authorization Page Is Confirmed
rules.rule_description: When the second authorization record on a new page is confirmed as loaded, the system must increment the current page number by 1 to accurately reflect the page the user is now viewing. This page number is used for display context and to control backward navigation boundaries.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Increment Page Counter by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has confirmed that the second authorization record for the current page has been successfully loaded (row index WS-IDX equals 2), and the current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) holds the page number of the previously completed page
acceptance_criteria.When: The new page confirmation condition is met (WS-IDX = 2)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The page counter (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is incremented by exactly 1, so that it now reflects the current page number being displayed to the user

rules.rule_name: Save Authorization Key of Current Page Into Page-Key History for Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: To enable accurate backward navigation (PF7), the system must record the authorization key associated with the start of each page into a page-key history array. This key is stored at the position corresponding to the current page number, allowing the system to reposition to the correct starting record when the user navigates back to a previously viewed page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save the Authorization Key of the 1st Record on this Page into Page-Key History Array at current page number position

acceptance_criteria.Given: The page counter (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) has just been incremented to reflect the current page number, and the second authorization record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) for the current page has been successfully retrieved from the Pending Authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The row index equals 2 and the page counter has been updated to the current page number
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization key of the record being processed (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved into the page-key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG) at the index position equal to the current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM), so that when the user presses PF7 to navigate backward, the system can retrieve this key and reposition the authorization list to the correct starting record for that page

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Approved Amount for Display
rules.rule_description: When populating an authorization record row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen, the approved amount from the authorization record must be prepared for display by moving it into the display-formatted amount field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Amount for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved from the authorization database and contains an approved amount value in the field PA-APPROVED-AMT
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is populating a row on the Pending Authorization Summary list screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The approved amount from the authorization record (PA-APPROVED-AMT) is moved into the working storage display amount field (WS-AUTH-AMT) so it is ready to be placed into the appropriate screen row amount field

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Time from HHMMSS to HH:MM:SS
rules.rule_description: The raw authorization origination time stored in the database is in HHMMSS format (6 characters, no separators). Before displaying on screen, it must be reformatted into HH:MM:SS format with colon separators for business readability.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Time: Extract HH, MM, SS from raw HHMMSS into HH:MM:SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and contains an origination time (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) stored as a 6-character string in HHMMSS format (positions 1-2 = hours, positions 3-4 = minutes, positions 5-6 = seconds)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the authorization time for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The hours portion (characters 1-2 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) is placed into positions 1-2 of WS-AUTH-TIME, the minutes portion (characters 3-4 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) is placed into positions 4-5 of WS-AUTH-TIME, and the seconds portion (characters 5-6 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) is placed into positions 7-8 of WS-AUTH-TIME, resulting in a display time formatted as HH:MM:SS

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Date from YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY
rules.rule_description: The raw authorization origination date stored in the database is in YYMMDD format (6 characters, no separators). Before displaying on screen, it must be reformatted into MM/DD/YY format with slash separators for business readability.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Date: Extract YY, MM, DD from raw YYMMDD into MM/DD/YY

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and contains an origination date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) stored as a 6-character string in YYMMDD format (positions 1-2 = year, positions 3-4 = month, positions 5-6 = day)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the authorization date for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The year portion (characters 1-2 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) is placed into WS-CURDATE-YY, the month portion (characters 3-4 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) is placed into WS-CURDATE-MM, the day portion (characters 5-6 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) is placed into WS-CURDATE-DD, and the combined formatted date field WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY (which assembles these components as MM/DD/YY) is then moved into WS-AUTH-DATE for display

rules.rule_name: Determine Authorization Approval Status as Approved or Declined
rules.rule_description: Each authorization record carries a response code that indicates whether the authorization was approved or declined. The system must translate this response code into a single-character business status indicator ('A' for Approved, 'D' for Declined) for display on the summary list screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Response Code = '00'?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and contains an authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code to determine the approval status
acceptance_criteria.Then: If PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals '00', the approval status indicator (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is set to 'A' meaning the authorization was Approved; if PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE is any value other than '00', the approval status indicator (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is set to 'D' meaning the authorization was Declined

rules.rule_name: Populate Authorization List Row 1 with Authorization Details
rules.rule_description: When the current row index is 1, the first row of the Pending Authorization Summary list must be populated with all relevant authorization details from the retrieved record, and the selection field for that row must be made available for user input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Row 1: Populate Transaction ID / Date / Time / Auth Type / Approval Status / Match Status / Amount / Enable Selection Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, all display fields (amount, date, time, approval status) have been formatted, and the current row index (WS-IDX) is 1
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization list row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved to CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(1) for later selection processing; Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) is placed into TRNID01I; formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE) is placed into PDATE01I; formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is placed into PTIME01I; authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) is placed into PTYPE01I; approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is placed into PAPRV01I; match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) is placed into PSTAT01I; approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT) is placed into PAMT001I; and the selection field (SEL0001A) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) so the user can enter a selection value for this row

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record row (1 through 5) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen has been fully populated with transaction ID, date, time, authorization type, approval status, match status, and amount

acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field attribute for that row (SEL0001A through SEL0005A corresponding to the row number) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP), meaning the field becomes editable and the user is able to type a selection value (such as 'S') next to that authorization record to select it for further action

key_functionalities.title: Authorization Date and Time Formatting

rules.rule_name: Extract Year Component from Raw Authorization Date
rules.rule_description: The system extracts the two-digit year from the raw authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format to prepare it for display formatting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Year digits
Positions 1-2 of raw date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination date stored in YYMMDD format (e.g., '240315' representing year 24, month 03, day 15)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the first two characters (positions 1-2) of the raw authorization origination date field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit year value (e.g., '24') is placed into the year component of the display date working field (WS-CURDATE-YY), making it available for assembly into the final MM/DD/YY display format

rules.rule_name: Extract Month Component from Raw Authorization Date
rules.rule_description: The system extracts the two-digit month from the raw authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format to prepare it for display formatting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Month digits
Positions 3-4 of raw date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination date stored in YYMMDD format (e.g., '240315' representing year 24, month 03, day 15)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 3-4 of the raw authorization origination date field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit month value (e.g., '03') is placed into the month component of the display date working field (WS-CURDATE-MM), making it available for assembly into the final MM/DD/YY display format

rules.rule_name: Extract Day Component from Raw Authorization Date
rules.rule_description: The system extracts the two-digit day from the raw authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format to prepare it for display formatting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Day digits
Positions 5-6 of raw date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination date stored in YYMMDD format (e.g., '240315' representing year 24, month 03, day 15)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 5-6 of the raw authorization origination date field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit day value (e.g., '15') is placed into the day component of the display date working field (WS-CURDATE-DD), making it available for assembly into the final MM/DD/YY display format

rules.rule_name: Assemble Authorization Date into MM/DD/YY Display Format
rules.rule_description: After extracting the individual year, month, and day components from the raw YYMMDD date, the system assembles them into the standard MM/DD/YY display format for presentation on the authorization list screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Assemble Display Date
as MM/DD/YY format

acceptance_criteria.Given: The year (WS-CURDATE-YY), month (WS-CURDATE-MM), and day (WS-CURDATE-DD) components have been individually extracted from the raw authorization origination date
acceptance_criteria.When: The system assembles the three date components using the pre-structured display date field (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) which arranges them in MM/DD/YY order
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fully formatted display date (e.g., '03/15/24') is stored in the authorization display date field (WS-AUTH-DATE) and is ready to be shown on the Pending Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Extract Hours Component from Raw Authorization Time
rules.rule_description: The system extracts the two-digit hours value from the raw authorization origination time stored in HHMMSS format and places it at the beginning of the display time field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Hours digits
Positions 1-2 of raw time
Place at display positions 1-2

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination time stored in HHMMSS format (e.g., '143022' representing 14 hours, 30 minutes, 22 seconds)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the first two characters (positions 1-2) of the raw authorization origination time field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit hours value (e.g., '14') is placed at display positions 1-2 of the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), forming the hours portion of the HH:MM:SS formatted time

rules.rule_name: Extract Minutes Component from Raw Authorization Time
rules.rule_description: The system extracts the two-digit minutes value from the raw authorization origination time stored in HHMMSS format and places it at display positions 4-5, after the first colon separator in the HH:MM:SS format.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Minutes digits
Positions 3-4 of raw time
Place at display positions 4-5
behind colon separator

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination time stored in HHMMSS format (e.g., '143022' representing 14 hours, 30 minutes, 22 seconds)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 3-4 of the raw authorization origination time field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit minutes value (e.g., '30') is placed at display positions 4-5 of the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), positioned after the first colon separator, forming the minutes portion of the HH:MM:SS formatted time (e.g., 'HH:30:SS')

rules.rule_name: Extract Seconds Component from Raw Authorization Time
rules.rule_description: The system extracts the two-digit seconds value from the raw authorization origination time stored in HHMMSS format and places it at display positions 7-8, after the second colon separator in the HH:MM:SS format.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Seconds digits
Positions 5-6 of raw time
Place at display positions 7-8
behind colon separator

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination time stored in HHMMSS format (e.g., '143022' representing 14 hours, 30 minutes, 22 seconds)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 5-6 of the raw authorization origination time field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit seconds value (e.g., '22') is placed at display positions 7-8 of the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), positioned after the second colon separator, forming the seconds portion of the HH:MM:SS formatted time (e.g., 'HH:MM:22')

rules.rule_name: Assembled Authorization Time in HH:MM:SS Display Format
rules.rule_description: After placing hours at positions 1-2, minutes at positions 4-5, and seconds at positions 7-8 of the display time field, the authorization time is fully assembled in HH:MM:SS format with colon separators at positions 3 and 6, ready for screen display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Assembled Display Time
formatted as HH:MM:SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: The hours, minutes, and seconds components have been individually extracted from the raw HHMMSS authorization origination time and placed into their respective positions within the display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), with colon separators pre-existing at positions 3 and 6 of the display field
acceptance_criteria.When: All three time components (hours at positions 1-2, minutes at positions 4-5, seconds at positions 7-8) have been moved into the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fully formatted display time (e.g., '14:30:22') is available in WS-AUTH-TIME and is ready to be shown on the Pending Authorization Summary screen alongside the corresponding authorization record

key_functionalities.title: Approval Status Derivation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Derive Approval Status\nfor Authorization Record])
    B[Read Authorization Response Code\nfrom Authorization Record]
    C{Is Response\nCode = '00'?}
    D[Set Display Status\nto 'A' = Approved]
    E[Set Display Status\nto 'D' = Declined]
    F([End: Status Indicator Set\nfor Display on Screen])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C -->|Yes - Response Code is 00| D
    C -->|No - Any other Response Code| E
    D --> F
    E --> F

rules.rule_name: Derive Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
rules.rule_description: When populating the authorization list for display, the system must determine and set the approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the pending authorization details. A response code of '00' indicates the authorization was approved; any other response code indicates the authorization was declined. The resulting status indicator ('A' or 'D') is then displayed on the Authorization Summary List screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Approval Status Derivation - Determine whether an authorization is Approved (response code '00') or Declined (any other response code) and set the display status indicator accordingly.

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved from the Pending Authorization Details data store and the Authorization Response Code field (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is available for evaluation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the Authorization Response Code to determine the outcome of the authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Authorization Response Code equals '00', the system sets the Approval Status display indicator to 'A' (Approved); if the Authorization Response Code is any value other than '00', the system sets the Approval Status display indicator to 'D' (Declined); the resulting status indicator is then populated into the corresponding row on the Authorization Summary List screen for user display

key_functionalities.title: Return to Main Menu (PF3)
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF3])
    B[Set Destination to\nMain Menu Program\nCOMEN01C]
    C{Main Menu Program\nName Valid?}
    D[Default to Sign-On\nProgram COSGN00C]
    E[Record Current Program\nas the Originating Program\nAuthorization Summary Screen]
    F[Transfer Control to\nMain Menu Program\nwith Session Information]
    G([Main Menu Screen Displayed])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C -->|Program name is blank| D
    C -->|Program name is set| E
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G

rules.rule_name: Set Destination to Main Menu Program on PF3
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Authorization Summary screen, the system sets the intended destination program to the Main Menu program so that navigation can proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Destination to Main Menu Program COMEN01C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Main Menu program (COMEN01C) as the target for navigation

rules.rule_name: Default to Sign-On Program When Main Menu Program Name is Not Set
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control, the system validates that the destination program name is populated. If the destination program name is blank or not set, the system defaults the destination to the Sign-On program to ensure the user is always navigated to a valid screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Default to Sign-On Program COSGN00C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 to return to the previous screen and the system is preparing to transfer control
acceptance_criteria.When: The destination program name is blank or contains no value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system overrides the destination and sets it to the Sign-On program (COSGN00C) as the fallback navigation target

rules.rule_name: Record Authorization Summary Screen as the Originating Program
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control to the destination program, the system records the current Authorization Summary screen as the originating program in the session information. This allows the destination program to know where the navigation originated from and enables return navigation if needed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Current Program as the Originating Program Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and the destination program has been determined (either Main Menu or Sign-On as fallback)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is preparing to transfer control to the destination program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the Authorization Summary program name as the originating program in the session data, and resets the program context to zero, so the destination program knows which screen initiated the navigation

rules.rule_name: Transfer Control to Destination Program with Session Information
rules.rule_description: After setting the destination and recording the originating program, the system transfers full control to the destination program (Main Menu or Sign-On fallback), passing along the complete session information so that user context, account data, and navigation history are preserved across the screen transition.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer Control to Main Menu Program with Session Information

acceptance_criteria.Given: The destination program has been set to Main Menu (or Sign-On as fallback) and the current Authorization Summary screen has been recorded as the originating program in the session data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the navigation transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system transfers complete control to the destination program and passes the full session information (including account ID, card number, customer ID, originating program name, and transaction ID) so the destination screen is displayed with all relevant context intact

key_functionalities.title: Invalid Key Handling
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses a Function Key])
    B{Is key ENTER,\nPF3, PF7, or PF8?}
    C[Set Error Flag]
    D[Set Error Message:\nInvalid Key Pressed]
    E[Redisplay Authorization\nSummary Screen with\nError Message]
    F([Continue Normal\nProcessing])

    A --> B
    B -->|No - Unsupported Key| C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    B -->|Yes - Supported Key| F

rules.rule_name: Supported Function Key Identification
rules.rule_description: The Authorization Summary screen only accepts four specific function keys: ENTER, PF3, PF7, and PF8. Any other key pressed by the user is considered unsupported and triggers error handling.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is key ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and has pressed a function key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the key pressed against the list of supported keys: ENTER (submit/search), PF3 (return to menu), PF7 (page backward), and PF8 (page forward)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the key is one of ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8, the system proceeds with the corresponding normal processing; if the key is any other key, the system routes to invalid key error handling

rules.rule_name: Invalid Key Error Flag Activation
rules.rule_description: When a user presses an unsupported function key on the Pending Authorization Summary screen, the system activates an error condition flag to indicate that an invalid action was attempted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Flag

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag (WS-ERR-FLG) to 'Y' to indicate an error condition is active, and positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field

rules.rule_name: Invalid Key Error Message Assignment
rules.rule_description: When an unsupported function key is pressed, the system assigns a standardized invalid key error message to be displayed to the user on the Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Invalid Key Pressed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed an unsupported function key on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the error flag has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the error message for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system assigns the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) to the screen message field (WS-MESSAGE), which will be shown in the error message area of the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Screen Redisplay with Invalid Key Error
rules.rule_description: After detecting an unsupported key press, the system redisplays the Pending Authorization Summary screen with the error message visible, preserving all previously displayed account and authorization data so the user can take a valid action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Redisplay Authorization Summary Screen with Error Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed an unsupported function key, the error flag is set to 'Y', and the invalid key error message has been assigned to the message field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen back to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system redisplays the Pending Authorization Summary screen (MAP COPAU0A, MAPSET COPAU00) with the invalid key error message shown in the error message area, the cursor positioned on the Account ID field, and all previously displayed account summary and authorization list data retained on the screen; the screen is sent without a full erase so existing data is preserved

key_functionalities.title: Screen Header Population
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Screen Header Population])
    B[Retrieve Current System\nDate and Time]
    C[Set Application Title\nLines on Screen Header]
    D[Set Transaction ID\non Screen Header]
    E[Set Program Name\non Screen Header]
    F[Format Current Date\nas MM/DD/YY]
    G[Set Formatted Date\non Screen Header]
    H[Format Current Time\nas HH:MM:SS]
    I[Set Formatted Time\non Screen Header]
    J([End: Header Ready\nfor Screen Display])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H
    H --> I
    I --> J

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Screen Header
rules.rule_description: Before populating the screen header, the system retrieves the current system date and time to ensure the header reflects the real-time values at the moment the screen is sent to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current System Date and Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Pending Authorization Summary screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen header population process is triggered
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current system date and time using the built-in current date function and stores it in the working storage date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA) for subsequent formatting and display

rules.rule_name: Set Application Title Lines on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The screen header must display the standard application title lines (Title Line 1 and Title Line 2) sourced from the centrally defined application constants, ensuring consistent branding across all screens.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Application Title Lines on Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has retrieved the current date and time and is populating the screen header
acceptance_criteria.When: The application title fields on the screen header are being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets Title Line 1 (TITLE01O) on the screen header from the application-defined constant CCDA-TITLE01, and sets Title Line 2 (TITLE02O) on the screen header from the application-defined constant CCDA-TITLE02

rules.rule_name: Set Transaction ID on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The screen header must display the current CICS transaction identifier so that users and support staff can identify the active transaction associated with the displayed screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction ID on Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating the screen header for the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction identifier field on the screen header is being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Transaction Name field (TRNNAMEO) on the screen header to the current CICS transaction ID (WS-CICS-TRANID)

rules.rule_name: Set Program Name on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The screen header must display the name of the currently executing program so that users and support staff can identify which program is serving the current screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Program Name on Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating the screen header for the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The program name field on the screen header is being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Program Name field (PGMNAMEO) on the screen header to the Authorization Summary program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY)

rules.rule_name: Format Current Date as MM/DD/YY for Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The current date retrieved from the system must be reformatted into the standard MM/DD/YY display format before being placed on the screen header. The year component uses only the last two digits of the four-digit year.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Current Date as MM/DD/YY

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has retrieved the current system date stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA containing month (WS-CURDATE-MONTH), day (WS-CURDATE-DAY), and four-digit year (WS-CURDATE-YEAR)
acceptance_criteria.When: The current date is being formatted for display on the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the month into WS-CURDATE-MM, the day into WS-CURDATE-DD, and the last two digits of the year (positions 3 and 4 of WS-CURDATE-YEAR) into WS-CURDATE-YY, composing the date in MM/DD/YY format stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY

rules.rule_name: Set Formatted Date on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: After formatting the current date into MM/DD/YY format, the system places the formatted date value into the designated date display field on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Formatted Date on Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current date has been formatted into MM/DD/YY format and stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY
acceptance_criteria.When: The date field on the screen header is being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Current Date field (CURDATEO) on the screen header to the formatted date value from WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY

rules.rule_name: Format Current Time as HH:MM:SS for Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The current time retrieved from the system must be reformatted into the standard HH:MM:SS display format before being placed on the screen header, extracting hours, minutes, and seconds into separate components.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Current Time as HH:MM:SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has retrieved the current system time stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA containing hours (WS-CURTIME-HOURS), minutes (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE), and seconds (WS-CURTIME-SECOND)
acceptance_criteria.When: The current time is being formatted for display on the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the hours into WS-CURTIME-HH, the minutes into WS-CURTIME-MM, and the seconds into WS-CURTIME-SS, composing the time in HH:MM:SS format stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS

rules.rule_name: Set Formatted Time on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: After formatting the current time into HH:MM:SS format, the system places the formatted time value into the designated time display field on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Formatted Time on Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current time has been formatted into HH:MM:SS format and stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS
acceptance_criteria.When: The time field on the screen header is being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Current Time field (CURTIMEO) on the screen header to the formatted time value from WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS

rules.rule_name: Invoke Screen Header Population Before Every Screen Send
rules.rule_description: The screen header population routine must be invoked every time the Pending Authorization Summary screen is sent to the user, ensuring that the header always reflects the most current date, time, transaction, and program information at the moment of display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current System Date and Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Pending Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A) to the user under any condition — whether it is an initial display, a response to ENTER, PF3, PF7, PF8, or an error condition
acceptance_criteria.When: The SEND-PAULST-SCREEN routine is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system always invokes the POPULATE-HEADER-INFO routine as the first step before sending the screen, ensuring the header fields (application title, transaction ID, program name, current date in MM/DD/YY, and current time in HH:MM:SS) are refreshed with current values on every screen send

rules.rule_name: Populate Screen Header with Application Identification and Current Date/Time
rules.rule_description: Before sending the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal, the system populates the screen header area with the application titles, the current transaction identifier, the program name, and the current system date and time formatted for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Screen Header Application Title Transaction ID Program Name Current Date & Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen header population routine is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen header must be populated with: (1) Application Title Line 1 from the application title constant (CCDA-TITLE01) displayed in the first title field, (2) Application Title Line 2 from the application title constant (CCDA-TITLE02) displayed in the second title field, (3) the current Transaction ID displayed in the transaction name field, (4) the Authorization Summary Program Name displayed in the program name field, (5) the current system date formatted as MM/DD/YY displayed in the current date field, and (6) the current system time formatted as HH:MM:SS displayed in the current time field

rules.rule_name: Display Current System Message in Screen Message Area
rules.rule_description: Before sending the Authorization Summary screen, the system moves the current working message (which may contain validation errors, informational messages, or be blank) into the screen's designated message/error display area so the user can see relevant feedback.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Move Current Message to Screen Message Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has a current message stored in the working message field (WS-MESSAGE), which may contain an error message such as 'Please enter Acct Id...', 'Acct Id must be Numeric...', 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S', 'You are already at the top of the page...', 'You are already at the bottom of the page...', 'Invalid key', or may be blank spaces
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to send the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The content of the current working message field is transferred to the screen error/message output field (ERRMSGO), so that the message is visible to the user on the displayed screen

rules.rule_name: Send Authorization Summary Screen with Full Erase on First Display
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary screen is being displayed for the first time in a session, or when the user navigates to this screen from another program, the system sends the screen using a full erase command that completely clears the terminal before rendering the new screen content.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Screen with Full Erase Clears entire terminal screen before displaying

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary screen is ready to be sent to the user terminal, AND the display mode is set to 'First Display' (SEND-ERASE-YES), which occurs in the following situations: (1) the very first time the screen is accessed with no prior session data, (2) the first re-entry into this program when called from another program with a valid account ID already loaded
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is transmitted to the terminal using a full ERASE command, which completely clears the entire terminal screen before displaying the Authorization Summary screen content, with the cursor positioned at the Account ID input field

rules.rule_name: Send Authorization Summary Screen as Overlay on Subsequent Displays
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary screen is being refreshed due to user interaction such as pagination (PF7 backward or PF8 forward navigation) or re-entry after prior display, the system sends the screen as an overlay that updates only the changed fields over the existing terminal screen, without clearing the entire screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Screen as Overlay Updates changed fields over existing screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary screen is ready to be sent to the user terminal, AND the display mode is set to 'Overlay' (SEND-ERASE-NO), which occurs in the following situations: (1) the user pressed PF7 to navigate to the previous page of authorizations, (2) the user pressed PF8 to navigate to the next page of authorizations
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is transmitted to the terminal without a full ERASE command, updating only the changed fields over the existing screen content (overlay mode), with the cursor positioned at the Account ID input field

rules.rule_name: Look Up Account in Card Cross-Reference File
rules.rule_description: When account details are requested, the system must first locate the account in the Card Cross-Reference file using the entered Account ID to retrieve the associated Customer ID and Card Number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Look up Account ID in Card Cross-Reference File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the account details lookup process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system searches the Card Cross-Reference file using the entered Account ID as the search key to retrieve the associated Customer ID and Card Number

rules.rule_name: Account Not Found in Card Cross-Reference File
rules.rule_description: When the entered Account ID does not exist in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system must notify the user with a descriptive message identifying the Account ID that was not found and stop further processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Not Found Notification - Display a descriptive message to the user when the entered account ID is not found in the card cross-reference, account, or customer files.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered an Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the system has searched the Card Cross-Reference file
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Card Cross-Reference file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Account: [Account ID] not found in XREF file' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account detail retrieval

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Customer ID and Card Number from Cross-Reference
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system retrieves and stores the associated Customer ID and Card Number for use in subsequent lookups.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Customer ID and Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Card Cross-Reference file using the entered Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is found in the Card Cross-Reference file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves and stores the Customer ID (XREF-CUST-ID) and Card Number (XREF-CARD-NUM) from the cross-reference record for use in subsequent account and customer data lookups

rules.rule_name: Look Up Account in Account Master File
rules.rule_description: After successfully retrieving the Customer ID and Card Number from the Card Cross-Reference file, the system must look up the account in the Account Master file to retrieve financial details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Look up Account ID in Account Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully retrieved the Customer ID and Card Number from the Card Cross-Reference file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system proceeds to retrieve account financial details
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system searches the Account Master file using the Account ID from the cross-reference record (XREF-ACCT-ID) as the search key

rules.rule_name: Account Not Found in Account Master File
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID does not exist in the Account Master file, the system must notify the user with a descriptive message identifying the Account ID that was not found and stop further processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: Account not found in Account Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Account Master file using the Account ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Account Master file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Account: [Account ID] not found in ACCT file' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account detail retrieval

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit from Account Master
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Account Master file, the system retrieves the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit to display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Account Master file using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is found in the Account Master file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Credit Limit (ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT) and Cash Credit Limit (ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT) from the account record and prepares them for display on the summary screen

rules.rule_name: Look Up Customer in Customer Master File
rules.rule_description: After successfully retrieving account financial details, the system must look up the customer in the Customer Master file using the Customer ID obtained from the Card Cross-Reference to retrieve personal details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Look up Customer ID in Customer Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully retrieved the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit from the Account Master file and has the Customer ID from the Card Cross-Reference record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system proceeds to retrieve customer personal details
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system searches the Customer Master file using the Customer ID (XREF-CUST-ID) from the cross-reference record as the search key

rules.rule_name: Customer Not Found in Customer Master File
rules.rule_description: When the Customer ID does not exist in the Customer Master file, the system must notify the user with a descriptive message identifying the Customer ID that was not found and stop further processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: Customer not found in Customer Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Customer Master file using the Customer ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Customer ID is not found in the Customer Master file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Customer: [Customer ID] not found in CUST file' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account detail retrieval

rules.rule_name: Retrieve and Format Customer Name, Address, and Phone Number
rules.rule_description: When the Customer ID is successfully found in the Customer Master file, the system retrieves and formats the customer's full name, address lines, and phone number for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Customer Name, Address, and Phone Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully found the customer record in the Customer Master file using the Customer ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system retrieves customer personal details
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system formats and prepares the following for display: (1) Customer ID, (2) Full name composed of First Name, Middle Name initial, and Last Name separated by spaces, (3) Address Line 1 combined with Address Line 2 separated by a comma, (4) Address Line 3 combined with State Code and first 5 digits of ZIP code each separated by commas, and (5) Primary Phone Number

rules.rule_name: Sequential Account Details Lookup Process
rules.rule_description: The account details lookup must follow a strict sequential order: Card Cross-Reference lookup first, then Account Master lookup, then Customer Master lookup. Each step depends on the successful completion of the prior step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Start: Account Details Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the account details lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must execute the lookups in the following mandatory sequence: (1) Look up Account ID in Card Cross-Reference file to get Customer ID and Card Number, (2) Look up Account ID in Account Master file to get Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit, (3) Look up Customer ID in Customer Master file to get Name, Address, and Phone — and if any step fails with a 'not found' condition, the system stops processing and displays the appropriate not-found message without proceeding to the next step

rules.rule_name: Determine Authorization Summary Display Based on Record Existence
rules.rule_description: After retrieving account details, the system checks whether a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the given account. Based on this check, the system either displays actual summary values or defaults all fields to zero.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Pending Authorization Summary Segment Found for Account?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed retrieval of account, customer, and card cross-reference details for a given Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether a Pending Authorization Summary segment exists for the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a Pending Authorization Summary segment is found, the system proceeds to display actual authorization counts, balances, and amounts from that record; if no summary segment is found, the system proceeds to display zero values for all authorization summary fields

rules.rule_name: Display Approved Authorization Count from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the count of approved authorizations sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Approved Authorization Count

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count field on the screen (APPRCNTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT

rules.rule_name: Display Declined Authorization Count from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the count of declined authorizations sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Declined Authorization Count

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count field on the screen (DECLCNTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT

rules.rule_name: Display Current Credit Balance from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the current credit balance sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-CREDIT-BALANCE.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Current Credit Balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Credit Balance field on the screen (CREDBALO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-CREDIT-BALANCE

rules.rule_name: Display Current Cash Balance from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the current cash balance sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-CASH-BALANCE.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Current Cash Balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Cash Balance field on the screen (CASHBALO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-CASH-BALANCE

rules.rule_name: Display Total Approved Authorization Amount from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the total approved authorization amount sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Total Approved Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Total Approved Authorization Amount field on the screen (APPRAMTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT

rules.rule_name: Display Total Declined Authorization Amount from Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the total declined authorization amount sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Total Declined Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Total Declined Authorization Amount field on the screen (DECLAMTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT

rules.rule_name: Default All Authorization Summary Fields to Zero When No Summary Record Exists
rules.rule_description: When no Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system defaults all six authorization summary display fields to zero, ensuring the screen does not show blank or misleading values for counts, balances, and amounts.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Authorization Summary Not Found Handling - When no pending authorization summary segment exists for the account, display zero values for all authorization counts, amounts, and balances.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed retrieval of account, customer, and card cross-reference details for a given Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: No Pending Authorization Summary segment is found for the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: All six authorization summary fields on the screen are set to zero: Approved Authorization Count (APPRCNTO) = 0, Declined Authorization Count (DECLCNTO) = 0, Current Credit Balance (CREDBALO) = 0, Current Cash Balance (CASHBALO) = 0, Total Approved Authorization Amount (APPRAMTO) = 0, and Total Declined Authorization Amount (DECLAMTO) = 0

key_functionalities.title: Session State Persistence
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD

    C[User Entered Account ID\nand Browsed Records]

    F[Save Last Authorization Key\nRecord the key of the last\nauthorization displayed on\ncurrent page]

    I --> J
    J --> R

    B -->|PF8 Forward| K
    K --> L
    L --> M
    M --> R

    B -->|PF7 Backward| N
    N --> O
    O --> P
    P --> Q
    Q --> R

    R --> S
    S --> END

rules.rule_name: Increment Page Number When Loading Authorization Records
rules.rule_description: When loading authorization records onto the screen, the system increments the page counter when the second record of a new page is populated, ensuring the page number accurately reflects the current page being viewed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Save Current Page Number
Increment page counter as
user moves through records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records onto the screen in PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, and the row index (WS-IDX) has just been incremented to 2 after populating the first record of a new page
acceptance_criteria.When: The second authorization record is about to be populated (WS-IDX equals 2) and no errors have occurred and records are still available
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is incremented by 1 to reflect that a new page of authorization records is now being displayed to the user

rules.rule_name: Save First Authorization Key of Each Page for Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the second authorization record on a page is populated (confirming a new page has started), the system saves the authorization key of the first record of that page into the page key history, enabling the user to navigate backward to any previously visited page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Save Page Key History
Store first authorization key
of each page visited to
enable backward navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records in PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, the row index (WS-IDX) equals 2, and the page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) has just been incremented
acceptance_criteria.When: The first authorization record of the new page has been successfully retrieved and its key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is available
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization key of the first record on this page is stored in the page key history array at the position corresponding to the current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM), making it available for backward navigation via PF7

rules.rule_name: Save Last Authorization Key Displayed on Current Page
rules.rule_description: As each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the system continuously updates the last authorization key tracker with the key of the most recently displayed record, so that forward pagination can resume from the correct position.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Save Last Authorization Key
Record the key of the last
authorization displayed on
current page
