all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid 'S' selection is confirmed, the system designates the Authorization Detail program as the next program to receive control, enabling the user to view the full details of the selected authorization record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has confirmed a valid 'S' selection and has set the Authorization Detail program as the destination
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the session communication area for the program transfer
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the current transaction identifier (WS-CICS-TRANID) as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the Authorization Summary program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY) as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), sets the program context to zero (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 0), and sets the program entry status flag to indicate a fresh entry (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER = TRUE) in the shared communication area.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Authorization Summary as the Originating Program in Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before transferring to the Authorization Detail screen, the system records the current Authorization Summary program and transaction as the originating source in the shared session communication area. This enables the Authorization Detail screen to know where to return control when the user navigates back.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has selected a specific authorization row using 'S', and the corresponding authorization key for that row has been captured into the Selected Authorization Key field (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED) in the shared communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system transfers control to the Authorization Detail program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The shared communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) containing the Selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED), the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM), the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), and the program context is passed in full to the Authorization Detail program, ensuring the correct authorization record is available for display.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pass Selected Authorization Key to Authorization Detail Program
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization key of the row selected by the user is carried forward in the shared session communication area so that the Authorization Detail program can retrieve and display the correct authorization record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The destination program has been set to the Authorization Detail program, the originating program details have been recorded in the communication area, and the selected authorization key has been stored in the shared communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the program transfer
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control is immediately and unconditionally transferred to the Authorization Detail program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) with the full shared communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) passed along, and the Authorization Detail screen is displayed to the user. The Authorization Summary List program is suspended and does not continue processing.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transfer Control to Authorization Detail Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all session data is prepared, the system immediately transfers control to the Authorization Detail program so the user can view the complete details of the selected pending authorization record. This is a direct program-to-program transfer with no return to the Authorization Summary List unless the user explicitly navigates back.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-blank value in one of the selection fields (SEL0001 through SEL0005) on the Authorization Summary List screen, and the entered value is neither 'S' nor 's'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the system evaluates the selection flag value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' on the screen, repositions the cursor to the Account ID field, does not navigate to the Authorization Detail screen, and proceeds to refresh the Authorization Summary List with the current account's data so the user can correct their selection.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Invalid Selection Error Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters a selection value other than 'S' against an authorization row, the system rejects the selection and informs the user of the only valid selection value, keeping the user on the Authorization Summary List screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and presses the ENTER key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field is blank or contains no value (spaces or low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an error condition, displays the error message 'Please enter Acct Id...' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Authorization Summary screen without performing any account lookup or selection processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Blank Validation on ENTER
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER, the system must validate that the Account ID field has been populated before proceeding with any authorization lookup or selection processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen, has entered a non-blank value in the Account ID field, and presses the ENTER key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The entered Account ID value contains non-numeric characters (letters, special characters, or mixed content)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an error condition, clears the internal Account ID working value, displays the error message 'Acct Id must be Numeric ...' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Authorization Summary screen without performing any account lookup or selection processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Numeric Validation on ENTER
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER with a non-blank Account ID, the system must validate that the Account ID contains only numeric characters before proceeding with any account lookup or selection processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and the Authorization Summary screen is displaying up to 5 authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the system evaluates selection fields for rows 1 through 5 sequentially
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies the first row (in order from row 1 to row 5) whose selection field is not blank and not low-values, captures the entered selection flag value and the corresponding authorization key for that row into the session; if no selection field among all 5 rows contains a value, both the selection flag and the selected authorization key are set to spaces and no selection processing occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Row Selection Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a valid Account ID is confirmed, the system evaluates the five authorization row selection fields in order (row 1 through row 5) to determine whether the user has entered a selection value against any displayed authorization record. Only the first non-blank selection field encountered is processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID and has entered a value in one of the five authorization row selection fields (rows 1 to 5)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system identifies the first non-blank selection field among the five rows
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the entered selection flag value from that row into the session selection flag, and stores the authorization key associated with that row (from the internally maintained list of up to 5 authorization keys) into the session selected authorization key field; both values must be non-blank and non-low-values to proceed to selection validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Selection Flag and Authorization Key for Selected Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a selection value is detected in one of the five authorization rows, the system captures both the user-entered selection flag value and the unique authorization key associated with that specific row, storing them in the session for subsequent validation and navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, has entered a selection value in one of the five authorization rows, and both the selection flag and the associated authorization key are non-blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The captured selection flag value is 'S' (uppercase) or 's' (lowercase)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Authorization Detail program, records the current transaction ID as the originating transaction, records the Authorization Summary program as the originating program, sets the program context to zero, sets the program entry flag to indicate a fresh entry, and immediately transfers control to the Authorization Detail program passing the full session communication area including the selected authorization key

all_rules.Rule_Name: Valid Selection Navigates to Authorization Detail Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters 'S' (uppercase or lowercase) as the selection value for an authorization record, the system transfers control to the Authorization Detail program, passing the selected authorization key and full session context, so the user can view the complete details of that authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID, has entered a selection value in one of the five authorization rows, and both the selection flag and the associated authorization key are non-blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The captured selection flag value is any character other than 'S' (uppercase) or 's' (lowercase)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Authorization Summary screen without navigating to any other program; the account details and authorization list are refreshed via the gather details process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Selection Value Error Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters any selection value other than 'S' or 's' for an authorization record, the system rejects the selection and displays a specific error message indicating the only valid selection value, keeping the user on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Authorization Summary screen and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: None of the five authorization row selection fields (rows 1 through 5) contain a non-blank value, resulting in both the selection flag and selected authorization key being set to spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to gather and refresh all account details including customer information, account financials, authorization summary counts and balances, and reloads the first page of authorization records for the entered Account ID, then redisplays the Authorization Summary screen with the refreshed data

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Selection Made - Refresh Authorization Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER with a valid Account ID but without entering any selection value against any of the five displayed authorization rows, the system refreshes the account details and authorization list for the entered Account ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered by the user on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates the account detail gathering process and queries the Card Cross-Reference data store using the entered Account ID as the lookup key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Card Cross-Reference record associated with the Account ID, making the Customer ID and Card Number available for subsequent lookups

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Card Cross-Reference by Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When gathering account details, the system must look up the Card Cross-Reference data store using the entered Account ID to retrieve the associated Customer ID and Card Number before proceeding with further account data retrieval.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered an Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the system has queried the Card Cross-Reference data store
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Card Cross-Reference data store
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays an error message indicating the specific Account ID was not found in the cross-reference, sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account data retrieval — no authorization list is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Not Found in Card Cross-Reference
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the entered Account ID does not exist in the Card Cross-Reference data store, the system must stop the account detail retrieval process and display an informative error message to the user identifying the account that was not found.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID has been found in the Card Cross-Reference data store
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Cross-Reference record is successfully retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts and stores the Customer ID and Card Number from the cross-reference record, making them available for the Account Master and Customer Master lookups

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Customer ID and Card Number from Cross-Reference
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Card Cross-Reference, the system retrieves and stores the associated Customer ID and Card Number from the cross-reference record to be used in subsequent customer and account data lookups.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Customer ID and Card Number have been successfully retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference for the entered Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system queries the Account Master data store using the Account ID as the lookup key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Account Master record containing the account's financial details including Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Account Master Record by Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully retrieving the Customer ID and Card Number from the Card Cross-Reference, the system must read the Account Master record using the Account ID to retrieve financial account details such as Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has queried the Account Master data store using the Account ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Account Master data store
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays an error message indicating the specific Account ID was not found in the Account Master, sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account data retrieval — no authorization list is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Not Found in Account Master
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID does not exist in the Account Master data store, the system must stop the account detail retrieval process and display an informative error message to the user identifying the account that was not found.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Master record has been successfully retrieved for the entered Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the Account Master record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit values from the Account Master record and prepares them for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit from Account Master
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Master record is successfully found, the system retrieves the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit values from the account record to be displayed in the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Master record has been successfully retrieved and the Customer ID was previously obtained from the Card Cross-Reference
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system queries the Customer Master data store using the Customer ID as the lookup key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Customer Master record containing the customer's personal details including name, address lines, state, ZIP code, and phone number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Customer Master Record by Customer ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully retrieving account financial details, the system must read the Customer Master record using the Customer ID obtained from the Card Cross-Reference to retrieve customer personal information including name, address, and phone number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has queried the Customer Master data store using the Customer ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Customer ID is not found in the Customer Master data store
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays an error message indicating the specific Customer ID was not found in the Customer Master, sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account data retrieval — no authorization list is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Not Found in Customer Master
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Customer ID does not exist in the Customer Master data store, the system must stop the account detail retrieval process and display an informative error message to the user identifying the customer that was not found.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Customer Master record has been successfully retrieved containing the customer's first name, middle name, and last name
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the customer name for display on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs the full name by concatenating: First Name (trimmed of trailing spaces) + single space + first character of Middle Name + single space + Last Name (trimmed of trailing spaces), and displays the result in the customer name field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Customer Full Name for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When customer data has been successfully retrieved, the system must format the customer's full name by combining the first name, middle initial (first character of middle name only), and last name into a single display string for the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Customer Master record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 1 and Address Line 2
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the first address line for display on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs the first address display field by concatenating Address Line 1 (delimited by double spaces) + comma + Address Line 2 (delimited by double spaces), and displays the result in the first address field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Customer Address Line 1 for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must format the customer's primary address by combining Address Line 1 and Address Line 2 into a single display string, separated by a comma, for the first address display field on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Customer Master record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 3, State Code, and ZIP code
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the second address line for display on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs the second address display field by concatenating Address Line 3 (delimited by double spaces) + comma + State Code + comma + first 5 characters of ZIP code, and displays the result in the second address field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Customer Address Line 2 for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must format the customer's secondary address information by combining Address Line 3 (city), State Code, and the first 5 digits of the ZIP code into a single display string, separated by commas, for the second address display field on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Customer Master and Account Master records have been successfully retrieved and address formatting is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the remaining header fields on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the customer's primary phone number in the phone field, the account Credit Limit formatted as a 12-digit amount in the credit limit field, and the account Cash Credit Limit formatted as a 9-digit amount in the cash limit field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer Phone Number, Credit Limit, and Cash Credit Limit
all_rules.Rule_Description: After formatting the customer address information, the system displays the customer's primary phone number, the account's Credit Limit, and the account's Cash Credit Limit in the screen header fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The customer and account header information has been populated on the screen and the Account ID is available in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system queries the Pending Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID as the lookup key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the authorization summary record containing: Approved Authorization Count, Declined Authorization Count, Total Approved Authorization Amount, Total Declined Authorization Amount, Credit Balance, and Cash Balance — and sets the summary-found indicator accordingly

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account
all_rules.Rule_Description: After populating customer and account header information, the system must retrieve the Pending Authorization Summary segment from the authorization database for the account to obtain aggregate counts, amounts, and balances for display on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the following values from the Authorization Summary record: Approved Authorization Count in the approved count field, Declined Authorization Count in the declined count field, Credit Balance formatted as a 12-digit amount in the credit balance field, Cash Balance formatted as a 9-digit amount in the cash balance field, Total Approved Authorization Amount formatted as a 9-digit amount in the approved amount field, and Total Declined Authorization Amount formatted as a 9-digit amount in the declined amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Summary Counts, Amounts, and Balances When Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system displays all six summary financial figures — approved and declined counts, approved and declined amounts, credit balance, and cash balance — in the corresponding screen header fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has queried the Pending Authorization Summary data store for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No Authorization Summary record is found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets all six authorization summary display fields to zero: Approved Authorization Count = 0, Declined Authorization Count = 0, Credit Balance = 0, Cash Balance = 0, Total Approved Authorization Amount = 0, and Total Declined Authorization Amount = 0

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero Values for Authorization Summary When Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system must display zero values for all six authorization summary fields — approved count, declined count, approved amount, declined amount, credit balance, and cash balance — rather than leaving them blank or undefined.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid numeric Account ID has been entered by the user and the system is about to retrieve account-related details
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a lookup against the Card Cross-Reference file using the Account ID as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX) is searched using the Account ID to locate the corresponding cross-reference record containing the Customer ID and Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Cross-Reference Lookup Using Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When gathering account details, the system uses the entered Account ID as the search key to look up the Card Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX - VSAM Alternate Index) to find the associated customer and card information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a lookup against the Card Cross-Reference file using the Account ID as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is found in the Card Cross-Reference file and a matching cross-reference record is returned
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Customer ID (XREF-CUST-ID) from the cross-reference record and saves it to the session communication area (CDEMO-CUST-ID), and retrieves the Card Number (XREF-CARD-NUM) and saves it to the session communication area (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) for use in subsequent Account Master and Customer data lookups

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve and Save Customer ID and Card Number from Cross-Reference
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system retrieves the associated Customer ID and Card Number and saves them in the session for use in subsequent lookups (Account Master and Customer data).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a lookup against the Card Cross-Reference file using the entered Account ID as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching record is found in the Card Cross-Reference file for the given Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Account: [Account ID] not found in XREF file' on the screen, repositions the cursor to the Account ID input field, sends the Authorization Summary screen with the error message, and stops further processing of account, customer, and authorization data retrieval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Not Found in Card Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the entered Account ID does not exist in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system stops further processing, displays an informational message identifying the account that was not found, and returns the cursor to the Account ID field for correction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been resolved from the Card Cross-Reference file and is available as the lookup key for the Account Master file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a lookup of the Account Master file (ACCTDAT) using the resolved Account ID as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full Account Master record associated with that Account ID, making account financial details available for further processing and display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Account Master Record Using Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account details are being gathered, the system must retrieve the account master record from the Account file using the Account ID obtained from the Card Cross-Reference lookup, in order to obtain credit and cash limit information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Master record has been successfully retrieved from the Account file for the given Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the retrieved Account Master record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the Credit Limit (formatted as a 12-character display amount) and the Cash Credit Limit (formatted as a 9-character display amount) from the account record, and displays both values in the corresponding Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit fields on the Pending Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit from Account Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Master record is successfully found, the system extracts the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit values from the record, formats them for display, and presents them on the Pending Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to retrieve the Account Master record using the Account ID resolved from the Card Cross-Reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching Account Master record is found in the Account file for the given Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs and displays an informational message in the format: 'Account: [Account ID] not found in ACCT file', sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID input field on the screen, and sends the Pending Authorization Summary screen to the user — no account financial data is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Not Found in Account Master File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID provided does not match any record in the Account Master file, the system must notify the user that the account was not found and redirect focus back to the Account ID entry field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and the Card Cross-Reference lookup has successfully returned a Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a customer master record retrieval using the Customer ID as the lookup key against the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the Customer Master file using the Customer ID as the record identifier to fetch the full customer profile including name, address, and phone number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Master Record Lookup Using Customer ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system uses the Customer ID obtained from the Card Cross-Reference file to retrieve the corresponding customer master record from the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to retrieve a customer master record using a Customer ID from the Card Cross-Reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching customer record is found in the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT) for the given Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Customer: [Customer ID] not found in CUST file' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field, and halts further data retrieval and display processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Record Not Found Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Customer Master file does not contain a record matching the provided Customer ID, the system must notify the user that the customer record could not be located.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer master record has been successfully retrieved from the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the customer's name for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs the full name by concatenating: First Name (trimmed of trailing spaces) + single space + first character of Middle Name only + single space + Last Name (trimmed of trailing spaces), and displays the result in the customer name field on screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Full Name Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a customer record is successfully retrieved, the system constructs the customer's full display name by combining the first name, middle initial (first character only), and last name into a single formatted string.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer master record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 1 and Address Line 2 fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the first address line for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs Address Display Line 1 by concatenating: Address Line 1 (trimmed at double-space boundary) + comma + Address Line 2 (trimmed at double-space boundary), and displays the result in the first address field on screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Address Line 1 Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system formats the first address display line by combining the customer's street address (Address Line 1) and Address Line 2, separated by a comma.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer master record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 3 (city), State Code, and ZIP Code fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the second address line for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs Address Display Line 2 by concatenating: Address Line 3 (trimmed at double-space boundary) + comma + State Code + comma + first 5 digits of ZIP Code only, and displays the result in the second address field on screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Address Line 2 Formatting with ZIP Code Truncation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system formats the second address display line by combining the city (Address Line 3), state code, and ZIP code. Only the first 5 digits of the ZIP code are displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer master record has been successfully retrieved and the name and address fields have been formatted
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the customer information for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the customer's primary phone number (Phone Number 1) directly from the customer master record in the phone number field on screen, completing the customer information display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Phone Number Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system displays the customer's primary phone number as retrieved directly from the customer master record without any reformatting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and the Card Cross-Reference lookup has returned a Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the Customer record from the Customer Master File using the Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the customer record is found, the system continues to format and display customer information on the summary screen. If the customer record is not found, the system displays the message 'Customer: [Customer ID] not found in CUST file' and refreshes the screen without loading further customer details.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Customer Record by Customer ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retrieves the customer record from the Customer Master File using the Customer ID obtained from the Card Cross-Reference. If the customer is not found, an informational message is displayed and the screen is refreshed. If the record is successfully retrieved, processing continues to format and display customer information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer record has been successfully retrieved from the Customer Master File containing First Name, Middle Name, and Last Name fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the customer's full name for display on the summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs the full name as: First Name (trimmed of trailing spaces) + single space + first character of Middle Name + single space + Last Name (trimmed of trailing spaces), and assigns the result to the Customer Name display field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Customer Full Name for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system constructs the customer's full display name by combining the first name, a single middle initial (first character of middle name), and the last name, each separated by a single space. First name and last name are delimited by spaces (trailing spaces are excluded), while the middle initial is always exactly one character.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 1 and Address Line 2 fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the first address line for display on the summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs Address Display Line 1 as: Address Line 1 (truncated at double-space) + comma + Address Line 2 (truncated at double-space), and assigns the result to the first address display field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Customer Address Line 1 for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system constructs the first address display line by combining the customer's street address line 1 and address line 2, separated by a comma. Each address component is delimited by two consecutive spaces, meaning trailing double-spaces are used as the end-of-value marker.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer record has been successfully retrieved containing Address Line 3 (city), State Code, and ZIP Code fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the second address line for display on the summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system constructs Address Display Line 2 as: Address Line 3 (truncated at double-space) + comma + full State Code + comma + first 5 characters of ZIP Code, and assigns the result to the second address display field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Customer Address Line 2 (City, State, ZIP) for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system constructs the second address display line by combining the customer's address line 3 (city), state code, and the first 5 digits of the ZIP code, each separated by a comma. Address line 3 is delimited by double-spaces, while state code is included in full and only the first 5 characters of the ZIP code are used.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer record has been successfully retrieved containing a primary phone number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the phone number for display on the summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system assigns the customer's primary phone number (Phone Number 1) as-is to the phone number display field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer Primary Phone Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system assigns the customer's primary phone number directly to the phone number display field on the summary screen without any reformatting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The customer's full name, address line 1, address line 2 (city/state/zip), and phone number have all been formatted and are ready for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Pending Authorization Summary screen with customer information
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the following on the summary screen: Customer ID in the Customer ID field, formatted full name in the Customer Name field, formatted Address Line 1 (street + address line 2) in the first address display field, formatted Address Line 2 (city + state + ZIP) in the second address display field, and primary phone number in the phone number display field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display All Customer Information on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all customer data fields have been formatted, the system displays the complete customer profile on the Pending Authorization Summary screen. This includes the Customer ID, formatted full name, two formatted address lines, and the primary phone number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and the Account Master Record has been successfully retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the account financial summary display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Credit Limit value from the Account Master Record is formatted and displayed in the Credit Limit field (CREDLIMO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Credit Limit on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account details are gathered, the credit limit is retrieved from the Account Master Record and displayed on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and the Account Master Record has been successfully retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the account financial summary display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Cash Credit Limit value from the Account Master Record is formatted and displayed in the Cash Credit Limit field (CASHLIMO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Cash Credit Limit on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account details are gathered, the cash credit limit is retrieved from the Account Master Record and displayed on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and account and customer details have been retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system queries the Pending Authorization Summary database segment using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Authorization Summary segment is found, the system proceeds to retrieve and display actual credit balance and cash balance values; if the Authorization Summary segment is not found, the system proceeds to display zero values for credit balance and cash balance

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Whether Authorization Summary Data Exists for Account
all_rules.Rule_Description: After retrieving account details, the system checks whether a Pending Authorization Summary segment exists for the account in the authorization database. This decision determines whether actual balance values or zero defaults are displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and the Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the account financial summary display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Credit Balance value from the Pending Authorization Summary is formatted and displayed in the Credit Balance field (CREDBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Credit Balance from Authorization Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary segment exists for the account, the current credit balance is retrieved from that summary and displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and the Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the account financial summary display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Cash Balance value from the Pending Authorization Summary is formatted and displayed in the Cash Balance field (CASHBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Cash Balance from Authorization Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary segment exists for the account, the current cash balance is retrieved from that summary and displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and no Pending Authorization Summary segment exists for the account in the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the account financial summary display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Credit Balance field (CREDBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen is set to and displays zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero Credit Balance When No Authorization Summary Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Pending Authorization Summary segment is found for the account, the Credit Balance field on the summary screen must default to zero to avoid displaying blank or misleading data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID has been entered and no Pending Authorization Summary segment exists for the account in the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the account financial summary display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Cash Balance field (CASHBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen is set to and displays zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero Cash Balance When No Authorization Summary Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Pending Authorization Summary segment is found for the account, the Cash Balance field on the summary screen must default to zero to avoid displaying blank or misleading data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the Authorization Summary record for the account from the Pending Authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system proceeds to read and display actual authorization statistics (counts and amounts); if no Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system displays zero for all authorization statistics fields (Approved Count, Declined Count, Approved Amount, Declined Amount)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check Authorization Summary Record Availability Before Displaying Statistics
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether an Authorization Summary record exists for the given account before deciding which set of statistics to display — actual values or zeros.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Approved Authorization Count field (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT) from the Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count value is formatted and displayed in the Approved Count field (APPRCNTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Approved Authorization Count from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system reads the total count of approved authorizations and displays it on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Declined Authorization Count field (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT) from the Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count value is formatted and displayed in the Declined Count field (DECLCNTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Declined Authorization Count from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system reads the total count of declined authorizations and displays it on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Total Approved Authorization Amount field (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT) from the Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Approved Authorization Amount value is formatted and displayed in the Approved Amount field (APPRAMTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Approved Authorization Amount from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system reads the total monetary amount of approved authorizations and displays it on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Total Declined Authorization Amount field (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT) from the Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Declined Authorization Amount value is formatted and displayed in the Declined Amount field (DECLAMTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Declined Authorization Amount from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system reads the total monetary amount of declined authorizations and displays it on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No Authorization Summary record exists for the account in the Pending Authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that the Authorization Summary record is not found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count field (APPRCNTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen is set to and displays zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero for Approved Authorization Count When No Summary Record Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the Approved Authorization Count is displayed as zero on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No Authorization Summary record exists for the account in the Pending Authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that the Authorization Summary record is not found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count field (DECLCNTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen is set to and displays zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero for Declined Authorization Count When No Summary Record Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the Declined Authorization Count is displayed as zero on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No Authorization Summary record exists for the account in the Pending Authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that the Authorization Summary record is not found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Amount field (APPRAMTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen is set to and displays zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero for Approved Authorization Amount When No Summary Record Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the Total Approved Authorization Amount is displayed as zero on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No Authorization Summary record exists for the account in the Pending Authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that the Authorization Summary record is not found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Amount field (DECLAMTO) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen is set to and displays zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero for Declined Authorization Amount When No Summary Record Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the Total Declined Authorization Amount is displayed as zero on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system needs to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) to retrieve pending authorization summary or detail records for an account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a request to schedule access to the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system submits the database access request and captures the resulting access status for evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Request Access to Authorization Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the system needs to retrieve authorization data, it must first request access to the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) before any authorization records can be read or queried.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has submitted a request to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and has received the access status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the returned access status to determine if the Authorization Database was already scheduled and active from a prior session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the database access was already active (scheduled more than once), the system proceeds to release the existing access and re-request it; if this is the first request, the system proceeds directly to evaluate whether access was granted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect If Authorization Database Access Is Already Active
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before proceeding with Authorization Database access, the system checks whether a prior database access session is still active. If it is, the system must release it before re-requesting access to avoid conflicts.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) access is already active from a previous session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system releases (terminates) the existing active Authorization Database access session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The existing Authorization Database access session is fully released, and the system is ready to re-request fresh access to the Authorization Database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Release Existing Authorization Database Access Before Re-Scheduling
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the Authorization Database access is found to be already active from a prior session, the system must release (terminate) that existing access session before attempting to re-establish a fresh access session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully released the previously active Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) access session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system re-submits a new request to schedule access to the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and captures the resulting access status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system has a new access status available for evaluation to determine whether the re-requested Authorization Database access was granted or failed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Re-Request Authorization Database Access After Release
all_rules.Rule_Description: After releasing the previously active Authorization Database session, the system must re-submit a fresh request to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) to ensure a clean and valid access session is established.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has submitted a request (initial or re-request) to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and has received the access status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The access status indicates that the Authorization Database access was granted successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the Authorization Database session as active and ready, enabling all subsequent authorization data retrieval operations (summary and detail lookups) to proceed for the current transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Authorization Database as Active and Ready
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Authorization Database access request is granted successfully, the system marks the database session as active and ready so that subsequent authorization data retrieval operations can proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has submitted a request (initial or re-request) to access the Authorization Database (PSBPAUTB) and has received the access status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The access status indicates that the Authorization Database access request failed (status is not successful)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', composes an error message reading 'System error while scheduling PSB: Code: [access status code]', positions the cursor on the Account ID field, and immediately displays the error message to the user on the Authorization Summary screen; no authorization data retrieval is attempted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Authorization Database Access Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the Authorization Database access request fails for any reason, the system must set an error condition and display a system error message to the user, preventing any further authorization data retrieval from proceeding.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Authorization Summary screen back to the user and the Authorization Database access session is currently marked as active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to display the Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A) to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the Authorization Database session as inactive, commits the current unit of work (syncpoint), and then proceeds to send the Authorization Summary screen to the user; if the database session was not active, the screen is sent directly without any database release

all_rules.Rule_Name: Release Authorization Database Access Before Sending Screen to User
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before sending any screen response back to the user, if the Authorization Database access session is currently active, the system must commit and release the database access to ensure data consistency and proper resource management.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID is available in the current session (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and the system is gathering account details for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system queries the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) using the Account ID as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Pending Authorization Summary record that matches the given Account ID, making aggregate authorization data available for further processing and display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Pending Authorization Summary by Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account details are being gathered, the system uses the Account ID stored in the session to query the IMS Pending Authorization Summary database segment (PAUTSUM0) to retrieve aggregate authorization data for that account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has queried the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Summary segment using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The IMS database returns a matching Pending Authorization Summary record for the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an internal indicator (FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG) to TRUE, signaling that authorization summary data is available for display on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Authorization Summary as Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the IMS database successfully returns a Pending Authorization Summary record for the queried Account ID, the system marks the summary as found so downstream display logic can use the retrieved data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has queried the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Summary segment using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The IMS database returns no matching Pending Authorization Summary record for the Account ID (segment not found or end of database)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an internal indicator (NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG) to TRUE, signaling that no pending authorization summary data exists for this account

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Authorization Summary as Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the IMS database does not find a Pending Authorization Summary record for the queried Account ID, the system marks the summary as not found, indicating that no pending authorizations exist for this account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database for the given Account ID (FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen with data from the retrieved summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the following six fields on the screen: (1) Approved Authorization Count (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT → APPRCNTO), (2) Declined Authorization Count (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT → DECLCNTO), (3) Current Credit Balance (PA-CREDIT-BALANCE → CREDBALO), (4) Current Cash Balance (PA-CASH-BALANCE → CASHBALO), (5) Total Approved Authorization Amount (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT → APPRAMTO), (6) Total Declined Authorization Amount (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT → DECLAMTO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Summary Counts and Amounts When Summary Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system extracts and displays six aggregate financial fields from the summary record on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No Pending Authorization Summary record was found in the IMS database for the given Account ID (NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays zero (0) for all six summary fields: (1) Approved Authorization Count (APPRCNTO = 0), (2) Declined Authorization Count (DECLCNTO = 0), (3) Current Credit Balance (CREDBALO = 0), (4) Current Cash Balance (CASHBALO = 0), (5) Total Approved Authorization Amount (APPRAMTO = 0), (6) Total Declined Authorization Amount (DECLAMTO = 0)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero Values for Authorization Summary When No Summary Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account in the IMS database, the system displays zero values for all six authorization summary fields on the screen, clearly indicating no pending authorization activity for the account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display a new page of pending authorization records for an account, and the authorization list screen currently contains data from a previous display or page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates the authorization list initialization process for all five rows sequentially (Row 1 through Row 5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each of the five rows on the authorization list screen, the following fields must be set to blank: Transaction ID, Authorization Date, Authorization Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Approved Amount. Additionally, the selection input field for each row must be set to protected (non-enterable) so the user cannot interact with an empty row. All five rows must be cleared regardless of how many records were previously displayed, ensuring no residual data from a prior page remains on screen before fresh authorization data is populated.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Authorization List Rows Before Fresh Data Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before displaying a new page of pending authorization records, all five rows of the authorization list on the screen must be completely cleared. Each row's Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields are reset to blank, and the selection field for each row is set to non-enterable (protected), ensuring no stale data from a previous page remains visible to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and presses PF8 to navigate forward
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is blank or low-values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the last displayed authorization key is blank or low-values, the system clears the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and proceeds directly to clear and reload the authorization list rows without repositioning; if the last key exists, the system saves it to WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE and proceeds to retrieve the authorization summary and reposition to that key

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check Last Displayed Authorization Key Availability for Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether a last displayed authorization key exists to enable forward page navigation. If no key is available, the system skips repositioning and proceeds directly to clear and reload the list from the beginning.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is not blank or low-values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to navigate to the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system copies the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) into the working save area (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the repositioning anchor for fetching the next set of authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Last Displayed Authorization Key for Repositioning
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid last displayed authorization key exists, the system saves it as the repositioning anchor before fetching the next page of authorization records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and a valid last displayed authorization key has been saved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition and load the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes GET-AUTH-SUMMARY to retrieve the pending authorization summary segment from the IMS database for the current account (CDEMO-ACCT-ID), scheduling the IMS PSB if not already active

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Authorization Summary Before Forward Page Load
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before loading the next page of authorization records, the system retrieves the authorization summary segment for the account to ensure the IMS database session is active and the account context is current.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization summary has been retrieved and WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE contains the last displayed authorization key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the repositioning operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system moves WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE into PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY and issues an IMS GNP call on the PAUTDTL1 segment using the authorization key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) to position the database cursor at that specific authorization record; if the record is found, the not-end-of-file indicator is set; if not found or end of database, the end-of-file indicator is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reposition to Last Displayed Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system repositions the IMS database cursor to the last displayed authorization record so that the next sequential read will retrieve the first record of the new page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has repositioned to the last displayed authorization record after PF8 is pressed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the NEXT-PAGE-YES/NEXT-PAGE-NO flag
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If NEXT-PAGE-YES is set, the system proceeds to clear the authorization list rows and load the next page of records; if NEXT-PAGE-NO is set, the system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and does not change the displayed authorization list

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Next Page Record Availability After Repositioning
all_rules.Rule_Description: After repositioning to the last displayed authorization key, the system checks whether the NEXT-PAGE flag indicates that additional records exist beyond the current page before proceeding to load the new page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and the NEXT-PAGE-NO flag is set, indicating no further authorization records exist beyond the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the next page availability
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' in the message area (WS-MESSAGE) and refreshes the screen without altering the currently displayed authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Already at Bottom of Page Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to navigate forward but no additional authorization records exist beyond the current page, the system informs the user they have reached the last page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to load a new page of authorization records (either next page records are available or no last key existed)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initializes the authorization display area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system iterates through all five rows (index 1 to 5) and for each row sets the selection field to protected (DFHBMPRO) and clears the Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields to spaces

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Five Authorization List Rows Before Loading New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before loading a new page of authorization records, the system clears all five display rows to ensure no stale data from the previous page remains visible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization list rows have been cleared and the database cursor is positioned at the correct starting record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system loads records for the new page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system loops with a row index starting at 1, issuing an IMS GNP call on the PAUTDTL1 segment to retrieve the next pending authorization detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) sequentially; the loop continues until the row index exceeds 5, end-of-data is reached, or an error occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Load Up to Five Authorization Records for New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system sequentially retrieves up to five pending authorization detail records from the IMS database to populate the current page of the authorization list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has issued an IMS GNP read for the next authorization detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the IMS return status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the status is OK (AUTHS-NOT-EOF is set), the system proceeds to populate the current row with the retrieved record data; if the status indicates segment not found or end of database (AUTHS-EOF is set), the system exits the loading loop and proceeds to check for additional records beyond the page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Record Retrieval Success for Each Authorization Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each IMS read attempt, the system determines whether a valid authorization record was retrieved to decide whether to populate the row or stop loading.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the corresponding display row (1 through 5) based on the current row index
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the row with: Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID), Authorization Date formatted as MM/DD/YY (derived from PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE where positions 1-2 are month, 3-4 are day, 5-6 are year), Authorization Time formatted as HH:MM:SS (derived from PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME where positions 1-2 are hours, 3-4 are minutes, 5-6 are seconds), Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE), Approval Status ('A' if PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals '00', otherwise 'D'), Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS), and Approved Amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT); the selection field for the row is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) to allow user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row with Transaction Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully retrieved authorization record is formatted and displayed in the corresponding row on the screen, including all key transaction details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization detail record has been retrieved with a PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines the approval status to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals '00', the system sets the approval status indicator (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) to 'A' (Approved); for any other response code value, the system sets the approval status indicator to 'D' (Declined)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system derives the human-readable approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating authorization rows and has successfully retrieved and populated a record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row index (WS-IDX) equals 2 after incrementing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system increments the page number counter (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM by 1) and saves the current authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) as the page start key for this page number in the page key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG at index CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) to enable accurate backward navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Identify First Record of New Page and Increment Page Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the second record of a page is loaded (row index = 2), the system recognizes this as the true first record of the new page and increments the page counter, saving the record's key as the page start key for backward navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The row index equals 2 (indicating the first record of the new page has been identified) and the page number has been incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system records the page navigation history
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the current authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) into the page key history array at the position corresponding to the new page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)), so that PF7 backward navigation can retrieve the correct starting key for any previously viewed page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Page Start Key into Page Key History for Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system maintains a history of the first authorization key for each page visited, enabling the PF7 backward navigation to accurately reposition to the beginning of any previously viewed page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and its data has been populated into a display row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system updates the last displayed key tracker
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system saves the current authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) into CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST, overwriting any previously saved last key; this key represents the last authorization record currently visible on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Last Displayed Authorization Key on Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each authorization record is successfully populated into a display row, the system saves that record's key as the last displayed key, which will be used as the repositioning anchor for the next forward page navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been populated into the current row and the row index has been incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the page is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the row index (WS-IDX) is 5 or less, the system continues the loop and attempts to retrieve the next authorization record; if the row index exceeds 5, the system exits the loading loop and proceeds to peek at the next record to determine if a further page is available

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check Whether More Rows Need to Be Filled
all_rules.Rule_Description: After populating each authorization row, the system checks whether the page has been fully filled (5 rows) or if more records should be loaded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has finished loading up to five authorization records (either five rows are filled or end-of-data was reached during loading)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks for additional records beyond the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If AUTHS-NOT-EOF and no error condition exists, the system issues one additional IMS GNP read on the PAUTDTL1 segment; if this peek read returns a record successfully (AUTHS-NOT-EOF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-YES to indicate a further page is available; if the peek read returns end-of-data or segment not found (AUTHS-EOF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-NO to indicate the current page is the last page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek at Next Record to Determine Further Page Availability
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling up to five rows, the system attempts to read one additional authorization record to determine whether a next page of records exists, without displaying that record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a peek read after filling the current page rows
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the peek read
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the peek read successfully retrieved a record (AUTHS-NOT-EOF and ERR-FLG-OFF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-YES to true, indicating PF8 forward navigation is available; if the peek read returned no record (AUTHS-EOF), the system sets NEXT-PAGE-NO to true, indicating no further pages exist and PF8 forward navigation is not available

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next Page Available Indicator
all_rules.Rule_Description: Based on the peek read result, the system sets the appropriate next-page availability indicator to control PF8 navigation on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The forward page navigation processing is complete, with either new records loaded or a bottom-of-page message set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with current date, time, transaction name, and program name; moves the current message (WS-MESSAGE) to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO); and sends the COPAU0A map from the COPAU00 mapset with cursor positioning; since SEND-ERASE-NO was set during PF8 processing, the screen is sent as an overlay (without ERASE) rather than a full screen refresh

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Updated Authorization Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After completing the forward page navigation processing, the system sends the updated authorization summary screen to the user with the newly loaded page of records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the current page number is tracked in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the current page number is greater than 1, backward navigation proceeds; if the current page number is 1 or less, the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' is displayed and the screen is refreshed without any data change

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Backward Navigation Eligibility
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determine whether the user can navigate to a previous page of authorization records. Navigation is only permitted when the user is not already on the first page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the current page number is 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message 'You are already at the top of the page...' is displayed on the screen, the screen is refreshed without erasing (overlay mode), and no authorization data is changed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Already at Top of List Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: Inform the user that no previous page exists when they attempt to navigate backward from the first page of authorization records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on a page greater than 1 of the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to navigate to the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current page number is decremented by 1 to identify the target previous page number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Decrement Page Number for Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Reduce the current page number by one to identify the target previous page when the user navigates backward through authorization records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The page number has been decremented to the target previous page number and a history of page start keys is maintained in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to load the previous page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The saved authorization key corresponding to the target page number is retrieved from the page key history and stored as the current navigation key to be used for repositioning

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Saved Page Start Key for Target Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: Retrieve the authorization key that was saved as the starting record of the target previous page, enabling accurate repositioning of the authorization record cursor.
