Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The target page key has been retrieved and the account ID is available in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to reload authorization records for the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary segment is retrieved from the database for the current account ID; if found, processing continues; if not found, summary fields are treated as unavailable

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account During Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Re-fetch the Pending Authorization Summary segment for the account to ensure the database session is active and the authorization data context is current before loading the previous page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to load the previous page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization list rows are initialized prior to populating with new data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All five rows on the screen are cleared: Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields are set to spaces for each of the five rows, and each row's selection field is set to protected (non-enterable)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Five Authorization List Rows Before Reload
all_rules.Rule_Description: Reset all five authorization record display rows to blank before loading the previous page data, ensuring no stale data from the prior page remains visible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The saved page start key for the target previous page has been retrieved and stored as the current navigation key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins loading authorization records for the previous page and the first row is being processed during a PF7 navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization record retrieval is repositioned to the authorization record matching the saved page start key; if the record is found, retrieval continues from that position; if the record is not found, the end-of-data condition is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reposition Authorization Cursor to Saved Page Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: Reposition the authorization record retrieval cursor to the specific authorization record identified by the saved page start key, so that the correct set of records is loaded for the previous page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization cursor is positioned at the correct starting record for the page being loaded
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system retrieves authorization records to fill the display rows (rows 2 through 5, or all rows when not the first row of a PF7 navigation)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next authorization detail record is retrieved sequentially; if a record is found, it is available for display; if no more records exist, the end-of-data condition is set and the loop stops

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Next Authorization Record Sequentially
all_rules.Rule_Description: Sequentially retrieve the next pending authorization detail record from the database for the current account to populate the next available row on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the corresponding display row (1 through 5) on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields are populated for the row: Transaction ID, Date formatted as MM/DD/YY (derived from the authorization origination date), Time formatted as HH:MM:SS (derived from the authorization origination time), Authorization Type, Approval Status set to 'A' if the authorization response code is '00' or 'D' for any other response code, Match Status, and Approved Amount; the row's selection field is set to unprotected (enterable by the user)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row with Record Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: Populate each authorization display row with the retrieved record's details, including formatting the date and time and deriving the approval status from the authorization response code.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system derives the approval status for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the authorization response code equals '00', the approval status is set to 'A' (Approved); for any other response code value, the approval status is set to 'D' (Declined)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Derive Approval Status from Authorization Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determine the display approval status of each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The second authorization record (row index = 2) has been successfully retrieved and populated on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the second row during page loading
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page number is incremented by 1 and the authorization key of the second record is saved into the page key history at the position corresponding to the new page number, establishing the start key for this page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save First Record Key as Page Start Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: Record the authorization key of the first record on the new page into the page key history to enable accurate backward navigation in future PF7 presses.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has finished populating up to five authorization rows or has reached end-of-data before filling all five rows
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether additional authorization records exist beyond the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: One additional authorization record retrieval is attempted; if a record is found, the Next Page Available indicator is set to indicate PF8 forward navigation is available; if no record is found, the No Further Pages indicator is set to indicate PF8 forward navigation is not available

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek at Next Record to Determine Further Page Availability
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling up to five authorization rows, attempt to retrieve one additional record to determine whether a further page of authorization records exists, enabling or disabling the PF8 forward navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The peek retrieval after filling the current page has found an additional authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether forward navigation should be enabled
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Next Page Available indicator is set to TRUE, signaling that PF8 forward navigation is available to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next Page Available Indicator
all_rules.Rule_Description: Mark that additional authorization records exist beyond the current page so that the user can navigate forward using PF8.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The peek retrieval after filling the current page has found no additional authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether forward navigation should be enabled
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The No Further Pages indicator is set to TRUE, signaling that PF8 forward navigation is not available to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set No Further Pages Indicator
all_rules.Rule_Description: Mark that no additional authorization records exist beyond the current page so that the user is informed there is no further forward navigation available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward navigation processing is complete, either with the previous page loaded or the top-of-list message set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the updated screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Summary screen is displayed in overlay mode (without full screen erase), showing either the reloaded previous page of up to five authorization records with updated page navigation indicators, or the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' if the user was already on the first page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Updated Authorization Summary Screen After Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Refresh the Pending Authorization Summary screen to display the reloaded previous page of authorization records or the top-of-list message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary list screen with authorization records displayed, and the current page number is tracked in the session as CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 to scroll backward through the authorization list
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system evaluates the current page number: if the current page number is greater than 1, backward navigation proceeds; if the current page number is 1 or less (already on the first page), the system suppresses backward navigation and triggers the top-of-list informational message instead

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect First Page on Backward Scroll Attempt
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user attempts to scroll backward through the Pending Authorization Summary list by pressing PF7, the system must first determine whether the user is already viewing the first page of results. This rule evaluates the current page number to decide whether backward navigation is possible or whether an informational message should be shown.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary list screen and the current page number is 1 (i.e., CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM is not greater than 1), meaning the user is already on the first page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 attempting to scroll backward
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the informational message 'You are already at the top of the page...' on the screen, the authorization list content is not changed or reloaded, and the screen is refreshed using an overlay (non-erase) send so that the existing authorization records remain visible alongside the message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Top-of-List Message When Already on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF7 to scroll backward but is already viewing the first page of the Pending Authorization Summary list, the system must inform the user that no further backward navigation is possible by displaying a specific informational message. The authorization list content remains unchanged and the screen is refreshed without erasing the existing display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the user is already on the first page of the Pending Authorization Summary list (page number is not greater than 1) and the top-of-list message has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to send the screen back to the user after the failed PF7 backward scroll attempt
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen is sent in overlay mode (SEND-ERASE-NO is set to TRUE, meaning no full screen erase is performed), the existing authorization list rows (up to 5 records) remain displayed without any reload or modification, and only the message area is updated with the top-of-list informational message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Preserve Authorization List Display When Top-of-List Reached
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the top-of-list condition is detected during a PF7 backward scroll attempt, the system must refresh the screen without altering the currently displayed authorization records. The screen is sent using an overlay mode (not a full erase), ensuring the existing list data remains intact and only the informational message is updated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and presses PF8 to scroll forward
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is blank or contains low-values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the last displayed authorization key is blank or low-values, the system clears the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and skips repositioning, proceeding directly to check if a next page is available; if the last displayed authorization key contains a valid value, the system saves it to WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE and proceeds to retrieve the authorization summary and reposition to that record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine If Forward Scrolling Is Possible Based on Last Displayed Authorization Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF8 to scroll forward through the authorization list, the system checks whether a last-displayed authorization key exists to determine if any records have been previously loaded and if forward navigation is possible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and a valid last displayed authorization key exists for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system needs to navigate forward in the authorization list
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system schedules the IMS Program Specification Block (PSB) and retrieves the Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) for the current account ID; if the summary segment is found, the system sets the found-summary indicator to true and proceeds; if the summary segment is not found, the system sets the not-found indicator; the retrieved summary provides the context needed for repositioning within the authorization detail records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Authorization Summary for Account Before Forward Scroll
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before repositioning to the next page of authorizations, the system retrieves the current authorization summary segment for the account from the IMS database to ensure the session context is current.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization summary has been retrieved and the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) contains the key of the last record displayed on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system needs to position to the correct starting point for the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system moves the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) into the authorization key field (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) and retrieves the authorization detail record (PAUTDTL1) from the IMS database using that specific key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY); if the record is found, the system sets the not-end-of-file indicator and is positioned at that record ready to read the next sequential records; if the record is not found or end of database is reached, the system sets the end-of-file indicator

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reposition to Last Displayed Authorization Record for Forward Scroll
all_rules.Rule_Description: To load the next page of authorizations, the system repositions the database cursor to the last authorization record that was displayed on the current page, so that the next sequential records can be retrieved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has finished loading up to 5 authorization records for the current page display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the NEXT-PAGE indicator flag that was set during the page-forward processing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the NEXT-PAGE indicator is set to YES (meaning an additional record was found beyond the 5 displayed), the system proceeds to load the next page of authorization records; if the NEXT-PAGE indicator is set to NO (meaning no additional records exist beyond the 5 displayed), the system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' to inform the user they have reached the last page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine If Additional Authorization Records Exist Beyond the Current Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: After loading up to 5 authorization records for the current page, the system checks whether additional records exist beyond those displayed to determine if forward scrolling (PF8) should be enabled or if the user has reached the last page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The NEXT-PAGE indicator is YES, confirming more authorization records exist beyond the current page, and the database cursor is repositioned to the last displayed record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the forward page load
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system first clears all 5 authorization display rows (setting each row's Transaction ID, Date, Time, Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount to spaces, and setting each selection field to protected), then iterates through up to 5 authorization detail records (PAUTDTL1) sequentially; for each record retrieved, the system populates the corresponding row with: Transaction ID, Date formatted as MM/DD/YY, Time formatted as HH:MM:SS, Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' if response code is '00', 'D' for any other response code), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the authorization key for each row is saved in CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(1-5); the key of the first record on the new page is saved as the page-start key in CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG for backward navigation; the key of the last record displayed is saved in CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST

all_rules.Rule_Name: Load Next Page of Authorization Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: When additional authorization records exist beyond the current page, the system initializes the display rows and loads the next set of up to 5 authorization records into the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Pending Authorization Summary screen and is on the last page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to scroll forward and either no last authorization key exists (no records were loaded) or the NEXT-PAGE indicator is set to NO after repositioning
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the message field (WS-MESSAGE) to 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and sets the screen send mode to overlay (SEND-ERASE-NO, meaning the screen is refreshed without a full erase), and the authorization list rows remain unchanged showing the current last page of records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bottom-of-List Detection - Inform User When Already on Last Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to scroll forward (PF8) but no additional authorization records exist beyond the currently displayed page, the system informs the user they have reached the end of the authorization list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The bottom-of-list message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' has been set and the screen send mode is overlay (SEND-ERASE-NO)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Pending Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A from mapset COPAU00)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with current date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), current time (formatted as HH:MM:SS), transaction name, and program name; the error message area displays 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'; the screen is sent in overlay mode (without full erase) preserving the existing authorization list rows; the cursor is positioned at the Account ID field; the current page of authorization records remains visible to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Summary Screen with Bottom-of-List Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: After determining the user is at the bottom of the authorization list, the system refreshes the screen displaying the bottom-of-list message to the user while preserving the current page content.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to retrieve authorization records for display on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An error flag is active, indicating a prior error condition such as account not found or a data retrieval failure
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system skips all authorization record retrieval and page population steps entirely, since the error has already been communicated to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Authorization Record Retrieval When Error Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: If an error condition has already been raised (e.g., account not found, data retrieval failure) before the authorization list retrieval begins, the system skips the entire page-loading process, as an error message has already been displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No active error condition exists and the system is ready to load authorization records for the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The page-forward process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The row counter is set to 1 and the last authorization key tracker is cleared to low-values, preparing the system to populate up to 5 rows on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Page Row Counter and Last Authorization Key Tracker
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before retrieving authorization records for a new page, the system initializes the row counter to 1 and clears the tracker that holds the last authorization key displayed on the page, ensuring a clean state for page population.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is in the process of retrieving and displaying authorization records for the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row counter exceeds 5 OR the end-of-records condition is reached OR an error flag is raised
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system exits the record retrieval loop and proceeds to check whether additional records exist beyond the current page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Stop Retrieving Records When Page Is Full or No More Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retrieves authorization records one at a time and stops when either 5 records have been loaded (filling the page) or there are no more authorization records available for the account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 (page backward) and the system is about to retrieve the first record for the page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current action is a PF7 backward navigation AND the row counter is at position 1 (first row)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system repositions the authorization record cursor to the saved page start key before reading, so that the correct set of records is retrieved for the previous page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reposition to Saved Page Key on PF7 Navigation for First Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates backward using PF7, the system must reposition the database cursor to the saved start key of the target page before reading the first record, ensuring the correct page of records is displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating authorization records for the current page and no repositioning is required
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current action is not a PF7 first-row reposition (i.e., it is a normal sequential read)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the next available authorization detail record sequentially from the pending authorization database segment

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Next Authorization Detail Record Sequentially
all_rules.Rule_Description: For all rows other than the first row during PF7 navigation, the system reads the next authorization detail record sequentially from the database to populate the next row on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read an authorization detail record from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The read result indicates the record segment was not found or the end of the database has been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the end-of-records indicator to true and exits the retrieval loop, stopping further record population for the current page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of Authorization Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each read attempt, the system evaluates whether a record was successfully retrieved. If no record is found or the end of available records is reached, the retrieval loop is exited.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the authorization date for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization origination date is reformatted from YYMMDD storage format to MM/DD/YY display format, where positions 1-2 become the year (YY), positions 3-4 become the month (MM), and positions 5-6 become the day (DD), resulting in a MM/DD/YY formatted date

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Authorization Date from YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization origination date stored in the database uses a YYMMDD format. The system reformats this date into MM/DD/YY format for display on the authorization list screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the authorization time for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization origination time is reformatted from HHMMSS storage format to HH:MM:SS display format, where positions 1-2 map to hours (HH) at display positions 1-2, positions 3-4 map to minutes (MM) at display positions 4-5, and positions 5-6 map to seconds (SS) at display positions 7-8, with colon separators inserted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Authorization Time from HHMMSS to HH:MM:SS
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization origination time stored in the database uses a compact HHMMSS format. The system reformats this time into HH:MM:SS format with separators for display on the authorization list screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved and contains an authorization response code
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code to determine the approval status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the response code is '00', the approval status is set to 'A' (Approved); if the response code is any value other than '00', the approval status is set to 'D' (Declined)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Derive Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system derives a human-readable approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the database. A response code of '00' indicates an approved authorization, while any other response code indicates a declined authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved and its date, time, and approval status have been formatted
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the screen row corresponding to the current row counter value (1 through 5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the following fields in the row matching the row counter position: Transaction ID, Authorization Date (MM/DD/YY), Authorization Time (HH:MM:SS), Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the selection field for that row is set to unprotected to allow user input; the authorization key for that row is saved in the session for later selection processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row on Screen with All Required Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each retrieved authorization record, the system populates the corresponding row on the authorization list screen with all required display fields. The row position (1 through 5) determines which set of screen fields is populated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully populated into a row on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system updates the page navigation tracking information
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key of the most recently displayed record is saved as the last authorization key on the current page, enabling the PF8 forward navigation to correctly retrieve the next set of records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Last Displayed Authorization Key for Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the system saves that record's authorization key as the last key displayed on the current page. This key is used by the PF8 forward navigation to correctly position to the next page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has just populated the second authorization record (row counter = 2) on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row counter equals 2 after populating a record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page number counter is incremented by 1, and the authorization key of the second record is saved as the page start key for the current page number, enabling PF7 backward navigation to return to the beginning of this page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Page Number and Save Page Start Key on Second Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the second authorization record on a page is populated, the system increments the page number counter and saves that record's authorization key as the start key for the current page. This saved key enables accurate backward navigation using PF7.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully populated into the current row on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes population of the current row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The row counter is incremented by 1, advancing the position for the next authorization record to be populated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Advance Row Counter After Each Record Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the row counter is incremented by 1 to advance to the next available row position for the subsequent record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed populating the current page with up to 5 authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieval loop exits after filling the page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the end-of-records indicator is not set and no error exists, the system attempts to peek at the next record to determine if more records are available; if the end-of-records indicator is already set, the system proceeds directly to mark the next page as unavailable

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check for Additional Records Beyond Current Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling up to 5 rows on the current page, the system checks whether additional authorization records exist beyond the current page. This check determines whether the PF8 (next page) navigation option should be made available to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current page has been fully populated and the end-of-records condition has not yet been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a peek read of the next authorization detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the next authorization record from the database solely to check its existence; the result determines whether the next page navigation flag is set to available or unavailable

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek at Next Authorization Record to Determine Page Availability
all_rules.Rule_Description: After loading the current page, the system reads one additional authorization record beyond the last displayed record to determine whether a next page of records exists, without displaying that record on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a peek read after filling the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The peek read successfully retrieves an additional authorization record, confirming more records exist
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next page available flag is set to YES, indicating that the user may press PF8 to navigate to the next page of authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next Page Available When Additional Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the peek read confirms that at least one more authorization record exists beyond the current page, the system marks the next page as available, enabling the user to navigate forward using PF8.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed loading the current page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either the end-of-records condition was already set before the peek attempt, OR the peek read returns no record (end of records or segment not found)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next page available flag is set to NO, indicating that the user is on the last page and PF8 forward navigation is not available; if the user presses PF8, the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' will be displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next Page Unavailable When No Additional Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: If no additional authorization records exist beyond the current page (either confirmed by a failed peek read or by the end-of-records condition being set before the peek), the system marks the next page as unavailable, preventing PF8 navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A paging operation (either backward via PF7 or forward via PF8) has been initiated and a saved authorization key exists in the current paging context (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition the Authorization Detail record cursor
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the search target to the saved authorization key from the paging context, so that the Authorization Detail records can be searched starting from that exact key position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Use Saved Authorization Key as Reposition Target
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the system needs to reposition the authorization list cursor for paging purposes, it uses the authorization key that was previously saved in the paging context as the exact target position to search for in the Authorization Detail records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The saved authorization key has been set as the target position and the Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1) is accessible within the current account's pending authorization data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system searches the Pending Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key as the match criterion
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Authorization Detail record whose authorization key matches the saved key, positioning the cursor at that record so that subsequent reads will proceed forward from that point

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Authorization Detail Records by Saved Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system queries the Pending Authorization Detail segment in the database using the saved authorization key as the search criterion to reposition the reading cursor to the correct location in the authorization list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The target authorization record matching the saved key is found successfully in the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record stream as 'Not End of Records' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF), indicating that the cursor is correctly positioned and the page-forward process can proceed to read and display authorization records from this point

all_rules.Rule_Name: Cursor Successfully Positioned at Target Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the target authorization record is found during repositioning, the system marks the authorization data stream as active and available, enabling the page-forward process to continue reading records from that position.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The target authorization record is not found (segment not found) OR the end of the authorization data has been reached (end of database)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record stream as 'End of Records' (AUTHS-EOF), indicating that no authorization records are available at or after the requested position, and the page-forward process will not attempt to display any records

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Authorization Record Found at Requested Position
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the target authorization record is not found during repositioning — either because the specific record no longer exists or the end of the authorization data has been reached — the system marks the authorization stream as exhausted, preventing further page-forward attempts.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 (page backward) and the current page number is greater than 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system decrements the page number by 1 and prepares to reload the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the saved first-authorization-key for the decremented page number from the page key history (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by the new page number) and sets it as the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the reposition target

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Saved Key Source for Backward Page Navigation (PF7)
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates backward (PF7), the system decrements the page number and retrieves the first authorization key that was saved when that page was originally loaded, using it as the reposition target to accurately redisplay that page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 (page forward), the last authorization key on the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is not blank or low-values, and more pages are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to load the next page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to the last authorization key displayed on the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST), then retrieves the authorization summary and repositions the cursor to that key so that forward reading begins from that record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Saved Key Source for Forward Page Navigation (PF8)
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates forward (PF8), the system uses the last authorization key displayed on the current page as the reposition target, so that the next page begins reading from the record immediately following the current page's last record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The page-forward loading loop is executing to populate up to 5 authorization rows on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row index is 1 (first row) AND the key pressed was PF7 (backward navigation)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system performs the reposition operation (REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS) to position the cursor at the saved authorization key before reading; for all other row iterations or when any key other than PF7 was pressed, the system reads the next sequential authorization record (GET-AUTHORIZATIONS) without repositioning

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Repositioning Only on First Row During PF7 Page Load
all_rules.Rule_Description: During the page-forward loading loop, repositioning of the authorization cursor is performed only once — on the very first row iteration and only when the user pressed PF7 (backward navigation). For all other rows and all other navigation actions, the system simply reads the next sequential authorization record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed the process of loading the current page of pending authorization records for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether all 5 authorization records were retrieved successfully — meaning the end-of-data indicator is NOT set AND the error flag is NOT set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If both conditions are met (no end-of-data and no error), the system proceeds to attempt reading one additional authorization record beyond the current page to determine if more records exist; otherwise, no peek attempt is made and next-page availability is left undetermined

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Eligibility to Peek for Next Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to populate the current page with up to 5 authorization records, the system evaluates whether the page was fully and successfully populated before attempting to look ahead for additional records. A peek is only performed if all 5 records were retrieved without reaching the end of available data and without any processing errors.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current page of 5 pending authorization records has been fully populated without reaching end-of-data and without any errors
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the next sequential pending authorization record (PAUTDTL1 segment) for the account using a Get Next within Parent (GNP) database call
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system receives either a successful record retrieval (setting the not-end-of-data indicator) or an end-of-data/not-found response (setting the end-of-data indicator), which is then used to determine next-page availability

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek at Next Authorization Record Beyond Current Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current page has been fully populated with 5 authorization records without errors, the system reads one additional authorization record from the pending authorizations data store. This read is solely to determine whether more records exist beyond the current page and does not display the record to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read one authorization record beyond the 5 records displayed on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The additional record is found successfully — meaning the end-of-data indicator is NOT set AND the error flag is NOT set after the peek read
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Next Page Indicator to YES, signaling that more pending authorization records are available and that the user may navigate forward to the next page using PF8

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next Page Indicator to YES When Additional Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: After peeking at the record beyond the current page, if an additional authorization record is successfully found, the system marks that a next page of authorization records is available. This enables the PF8 (page forward) navigation option for the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read one authorization record beyond the 5 records displayed on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No additional record is found — meaning the end-of-data indicator IS set OR the error flag IS set after the peek read
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Next Page Indicator to NO, signaling that the current page is the last page of pending authorization records and that PF8 forward navigation is not available; if the user attempts PF8, the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next Page Indicator to NO When No Additional Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: After peeking at the record beyond the current page, if no additional authorization record is found (end of available data is reached), the system marks that no further pages exist. This disables the PF8 (page forward) navigation option and informs the user they are on the last page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed the loop to load up to 5 pending authorization records onto the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The end-of-data indicator IS set (fewer than 5 records were available) OR the error flag IS set (a processing error occurred during page loading)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system skips the peek read entirely and does not attempt to retrieve any additional record; the Next Page Indicator remains unchanged (effectively indicating no further pages are available), and no 'next page exists' signal is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Next Page Peek When Page is Partially Filled or Has Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the current page was not fully populated with 5 records — either because the end of available authorization data was reached during page loading or because an error occurred — the system does not attempt to peek at an additional record. In this case, the current page is implicitly the last page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is in the process of loading authorization records for the current page, and a row index counter (WS-IDX) is being used to track how many records have been loaded so far for the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row index counter equals 2, meaning the second authorization record for the current page has just been successfully retrieved and is ready to be populated on screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system confirms that a new page has started and proceeds to increment the page counter and save the page navigation key; if the row index is not equal to 2 (i.e., it is the 1st record or the 3rd through 5th record), no page tracking action is taken and loading continues normally

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect New Page Start When Second Authorization Record Is Loaded
all_rules.Rule_Description: When loading authorization records for display, the system must detect when a new page has been confirmed as started. A new page is confirmed only when the second authorization record for that page is successfully loaded, as the first record alone is insufficient to confirm a full page transition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has confirmed that the second authorization record for the current page has been successfully loaded (row index WS-IDX equals 2), and the current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) holds the page number of the previously completed page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The new page confirmation condition is met (WS-IDX = 2)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page counter (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is incremented by exactly 1, so that it now reflects the current page number being displayed to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Page Counter When New Authorization Page Is Confirmed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the second authorization record on a new page is confirmed as loaded, the system must increment the current page number by 1 to accurately reflect the page the user is now viewing. This page number is used for display context and to control backward navigation boundaries.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The page counter (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) has just been incremented to reflect the current page number, and the second authorization record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) for the current page has been successfully retrieved from the Pending Authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row index equals 2 and the page counter has been updated to the current page number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key of the record being processed (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved into the page-key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG) at the index position equal to the current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM), so that when the user presses PF7 to navigate backward, the system can retrieve this key and reposition the authorization list to the correct starting record for that page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Authorization Key of Current Page Into Page-Key History for Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: To enable accurate backward navigation (PF7), the system must record the authorization key associated with the start of each page into a page-key history array. This key is stored at the position corresponding to the current page number, allowing the system to reposition to the correct starting record when the user navigates back to a previously viewed page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved from the authorization database and contains an approved amount value in the field PA-APPROVED-AMT
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is populating a row on the Pending Authorization Summary list screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The approved amount from the authorization record (PA-APPROVED-AMT) is moved into the working storage display amount field (WS-AUTH-AMT) so it is ready to be placed into the appropriate screen row amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Authorization Approved Amount for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When populating an authorization record row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen, the approved amount from the authorization record must be prepared for display by moving it into the display-formatted amount field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and contains an origination time (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) stored as a 6-character string in HHMMSS format (positions 1-2 = hours, positions 3-4 = minutes, positions 5-6 = seconds)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the authorization time for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The hours portion (characters 1-2 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) is placed into positions 1-2 of WS-AUTH-TIME, the minutes portion (characters 3-4 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) is placed into positions 4-5 of WS-AUTH-TIME, and the seconds portion (characters 5-6 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) is placed into positions 7-8 of WS-AUTH-TIME, resulting in a display time formatted as HH:MM:SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Authorization Time from HHMMSS to HH:MM:SS
all_rules.Rule_Description: The raw authorization origination time stored in the database is in HHMMSS format (6 characters, no separators). Before displaying on screen, it must be reformatted into HH:MM:SS format with colon separators for business readability.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and contains an origination date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) stored as a 6-character string in YYMMDD format (positions 1-2 = year, positions 3-4 = month, positions 5-6 = day)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the authorization date for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The year portion (characters 1-2 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) is placed into WS-CURDATE-YY, the month portion (characters 3-4 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) is placed into WS-CURDATE-MM, the day portion (characters 5-6 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) is placed into WS-CURDATE-DD, and the combined formatted date field WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY (which assembles these components as MM/DD/YY) is then moved into WS-AUTH-DATE for display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Authorization Date from YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY
all_rules.Rule_Description: The raw authorization origination date stored in the database is in YYMMDD format (6 characters, no separators). Before displaying on screen, it must be reformatted into MM/DD/YY format with slash separators for business readability.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and contains an authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code to determine the approval status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals '00', the approval status indicator (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is set to 'A' meaning the authorization was Approved; if PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE is any value other than '00', the approval status indicator (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is set to 'D' meaning the authorization was Declined

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Authorization Approval Status as Approved or Declined
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each authorization record carries a response code that indicates whether the authorization was approved or declined. The system must translate this response code into a single-character business status indicator ('A' for Approved, 'D' for Declined) for display on the summary list screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, all display fields (amount, date, time, approval status) have been formatted, and the current row index (WS-IDX) is 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization list row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved to CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(1) for later selection processing; Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) is placed into TRNID01I; formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE) is placed into PDATE01I; formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is placed into PTIME01I; authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) is placed into PTYPE01I; approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is placed into PAPRV01I; match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) is placed into PSTAT01I; approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT) is placed into PAMT001I; and the selection field (SEL0001A) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) so the user can enter a selection value for this row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization List Row 1 with Authorization Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current row index is 1, the first row of the Pending Authorization Summary list must be populated with all relevant authorization details from the retrieved record, and the selection field for that row must be made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, all display fields (amount, date, time, approval status) have been formatted, and the current row index (WS-IDX) is 2
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization list row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved to CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(2) for later selection processing; Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) is placed into TRNID02I; formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE) is placed into PDATE02I; formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is placed into PTIME02I; authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) is placed into PTYPE02I; approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is placed into PAPRV02I; match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) is placed into PSTAT02I; approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT) is placed into PAMT002I; and the selection field (SEL0002A) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) so the user can enter a selection value for this row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization List Row 2 with Authorization Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current row index is 2, the second row of the Pending Authorization Summary list must be populated with all relevant authorization details from the retrieved record, and the selection field for that row must be made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, all display fields (amount, date, time, approval status) have been formatted, and the current row index (WS-IDX) is 3
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization list row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved to CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(3) for later selection processing; Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) is placed into TRNID03I; formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE) is placed into PDATE03I; formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is placed into PTIME03I; authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) is placed into PTYPE03I; approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is placed into PAPRV03I; match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) is placed into PSTAT03I; approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT) is placed into PAMT003I; and the selection field (SEL0003A) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) so the user can enter a selection value for this row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization List Row 3 with Authorization Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current row index is 3, the third row of the Pending Authorization Summary list must be populated with all relevant authorization details from the retrieved record, and the selection field for that row must be made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, all display fields (amount, date, time, approval status) have been formatted, and the current row index (WS-IDX) is 4
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization list row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved to CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(4) for later selection processing; Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) is placed into TRNID04I; formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE) is placed into PDATE04I; formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is placed into PTIME04I; authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) is placed into PTYPE04I; approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is placed into PAPRV04I; match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) is placed into PSTAT04I; approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT) is placed into PAMT004I; and the selection field (SEL0004A) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) so the user can enter a selection value for this row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization List Row 4 with Authorization Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current row index is 4, the fourth row of the Pending Authorization Summary list must be populated with all relevant authorization details from the retrieved record, and the selection field for that row must be made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, all display fields (amount, date, time, approval status) have been formatted, and the current row index (WS-IDX) is 5
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization list row on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved to CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(5) for later selection processing; Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) is placed into TRNID05I; formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE) is placed into PDATE05I; formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is placed into PTIME05I; authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) is placed into PTYPE05I; approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is placed into PAPRV05I; match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) is placed into PSTAT05I; approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT) is placed into PAMT005I; and the selection field (SEL0005A) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) so the user can enter a selection value for this row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization List Row 5 with Authorization Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current row index is 5, the fifth row of the Pending Authorization Summary list must be populated with all relevant authorization details from the retrieved record, and the selection field for that row must be made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record row (1 through 5) on the Pending Authorization Summary screen has been fully populated with transaction ID, date, time, authorization type, approval status, match status, and amount
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row population process completes for that row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection field attribute for that row (SEL0001A through SEL0005A corresponding to the row number) is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP), meaning the field becomes editable and the user is able to type a selection value (such as 'S') next to that authorization record to select it for further action

all_rules.Rule_Name: Enable User Selection on Each Populated Authorization Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once an authorization row has been fully populated with its details, the selection input field for that row must be activated so the user can enter a selection character to act on that specific authorization record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination date stored in YYMMDD format (e.g., '240315' representing year 24, month 03, day 15)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the first two characters (positions 1-2) of the raw authorization origination date field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit year value (e.g., '24') is placed into the year component of the display date working field (WS-CURDATE-YY), making it available for assembly into the final MM/DD/YY display format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Year Component from Raw Authorization Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system extracts the two-digit year from the raw authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format to prepare it for display formatting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination date stored in YYMMDD format (e.g., '240315' representing year 24, month 03, day 15)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 3-4 of the raw authorization origination date field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit month value (e.g., '03') is placed into the month component of the display date working field (WS-CURDATE-MM), making it available for assembly into the final MM/DD/YY display format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Month Component from Raw Authorization Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system extracts the two-digit month from the raw authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format to prepare it for display formatting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination date stored in YYMMDD format (e.g., '240315' representing year 24, month 03, day 15)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 5-6 of the raw authorization origination date field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit day value (e.g., '15') is placed into the day component of the display date working field (WS-CURDATE-DD), making it available for assembly into the final MM/DD/YY display format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Day Component from Raw Authorization Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system extracts the two-digit day from the raw authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format to prepare it for display formatting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The year (WS-CURDATE-YY), month (WS-CURDATE-MM), and day (WS-CURDATE-DD) components have been individually extracted from the raw authorization origination date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system assembles the three date components using the pre-structured display date field (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) which arranges them in MM/DD/YY order
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fully formatted display date (e.g., '03/15/24') is stored in the authorization display date field (WS-AUTH-DATE) and is ready to be shown on the Pending Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assemble Authorization Date into MM/DD/YY Display Format
all_rules.Rule_Description: After extracting the individual year, month, and day components from the raw YYMMDD date, the system assembles them into the standard MM/DD/YY display format for presentation on the authorization list screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination time stored in HHMMSS format (e.g., '143022' representing 14 hours, 30 minutes, 22 seconds)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the first two characters (positions 1-2) of the raw authorization origination time field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit hours value (e.g., '14') is placed at display positions 1-2 of the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), forming the hours portion of the HH:MM:SS formatted time

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Hours Component from Raw Authorization Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system extracts the two-digit hours value from the raw authorization origination time stored in HHMMSS format and places it at the beginning of the display time field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination time stored in HHMMSS format (e.g., '143022' representing 14 hours, 30 minutes, 22 seconds)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 3-4 of the raw authorization origination time field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit minutes value (e.g., '30') is placed at display positions 4-5 of the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), positioned after the first colon separator, forming the minutes portion of the HH:MM:SS formatted time (e.g., 'HH:30:SS')

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Minutes Component from Raw Authorization Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system extracts the two-digit minutes value from the raw authorization origination time stored in HHMMSS format and places it at display positions 4-5, after the first colon separator in the HH:MM:SS format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record exists with a raw origination time stored in HHMMSS format (e.g., '143022' representing 14 hours, 30 minutes, 22 seconds)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads characters at positions 5-6 of the raw authorization origination time field (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit seconds value (e.g., '22') is placed at display positions 7-8 of the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), positioned after the second colon separator, forming the seconds portion of the HH:MM:SS formatted time (e.g., 'HH:MM:22')

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Seconds Component from Raw Authorization Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system extracts the two-digit seconds value from the raw authorization origination time stored in HHMMSS format and places it at display positions 7-8, after the second colon separator in the HH:MM:SS format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The hours, minutes, and seconds components have been individually extracted from the raw HHMMSS authorization origination time and placed into their respective positions within the display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME), with colon separators pre-existing at positions 3 and 6 of the display field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All three time components (hours at positions 1-2, minutes at positions 4-5, seconds at positions 7-8) have been moved into the authorization display time field (WS-AUTH-TIME)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fully formatted display time (e.g., '14:30:22') is available in WS-AUTH-TIME and is ready to be shown on the Pending Authorization Summary screen alongside the corresponding authorization record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assembled Authorization Time in HH:MM:SS Display Format
all_rules.Rule_Description: After placing hours at positions 1-2, minutes at positions 4-5, and seconds at positions 7-8 of the display time field, the authorization time is fully assembled in HH:MM:SS format with colon separators at positions 3 and 6, ready for screen display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved from the Pending Authorization Details data store and the Authorization Response Code field (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is available for evaluation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Authorization Response Code to determine the outcome of the authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Authorization Response Code equals '00', the system sets the Approval Status display indicator to 'A' (Approved); if the Authorization Response Code is any value other than '00', the system sets the Approval Status display indicator to 'D' (Declined); the resulting status indicator is then populated into the corresponding row on the Authorization Summary List screen for user display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Derive Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: When populating the authorization list for display, the system must determine and set the approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the pending authorization details. A response code of '00' indicates the authorization was approved; any other response code indicates the authorization was declined. The resulting status indicator ('A' or 'D') is then displayed on the Authorization Summary List screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Main Menu program (COMEN01C) as the target for navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Destination to Main Menu Program on PF3
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 on the Authorization Summary screen, the system sets the intended destination program to the Main Menu program so that navigation can proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 to return to the previous screen and the system is preparing to transfer control
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The destination program name is blank or contains no value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system overrides the destination and sets it to the Sign-On program (COSGN00C) as the fallback navigation target

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default to Sign-On Program When Main Menu Program Name is Not Set
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before transferring control, the system validates that the destination program name is populated. If the destination program name is blank or not set, the system defaults the destination to the Sign-On program to ensure the user is always navigated to a valid screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and the destination program has been determined (either Main Menu or Sign-On as fallback)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is preparing to transfer control to the destination program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the Authorization Summary program name as the originating program in the session data, and resets the program context to zero, so the destination program knows which screen initiated the navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Authorization Summary Screen as the Originating Program
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before transferring control to the destination program, the system records the current Authorization Summary screen as the originating program in the session information. This allows the destination program to know where the navigation originated from and enables return navigation if needed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The destination program has been set to Main Menu (or Sign-On as fallback) and the current Authorization Summary screen has been recorded as the originating program in the session data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the navigation transfer
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system transfers complete control to the destination program and passes the full session information (including account ID, card number, customer ID, originating program name, and transaction ID) so the destination screen is displayed with all relevant context intact

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transfer Control to Destination Program with Session Information
all_rules.Rule_Description: After setting the destination and recording the originating program, the system transfers full control to the destination program (Main Menu or Sign-On fallback), passing along the complete session information so that user context, account data, and navigation history are preserved across the screen transition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and has pressed a function key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the key pressed against the list of supported keys: ENTER (submit/search), PF3 (return to menu), PF7 (page backward), and PF8 (page forward)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the key is one of ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8, the system proceeds with the corresponding normal processing; if the key is any other key, the system routes to invalid key error handling

all_rules.Rule_Name: Supported Function Key Identification
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Authorization Summary screen only accepts four specific function keys: ENTER, PF3, PF7, and PF8. Any other key pressed by the user is considered unsupported and triggers error handling.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag (WS-ERR-FLG) to 'Y' to indicate an error condition is active, and positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Key Error Flag Activation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses an unsupported function key on the Pending Authorization Summary screen, the system activates an error condition flag to indicate that an invalid action was attempted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed an unsupported function key on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the error flag has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the error message for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system assigns the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) to the screen message field (WS-MESSAGE), which will be shown in the error message area of the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Key Error Message Assignment
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unsupported function key is pressed, the system assigns a standardized invalid key error message to be displayed to the user on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed an unsupported function key, the error flag is set to 'Y', and the invalid key error message has been assigned to the message field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen back to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system redisplays the Pending Authorization Summary screen (MAP COPAU0A, MAPSET COPAU00) with the invalid key error message shown in the error message area, the cursor positioned on the Account ID field, and all previously displayed account summary and authorization list data retained on the screen; the screen is sent without a full erase so existing data is preserved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Summary Screen Redisplay with Invalid Key Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: After detecting an unsupported key press, the system redisplays the Pending Authorization Summary screen with the error message visible, preserving all previously displayed account and authorization data so the user can take a valid action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Pending Authorization Summary screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen header population process is triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current system date and time using the built-in current date function and stores it in the working storage date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA) for subsequent formatting and display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating the screen header, the system retrieves the current system date and time to ensure the header reflects the real-time values at the moment the screen is sent to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has retrieved the current date and time and is populating the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The application title fields on the screen header are being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets Title Line 1 (TITLE01O) on the screen header from the application-defined constant CCDA-TITLE01, and sets Title Line 2 (TITLE02O) on the screen header from the application-defined constant CCDA-TITLE02

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Application Title Lines on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the standard application title lines (Title Line 1 and Title Line 2) sourced from the centrally defined application constants, ensuring consistent branding across all screens.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating the screen header for the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction identifier field on the screen header is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Transaction Name field (TRNNAMEO) on the screen header to the current CICS transaction ID (WS-CICS-TRANID)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Transaction ID on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the current CICS transaction identifier so that users and support staff can identify the active transaction associated with the displayed screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating the screen header for the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program name field on the screen header is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Program Name field (PGMNAMEO) on the screen header to the Authorization Summary program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Program Name on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the name of the currently executing program so that users and support staff can identify which program is serving the current screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has retrieved the current system date stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA containing month (WS-CURDATE-MONTH), day (WS-CURDATE-DAY), and four-digit year (WS-CURDATE-YEAR)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current date is being formatted for display on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the month into WS-CURDATE-MM, the day into WS-CURDATE-DD, and the last two digits of the year (positions 3 and 4 of WS-CURDATE-YEAR) into WS-CURDATE-YY, composing the date in MM/DD/YY format stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Date as MM/DD/YY for Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current date retrieved from the system must be reformatted into the standard MM/DD/YY display format before being placed on the screen header. The year component uses only the last two digits of the four-digit year.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current date has been formatted into MM/DD/YY format and stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The date field on the screen header is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Current Date field (CURDATEO) on the screen header to the formatted date value from WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Formatted Date on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: After formatting the current date into MM/DD/YY format, the system places the formatted date value into the designated date display field on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has retrieved the current system time stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA containing hours (WS-CURTIME-HOURS), minutes (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE), and seconds (WS-CURTIME-SECOND)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current time is being formatted for display on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the hours into WS-CURTIME-HH, the minutes into WS-CURTIME-MM, and the seconds into WS-CURTIME-SS, composing the time in HH:MM:SS format stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Time as HH:MM:SS for Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current time retrieved from the system must be reformatted into the standard HH:MM:SS display format before being placed on the screen header, extracting hours, minutes, and seconds into separate components.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current time has been formatted into HH:MM:SS format and stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The time field on the screen header is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Current Time field (CURTIMEO) on the screen header to the formatted time value from WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Formatted Time on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: After formatting the current time into HH:MM:SS format, the system places the formatted time value into the designated time display field on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Pending Authorization Summary screen (COPAU0A) to the user under any condition — whether it is an initial display, a response to ENTER, PF3, PF7, PF8, or an error condition
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The SEND-PAULST-SCREEN routine is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system always invokes the POPULATE-HEADER-INFO routine as the first step before sending the screen, ensuring the header fields (application title, transaction ID, program name, current date in MM/DD/YY, and current time in HH:MM:SS) are refreshed with current values on every screen send

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invoke Screen Header Population Before Every Screen Send
