all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header population routine must be invoked every time the Pending Authorization Summary screen is sent to the user, ensuring that the header always reflects the most current date, time, transaction, and program information at the moment of display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to send the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen header population routine is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen header must be populated with: (1) Application Title Line 1 from the application title constant (CCDA-TITLE01) displayed in the first title field, (2) Application Title Line 2 from the application title constant (CCDA-TITLE02) displayed in the second title field, (3) the current Transaction ID displayed in the transaction name field, (4) the Authorization Summary Program Name displayed in the program name field, (5) the current system date formatted as MM/DD/YY displayed in the current date field, and (6) the current system time formatted as HH:MM:SS displayed in the current time field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Screen Header with Application Identification and Current Date/Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before sending the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal, the system populates the screen header area with the application titles, the current transaction identifier, the program name, and the current system date and time formatted for display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has a current message stored in the working message field (WS-MESSAGE), which may contain an error message such as 'Please enter Acct Id...', 'Acct Id must be Numeric...', 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S', 'You are already at the top of the page...', 'You are already at the bottom of the page...', 'Invalid key', or may be blank spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to send the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The content of the current working message field is transferred to the screen error/message output field (ERRMSGO), so that the message is visible to the user on the displayed screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current System Message in Screen Message Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before sending the Authorization Summary screen, the system moves the current working message (which may contain validation errors, informational messages, or be blank) into the screen's designated message/error display area so the user can see relevant feedback.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary screen is ready to be sent to the user terminal, AND the display mode is set to 'First Display' (SEND-ERASE-YES), which occurs in the following situations: (1) the very first time the screen is accessed with no prior session data, (2) the first re-entry into this program when called from another program with a valid account ID already loaded
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen is transmitted to the terminal using a full ERASE command, which completely clears the entire terminal screen before displaying the Authorization Summary screen content, with the cursor positioned at the Account ID input field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Send Authorization Summary Screen with Full Erase on First Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Authorization Summary screen is being displayed for the first time in a session, or when the user navigates to this screen from another program, the system sends the screen using a full erase command that completely clears the terminal before rendering the new screen content.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary screen is ready to be sent to the user terminal, AND the display mode is set to 'Overlay' (SEND-ERASE-NO), which occurs in the following situations: (1) the user pressed PF7 to navigate to the previous page of authorizations, (2) the user pressed PF8 to navigate to the next page of authorizations
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Summary screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen is transmitted to the terminal without a full ERASE command, updating only the changed fields over the existing screen content (overlay mode), with the cursor positioned at the Account ID input field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Send Authorization Summary Screen as Overlay on Subsequent Displays
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Authorization Summary screen is being refreshed due to user interaction such as pagination (PF7 backward or PF8 forward navigation) or re-entry after prior display, the system sends the screen as an overlay that updates only the changed fields over the existing terminal screen, without clearing the entire screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates the account details lookup process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system searches the Card Cross-Reference file using the entered Account ID as the search key to retrieve the associated Customer ID and Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Account in Card Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account details are requested, the system must first locate the account in the Card Cross-Reference file using the entered Account ID to retrieve the associated Customer ID and Card Number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered an Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen and the system has searched the Card Cross-Reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Card Cross-Reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Account: [Account ID] not found in XREF file' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account detail retrieval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Not Found in Card Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the entered Account ID does not exist in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system must notify the user with a descriptive message identifying the Account ID that was not found and stop further processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Card Cross-Reference file using the entered Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is found in the Card Cross-Reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves and stores the Customer ID (XREF-CUST-ID) and Card Number (XREF-CARD-NUM) from the cross-reference record for use in subsequent account and customer data lookups

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Customer ID and Card Number from Cross-Reference
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system retrieves and stores the associated Customer ID and Card Number for use in subsequent lookups.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully retrieved the Customer ID and Card Number from the Card Cross-Reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system proceeds to retrieve account financial details
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system searches the Account Master file using the Account ID from the cross-reference record (XREF-ACCT-ID) as the search key

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Account in Account Master File
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully retrieving the Customer ID and Card Number from the Card Cross-Reference file, the system must look up the account in the Account Master file to retrieve financial details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Account Master file using the Account ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the Account Master file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Account: [Account ID] not found in ACCT file' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account detail retrieval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Not Found in Account Master File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID does not exist in the Account Master file, the system must notify the user with a descriptive message identifying the Account ID that was not found and stop further processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Account Master file using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is found in the Account Master file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Credit Limit (ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT) and Cash Credit Limit (ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT) from the account record and prepares them for display on the summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit from Account Master
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID is successfully found in the Account Master file, the system retrieves the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit to display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully retrieved the Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit from the Account Master file and has the Customer ID from the Card Cross-Reference record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system proceeds to retrieve customer personal details
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system searches the Customer Master file using the Customer ID (XREF-CUST-ID) from the cross-reference record as the search key

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Customer in Customer Master File
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully retrieving account financial details, the system must look up the customer in the Customer Master file using the Customer ID obtained from the Card Cross-Reference to retrieve personal details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Customer Master file using the Customer ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Customer ID is not found in the Customer Master file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Customer: [Customer ID] not found in CUST file' on the screen, positions the cursor back to the Account ID input field, and stops further account detail retrieval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Customer Not Found in Customer Master File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Customer ID does not exist in the Customer Master file, the system must notify the user with a descriptive message identifying the Customer ID that was not found and stop further processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully found the customer record in the Customer Master file using the Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system retrieves customer personal details
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system formats and prepares the following for display: (1) Customer ID, (2) Full name composed of First Name, Middle Name initial, and Last Name separated by spaces, (3) Address Line 1 combined with Address Line 2 separated by a comma, (4) Address Line 3 combined with State Code and first 5 digits of ZIP code each separated by commas, and (5) Primary Phone Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve and Format Customer Name, Address, and Phone Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Customer ID is successfully found in the Customer Master file, the system retrieves and formats the customer's full name, address lines, and phone number for display on the Pending Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates the account details lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must execute the lookups in the following mandatory sequence: (1) Look up Account ID in Card Cross-Reference file to get Customer ID and Card Number, (2) Look up Account ID in Account Master file to get Credit Limit and Cash Credit Limit, (3) Look up Customer ID in Customer Master file to get Name, Address, and Phone — and if any step fails with a 'not found' condition, the system stops processing and displays the appropriate not-found message without proceeding to the next step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Account Details Lookup Process
all_rules.Rule_Description: The account details lookup must follow a strict sequential order: Card Cross-Reference lookup first, then Account Master lookup, then Customer Master lookup. Each step depends on the successful completion of the prior step.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed retrieval of account, customer, and card cross-reference details for a given Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether a Pending Authorization Summary segment exists for the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If a Pending Authorization Summary segment is found, the system proceeds to display actual authorization counts, balances, and amounts from that record; if no summary segment is found, the system proceeds to display zero values for all authorization summary fields

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Authorization Summary Display Based on Record Existence
all_rules.Rule_Description: After retrieving account details, the system checks whether a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the given account. Based on this check, the system either displays actual summary values or defaults all fields to zero.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count field on the screen (APPRCNTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Approved Authorization Count from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the count of approved authorizations sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count field on the screen (DECLCNTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Declined Authorization Count from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the count of declined authorizations sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Credit Balance field on the screen (CREDBALO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-CREDIT-BALANCE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Credit Balance from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the current credit balance sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-CREDIT-BALANCE.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Cash Balance field on the screen (CASHBALO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-CASH-BALANCE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Cash Balance from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the current cash balance sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-CASH-BALANCE.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Approved Authorization Amount field on the screen (APPRAMTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Approved Authorization Amount from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the total approved authorization amount sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary segment has been found for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization summary section of the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Declined Authorization Amount field on the screen (DECLAMTO) is populated with the value from the Pending Authorization Summary record field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Declined Authorization Amount from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system displays the total declined authorization amount sourced from the Pending Authorization Summary segment field PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed retrieval of account, customer, and card cross-reference details for a given Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No Pending Authorization Summary segment is found for the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All six authorization summary fields on the screen are set to zero: Approved Authorization Count (APPRCNTO) = 0, Declined Authorization Count (DECLCNTO) = 0, Current Credit Balance (CREDBALO) = 0, Current Cash Balance (CASHBALO) = 0, Total Approved Authorization Amount (APPRAMTO) = 0, and Total Declined Authorization Amount (DECLAMTO) = 0

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default All Authorization Summary Fields to Zero When No Summary Record Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Pending Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the system defaults all six authorization summary display fields to zero, ensuring the screen does not show blank or misleading values for counts, balances, and amounts.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records onto the screen in PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, and the row index (WS-IDX) has just been incremented to 2 after populating the first record of a new page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The second authorization record is about to be populated (WS-IDX equals 2) and no errors have occurred and records are still available
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is incremented by 1 to reflect that a new page of authorization records is now being displayed to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Page Number When Loading Authorization Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: When loading authorization records onto the screen, the system increments the page counter when the second record of a new page is populated, ensuring the page number accurately reflects the current page being viewed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records in PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, the row index (WS-IDX) equals 2, and the page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) has just been incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first authorization record of the new page has been successfully retrieved and its key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key of the first record on this page is stored in the page key history array at the position corresponding to the current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM), making it available for backward navigation via PF7

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save First Authorization Key of Each Page for Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the second authorization record on a page is populated (confirming a new page has started), the system saves the authorization key of the first record of that page into the page key history, enabling the user to navigate backward to any previously visited page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records in PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD and an authorization record has been successfully retrieved and populated on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each authorization record is successfully populated (AUTHS-NOT-EOF and ERR-FLG-OFF), and the row index is incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key of the most recently populated record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved to CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST, overwriting any previously saved last key, so that the last key always reflects the final authorization record shown on the current page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Last Authorization Key Displayed on Current Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: As each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the system continuously updates the last authorization key tracker with the key of the most recently displayed record, so that forward pagination can resume from the correct position.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has finished populating up to 5 authorization records on the current page in PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, and no errors have occurred and records were not exhausted during the page fill
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An additional authorization record retrieval is attempted beyond the 5 displayed records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the additional record is found (AUTHS-NOT-EOF and ERR-FLG-OFF), the next-page flag is set to NEXT-PAGE-YES indicating more records are available and PF8 forward navigation is enabled; if no additional record is found, the next-page flag is set to NEXT-PAGE-NO indicating the user is on the last page and PF8 forward navigation is disabled

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Whether a Next Page of Authorizations Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling up to 5 authorization records on the current page, the system peeks at the next record in the database to determine whether additional authorization records exist, and sets the next-page flag accordingly to control whether PF8 (forward navigation) is available to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in one of the five selection fields (SEL0001I through SEL0005I) on the Authorization Summary screen, and the Account ID entered is valid and numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first non-blank selection field is identified among SEL0001I through SEL0005I (evaluated in order from 1 to 5), and the corresponding authorization key exists in the session key array (CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS at position 1 through 5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key corresponding to the selected row (CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS at the matching position) is stored in CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED in the communication area, making it available to the Authorization Detail program

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Selected Authorization Key When User Selects a Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters 'S' in the selection field next to an authorization record, the system saves the authorization key of that selected record into the session, enabling the Authorization Detail screen to retrieve and display the correct record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-blank, non-low-values value in one of the five selection fields (SEL0001I through SEL0005I) on the Authorization Summary screen, and the Account ID is valid and numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first non-blank selection field is identified among SEL0001I through SEL0005I (evaluated in order from 1 to 5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The value entered by the user in that selection field is stored in CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG in the communication area; if no selection field contains a non-blank value, both CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG and CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED are set to SPACES

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save User Selection Flag Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters a value in a selection field next to an authorization record, the system saves the actual value entered by the user into the session selection flag, which is subsequently validated to ensure only 'S' is accepted as a valid selection.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 to navigate forward, and CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST contains a non-blank, non-low-values authorization key from the previously displayed page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system repositions to the saved last authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE set from CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) and loads the next page of authorization records via PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST is updated to the authorization key of the last record successfully populated on the newly displayed page, and the next-page flag is updated to reflect whether further records exist beyond the new page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Last Authorization Key After Forward Page Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates forward using PF8, the system repositions to the last known authorization key and loads the next page of records, continuously updating the last authorization key to reflect the final record displayed on the newly loaded page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST is not blank or low-values, and the system has successfully repositioned and loaded the next page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD completes loading up to 5 records and performs a peek-ahead read for an additional record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If an additional record exists beyond the 5 displayed, NEXT-PAGE-YES is set enabling further PF8 navigation; if no additional record exists, NEXT-PAGE-NO is set and the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' will be shown on the subsequent PF8 press; if CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST was blank or low-values when PF8 was pressed, NEXT-PAGE-NO remains and the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' is displayed immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Next-Page Flag After Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the user navigates forward using PF8 and a new page of authorization records is loaded, the system checks whether additional records exist beyond the newly displayed page and updates the next-page flag to control whether further forward navigation is available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to navigate backward and the current page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is greater than 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward navigation is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is reduced by 1 (COMPUTE CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM = CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM - 1), and the system proceeds to retrieve the saved page key for the new (decremented) page number to reposition the authorization list

all_rules.Rule_Name: Decrement Page Number on Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7 to navigate backward and the current page is greater than 1, the system decrements the page counter by one to reflect the page the user is returning to.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7, the current page number was greater than 1, and the page number has been decremented by 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system looks up the page key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG) at the position of the newly decremented page number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key stored at that position is retrieved into WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE, which is then used to reposition the authorization record retrieval to the start of the target page via REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Prior Page Key for Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating backward, the system retrieves the saved first authorization key for the target page from the page key history, enabling accurate repositioning to the beginning of the previously viewed page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7, the page number was greater than 1, the page number has been decremented, and the prior page key has been retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward navigation setup is complete and the system is about to reload the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next-page flag is set to NEXT-PAGE-YES, confirming that forward navigation (PF8) will be available after the previous page is displayed, since the user has moved back and records exist ahead

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Next-Page Flag to Yes After Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates backward to a previous page, the system automatically sets the next-page flag to indicate that a next page exists, since moving backward always means there are records ahead (the page the user just came from).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Any screen interaction has completed — whether the user browsed records, selected a record, navigated forward with PF8, or navigated backward with PF7 — and all relevant session state fields (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM, CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG array, CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST, next-page flag, CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED, CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG) have been updated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program returns control to CICS using EXEC CICS RETURN with TRANSID and COMMAREA
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entire CARDDEMO-COMMAREA — containing all updated session state fields — is passed back to CICS and stored, making all state available when the user next interacts with the screen so that pagination, selection, and navigation can continue seamlessly from where the user left off

all_rules.Rule_Name: Persist All Session State to Communication Area for Next Interaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the end of every screen interaction, the system returns all session state — including page number, page key history, last authorization key, next-page flag, selected authorization key, and selection flag — to CICS within the communication area, ensuring all state is preserved and available for the next user interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID is available in the current session and account details are being gathered for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system queries the Authorization Summary database using the Account ID as the search key against the PAUTSUM0 root segment
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Authorization Summary record for that Account ID, and the result is flagged as either Found or Not Found for subsequent processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Authorization Summary Record by Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account details are being gathered, the system uses the Account ID to query the Authorization Summary database (PAUTSUM0 root segment) to retrieve the pending authorization summary for that account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary database has been queried using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the database query
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Authorization Summary record is found for the Account ID, the system proceeds to retrieve and display the six actual summary values (Approved Count, Declined Count, Credit Balance, Cash Balance, Approved Amount, Declined Amount); if no record is found for the Account ID, the system sets all six summary values to zero and displays them on screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Authorization Summary Record Existence
all_rules.Rule_Description: After querying the Authorization Summary database, the system determines whether a summary record exists for the given Account ID and routes processing accordingly — either to display actual values or to display zeros.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Approved Authorization Count field (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count value is formatted and populated into the Approved Count display field (APPRCNTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Approved Authorization Count from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total count of approved authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Declined Authorization Count field (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count value is formatted and populated into the Declined Count display field (DECLCNTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Declined Authorization Count from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total count of declined authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Credit Balance field (PA-CREDIT-BALANCE) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Credit Balance value is formatted as a 12-digit amount and populated into the Credit Balance display field (CREDBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Current Credit Balance from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the current credit balance from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Cash Balance field (PA-CASH-BALANCE) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Cash Balance value is formatted as a 9-digit amount and populated into the Cash Balance display field (CASHBALO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Current Cash Balance from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the current cash balance from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Approved Authorization Amount field (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Approved Authorization Amount value is formatted as a 9-digit amount and populated into the Approved Amount display field (APPRAMTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Total Approved Authorization Amount from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total monetary amount of all approved authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 database segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Declined Authorization Amount field (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT) from the retrieved Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Declined Authorization Amount value is formatted as a 9-digit amount and populated into the Declined Amount display field (DECLAMTO) on the Authorization Summary screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Total Declined Authorization Amount from Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, the system retrieves the total monetary amount of all declined authorizations from the summary record for display on the Authorization Summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record has been found for the Account ID and all six values — Approved Authorization Count, Declined Authorization Count, Current Credit Balance, Current Cash Balance, Total Approved Authorization Amount, and Total Declined Authorization Amount — have been retrieved from the summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen with the retrieved values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All six values are displayed on the Authorization Summary screen: Approved Count in APPRCNTO, Declined Count in DECLCNTO, Credit Balance in CREDBALO, Cash Balance in CASHBALO, Approved Amount in APPRAMTO, and Declined Amount in DECLAMTO

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display All Six Authorization Summary Values When Record Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Summary record is found for the account, all six retrieved summary values are displayed together on the Authorization Summary screen, providing a complete financial and authorization activity overview for the account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary database has been queried using the Account ID and no Authorization Summary record was found for that Account ID in the PAUTSUM0 segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that no summary record exists for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets all six summary display fields to zero: Approved Authorization Count (APPRCNTO) = 0, Declined Authorization Count (DECLCNTO) = 0, Current Credit Balance (CREDBALO) = 0, Current Cash Balance (CASHBALO) = 0, Total Approved Authorization Amount (APPRAMTO) = 0, and Total Declined Authorization Amount (DECLAMTO) = 0

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set All Authorization Summary Values to Zero When No Record Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Authorization Summary record exists for the given Account ID in the database, the system sets all six authorization summary display values to zero, ensuring the screen shows meaningful default values rather than blank or undefined data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No Authorization Summary record was found for the Account ID and all six summary fields have been set to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Summary screen with the zero values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All six Authorization Summary fields on the screen display zero: Approved Count = 0, Declined Count = 0, Credit Balance = 0, Cash Balance = 0, Approved Amount = 0, and Declined Amount = 0, providing a complete screen display even in the absence of authorization activity for the account

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Zero Values for Authorization Summary When No Record Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no Authorization Summary record exists for the account, the screen displays zero values for all six authorization summary fields, ensuring the user sees a complete and consistent screen layout with no blank or undefined fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to load a page of pending authorization records for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization list loading process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The row counter is set to 1 and the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is cleared to LOW-VALUES, ensuring no stale key references remain from a prior page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Authorization List Loading
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before loading authorization records onto the screen, the system initializes the row counter to 1 and clears the last displayed authorization key tracker to prepare for a fresh page load.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is in the process of loading authorization records for the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each iteration of the loading loop is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The loop continues loading records only if the row counter is 5 or less AND more authorization records exist (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) AND no error condition has been raised (ERR-FLG-OFF); the loop terminates when the row counter exceeds 5, or no more records are available, or an error occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization List Page Loading Loop Termination Condition
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system continues loading authorization records onto the screen until either 5 rows have been filled or there are no more authorization records available for the account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records for a page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current action is a PF7 (backward navigation) request AND the row counter is at position 1 (first row)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system repositions the database cursor to the saved page key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) before fetching the first record; for all subsequent rows (row counter > 1) or for any action other than PF7, the system fetches the next sequential authorization record without repositioning

all_rules.Rule_Name: Backward Navigation Cursor Repositioning on First Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates backward (PF7) to a previous page, the system must reposition the database cursor to the saved starting key of that page before fetching records, but only on the very first row of the page load.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to navigate to a previous page AND the system is processing the first row of the page load
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system repositions the database cursor using the saved page key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) as the search key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) against the pending authorization detail segment (PAUTDTL1)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the record matching the saved key is found, the system sets the record availability indicator to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) and proceeds to populate the row; if the record is not found or the end of data is reached, the system sets the indicator to 'no more records' (AUTHS-EOF)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reposition Database Cursor to Saved Page Key for Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating backward to a previous page, the system repositions the authorization record cursor to the specific authorization key that was saved as the starting point of that page, enabling accurate backward page navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is loading authorization records for the current page AND the action is not a PF7 backward navigation on the first row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system fetches the next authorization record from the pending authorization detail segment (PAUTDTL1) using a sequential get-next-within-parent (GNP) database call
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If a record is successfully retrieved, the system sets the record availability indicator to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) and the record data (transaction ID, dates, amounts, response codes, match status, auth type) is available for display; if no more records exist or end of data is reached, the system sets the indicator to 'no more records' (AUTHS-EOF)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Fetch Next Sequential Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: During normal forward page loading, the system sequentially fetches the next pending authorization detail record for the account from the authorization database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved with an origination date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) in YYMMDD format and an origination time (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) in HHMMSS format
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the authorization data for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The date is reformatted by mapping positions 1-2 (YY) to the year portion, positions 3-4 (MM) to the month portion, and positions 5-6 (DD) to the day portion, producing a display date (WS-AUTH-DATE) in MM/DD/YY format; the time is reformatted by mapping positions 1-2 (HH) to hours, positions 3-4 (MM) to minutes, and positions 5-6 (SS) to seconds, producing a display time (WS-AUTH-TIME) in HH:MM:SS format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Date Format Conversion
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format and the origination time stored in HHMMSS format must be reformatted into user-friendly display formats MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS respectively before being shown on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved with an authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the response code to determine the approval outcome
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the response code equals '00', the approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT) is set to 'A' indicating Approved; if the response code is any value other than '00', the approval status is set to 'D' indicating Declined

all_rules.Rule_Name: Derive Authorization Approval Status from Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system derives a single-character approval status indicator for each authorization record based on the authorization response code stored in the database, translating it into a business-meaningful approved or declined status for display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and its date, time, and approval status have been formatted
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the screen row corresponding to the current row counter (WS-IDX, values 1 through 5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For the row matching the current row counter, the system displays: Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID → TRNIDnn), formatted date (WS-AUTH-DATE → PDATEnn), formatted time (WS-AUTH-TIME → PTIMEnn), authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE → PTYPEnn), derived approval status (WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT → PAPRVnn), match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS → PSTATnn), and approved amount (WS-AUTH-AMT → PAMTnnn); the authorization key is also saved to the session key array (CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(n)) for that row position; the selection field (SELnnnnA) for that row is set to unprotected (DFHBMUNP) allowing the user to enter a selection value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Record Row on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully retrieved authorization record is displayed in its corresponding row on the pending authorization summary screen, showing all relevant authorization details and enabling the row's selection field for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and populated onto the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes populating a row with authorization data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization key of the just-displayed record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved as the last displayed key on the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST), overwriting any previously saved last key; this key is updated after every successfully displayed row so it always reflects the key of the last record shown on the page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Track Last Displayed Authorization Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each authorization record is successfully displayed on screen, the system saves its authorization key as the last displayed key on the current page. This key is used to determine the starting point for the next page when the user navigates forward.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Authorization records are being loaded onto the screen and a record has just been successfully populated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row counter after incrementing equals 2 (meaning the record just displayed was the first record, and the second slot is now being prepared — i.e., WS-IDX = 2 after COMPUTE WS-IDX = WS-IDX + 1)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page number (CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM) is incremented by 1, and the authorization key of the first record on this page (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) is saved into the page key history array at the current page number position (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)), enabling the system to reposition to the start of this page during backward navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Page Start Key and Increment Page Number for Second Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the second authorization record on a page is successfully displayed, the system increments the page number and saves the authorization key of the first record on this page. This saved key enables accurate backward navigation (PF7) to return to the beginning of this page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved and populated onto the current screen row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes populating the current row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The row counter (WS-IDX) is incremented by 1 (COMPUTE WS-IDX = WS-IDX + 1), moving the pointer to the next available row position for the subsequent record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Advance Row Counter After Each Record Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each authorization record is successfully populated on the screen, the row counter is incremented by 1 to advance to the next available display row.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization record loading loop has completed either by filling all 5 rows or by exhausting available records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the end-of-loop condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If all 5 rows were filled (AUTHS-NOT-EOF is true and ERR-FLG-OFF is true after the loop), the system proceeds to peek at the next record to determine if more pages exist; if fewer than 5 rows were filled because no more records were available, the system skips the peek and proceeds directly to display the screen without setting a next-page indicator

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check Whether All Five Display Rows Are Filled
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the loading loop completes, the system determines whether all 5 display rows were filled with authorization records or whether the loop ended early due to no more records being available, in order to decide whether to check for additional pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All 5 authorization rows on the current page have been successfully populated AND no error condition exists
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a lookahead by fetching the next sequential authorization record from the pending authorization detail segment (PAUTDTL1)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fetch result is used solely to set the next-page availability indicator; the fetched record data is not displayed on screen; if a record is found, the next-page indicator is set to YES; if no record is found, the next-page indicator is set to NO

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek at Next Record to Determine Additional Pages Availability
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling all 5 display rows, the system performs a lookahead fetch of the next authorization record to determine whether additional pages of data exist beyond the current page, without displaying that record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed a lookahead fetch after filling all 5 display rows
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the lookahead fetch
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the lookahead fetch successfully retrieved a record (AUTHS-NOT-EOF and ERR-FLG-OFF), the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES) is set to TRUE, indicating that PF8 forward navigation is available; if the lookahead fetch found no record or reached end of data, the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-NO) is set to TRUE, indicating that the current page is the last page and PF8 forward navigation is not available

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Next Page Indicator Based on Additional Records Availability
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the lookahead fetch, the system sets the next-page availability indicator to reflect whether the user can navigate forward to an additional page of authorization records using PF8.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing a page of pending authorization records for an account and presses PF8 to navigate forward
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) to determine if it contains a valid saved key or is empty (spaces or low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the last displayed authorization key is spaces or low-values, the system clears the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and proceeds to check if a next page is available, which will result in displaying 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' message. If the last displayed authorization key contains a valid value, the system copies it to the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) and proceeds to reposition the authorization list cursor.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine If Forward Page Navigation Is Possible Based on Saved Authorization Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user requests the next page of authorizations (PF8), the system checks whether a last-displayed authorization key was saved from the current page. This key is required to reposition the cursor in the authorization list to load the next set of records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next page of authorization records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) is found to be spaces or low-values (no saved key exists)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to low-values, sets the screen send mode to overlay (no full erase), and since no next-page indicator is set, displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Reposition Target When No Last Authorization Key Is Available
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF8 and no last-displayed authorization key has been saved, the system clears the reposition target, indicating there is no valid position to navigate forward from, which will ultimately result in a 'bottom of page' message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate forward and the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) contains a valid non-blank, non-empty value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition the authorization list cursor for forward page navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system copies the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) into the reposition target key field (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the starting position for retrieving the next page of authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Copy Last Displayed Authorization Key as Reposition Target for Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid last-displayed authorization key exists, the system copies it to the reposition target field so that the authorization list can be repositioned to the correct starting point for loading the next page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 and a valid last displayed authorization key has been saved and copied to the reposition target
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to reposition the authorization list to load the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the authorization summary retrieval (GET-AUTH-SUMMARY) using the current account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) to refresh the authorization summary segment before repositioning the cursor in the authorization detail records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Refresh Authorization Summary Before Repositioning for Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before repositioning the authorization list cursor for forward page navigation, the system refreshes the authorization summary data for the account to ensure the most current summary information is available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization summary has been retrieved and the reposition target key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) contains the key of the last authorization record displayed on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes a search of the pending authorization detail records (PAUTDTL1 segment) using the saved authorization key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) to locate the exact last-displayed record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system positions the authorization list cursor at the matching record so that subsequent reads will retrieve records starting immediately after the last displayed record, enabling the next page to be loaded correctly

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reposition Authorization List Cursor to Last Displayed Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system repositions the authorization list cursor to the last record displayed on the current page by searching for the saved authorization key. This ensures the next page load begins immediately after the last record the user saw.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the pending authorization detail records (PAUTDTL1) using the saved authorization key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the authorization record search
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the authorization record matching the saved key is found, the system sets the 'authorizations not at end-of-file' indicator (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) to true, meaning the cursor is correctly positioned and the next page can be loaded. If the record is not found or the end of the authorization list is reached, the system sets the 'authorizations end-of-file' indicator (AUTHS-EOF) to true, meaning no further records are available.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Cursor Position Result After Repositioning to Last Displayed Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to reposition the authorization list cursor to the last displayed record, the system evaluates whether the target record was found, setting the appropriate end-of-list indicator to control subsequent page loading.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully repositioned the authorization list cursor by finding the saved authorization key in the pending authorization detail records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization record search returns a successful match (AUTHS-NOT-EOF is set to true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to evaluate whether next-page records are available (NEXT-PAGE-YES indicator), and if so, initializes the authorization display rows and loads the next page of up to 5 authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Cursor Is Positioned and Ready to Load Next Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization list cursor is successfully positioned at the last displayed record, the system is ready to proceed with loading the next page of authorization records for display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system attempts to reposition the authorization list cursor using the saved authorization key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The search returns a 'segment not found' or 'end of database' result, meaning the saved key no longer exists or the list is exhausted
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the end-of-file indicator (AUTHS-EOF) to true, and since the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES) is not set, displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' to inform the user that no further authorization records are available

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle End of Authorization List When Repositioning Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the system cannot find the saved authorization key during repositioning, it means the end of the authorization list has been reached and no further records are available for forward navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization list cursor has been repositioned to the last displayed record and the system is ready to load the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the next-page availability indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the next-page indicator is set to YES, the system initializes the five authorization display rows (clears all row fields) and proceeds to load the next page of authorization records (PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD). If the next-page indicator is not set to YES, the system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' and does not change the displayed authorization list.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Whether Next Page of Authorization Records Is Available
all_rules.Rule_Description: After repositioning the authorization list cursor, the system checks whether a next page of records is available before proceeding to load and display them, preventing unnecessary processing when already at the last page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization list cursor is positioned at the last displayed record and the next-page indicator (NEXT-PAGE-YES) confirms more records exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system proceeds with forward page navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system first initializes all five authorization display rows by clearing Transaction ID, Date, Time, Authorization Type, Approval Status, Match Status, and Amount fields for rows 1 through 5, then invokes PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD to read and populate the next page of up to 5 pending authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Load Next Page of Authorization Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: When next-page records are confirmed to be available, the system clears the current authorization display rows and loads the next set of up to 5 authorization records for the account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate forward in the authorization list
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either no last-displayed authorization key was saved, the saved key could not be found during repositioning, or the next-page indicator is not set to YES
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' on the screen, sets the screen send mode to overlay (no full erase), and does not change the currently displayed authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Bottom-of-Page Message When No Further Authorization Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When forward page navigation is not possible because no further authorization records exist beyond the current page, the system informs the user that they have reached the last page of authorization records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is navigating between pages of the pending authorization list, and the system maintains a page-key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG) storing the first authorization key for each previously visited page, and a last-page key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) storing the last authorization key of the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: PF7 (page backward) is pressed, the system retrieves the saved first-authorization key for the decremented target page number from the page-key history array (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by the new page number); OR when PF8 (page forward) is pressed, the system retrieves the last authorization key of the current page (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The retrieved authorization key is stored in the working saved-key field (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) to be used as the repositioning anchor for the subsequent authorization record search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Saved Page Key from Page-Key History
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating backward (PF7) or forward (PF8) through authorization pages, the system retrieves the previously saved authorization key for the target page from the page-key history array to use as the repositioning anchor.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The saved page key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) has been populated with the target authorization key retrieved from the page-key history (either the first key of the target page for PF7, or the last key of the current page for PF8)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is about to reposition the authorization record cursor by invoking the REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The saved key value (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) is moved into the authorization record key field (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY), making it the active search key for the pending authorization details database query

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Saved Authorization Key as Search Key for Repositioning
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before searching the authorization records database to reposition the cursor, the system sets the saved page key as the authorization record search key so the database query targets the correct starting position.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization record search key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) has been set to the target page anchor key, and the Pending Authorization database (IMS segment PAUTDTL1) is accessible via the scheduled Program Specification Block (PSB)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes a qualified Get Next within Parent (GNP) database call against the Pending Authorization Details segment (PAUTDTL1), searching for the record where the authorization key field (PAUT9CTS) matches the value in PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The database returns either the matching authorization record into the PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS data area, or a status indicating the record was not found or the end of available records was reached

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Pending Authorization Records for Matching Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system searches the Pending Authorization Details database segment to locate the authorization record that matches the target key, positioning the database cursor at that record so subsequent sequential reads will retrieve records from that point forward.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A search for the target authorization key has been executed against the Pending Authorization Details database segment (PAUTDTL1)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database search returns a successful status (STATUS-OK), indicating the matching authorization record was found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization end-of-data indicator to 'not end-of-file' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF = TRUE), signaling that the cursor is successfully positioned and the system is ready to read authorization records sequentially forward from this position to populate the page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Authorization Cursor at Matching Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the target authorization record is successfully located in the database, the system marks the authorization data stream as active and ready, so that subsequent sequential reads will retrieve records starting from this repositioned point forward.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A search for the target authorization key has been executed against the Pending Authorization Details database segment (PAUTDTL1)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database search returns a 'segment not found' status (SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND) indicating the target authorization key no longer exists in the database, OR returns an 'end of database' status (END-OF-DB) indicating no more authorization records are available
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization end-of-data indicator to 'end-of-file' (AUTHS-EOF = TRUE), signaling that no authorization records are available to display; the page will be rendered with empty authorization rows

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark End of Authorization Records When Repositioning Target Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the target authorization key used for repositioning cannot be found in the database, or the end of the authorization records has been reached, the system marks the authorization data stream as exhausted so the page will be displayed as empty.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is in the process of building the authorization list for a given account, and a valid authorization summary segment has been found for that account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system requests the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database for the current account context
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next available pending authorization detail record (containing fields such as Authorization Key, Transaction ID, Approved Amount, Authorization Date, Authorization Time, Authorization Type, Response Code, Match Status) and makes it available for display on the authorization list screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Retrieval of Next Pending Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retrieves the next pending authorization detail record in sequence for the current account from the authorization database. This is used to populate each row of the authorization list display, one record at a time, in the order they are stored.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has requested the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns the record successfully (retrieval status indicates success)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization list status to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF), indicating that a valid record has been retrieved and is ready to be populated into the current row of the authorization list display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Authorization Record as Available When Successfully Retrieved
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization database successfully returns a pending authorization detail record, the system marks the record retrieval status as available, allowing the record's data to be used to populate a row on the authorization list screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has requested the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database indicates that either the requested authorization segment does not exist OR the end of all available authorization records for the account has been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization list status to 'end of records' (AUTHS-EOF), which stops the page-building loop from requesting any further records and triggers evaluation of whether a next page indicator should be shown to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark End of Authorization List When No More Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization database indicates that there are no more pending authorization detail records available for the current account — either because the specific segment was not found or the end of the available records has been reached — the system marks the authorization list as exhausted, stopping further retrieval attempts.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has requested the next sequential pending authorization detail record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns an unexpected condition that is neither a successful retrieval nor a normal 'no more records' or 'segment not found' response
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y' (WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y'), constructs an error message reading 'System error while reading AUTH Details: Code: [database return code]', sets the cursor focus back to the Account ID field, and immediately sends the authorization list screen displaying the error message — stopping all further authorization record retrieval and page-building processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Unexpected Condition During Authorization Record Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unexpected condition occurs during the retrieval of a pending authorization detail record — one that is neither a successful retrieval nor a normal end-of-records condition — the system raises an error flag, captures a descriptive error message, and immediately displays the authorization list screen with the error message, halting further record processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has navigated to a previous page and the system has a saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) stored from prior page navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a repositioning operation to return to a specific page of the authorization list
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the saved authorization key (WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE) as the active search key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) to be used as the target for locating the correct position in the authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Saved Authorization Key as Target for Repositioning
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before repositioning the authorization list cursor, the system must load the previously saved authorization key as the target search key so the database knows which record to locate.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The saved authorization key has been set as the target search key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) and the system is ready to reposition within the Pending Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes a database search using the saved authorization key as the search criterion (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) against the Authorization database (PCB PAUT-PCB-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the authorization detail record matching the saved key, positioning the database cursor at that specific record so subsequent sequential reads will return records starting from that position forward

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Authorization Detail Records Using Saved Key to Position Cursor
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must query the Authorization Detail records using the saved authorization key to reposition the database cursor to the correct starting point for the page being navigated to.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has executed a search for the authorization detail record using the saved authorization key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database search returns a successful status (STATUS-OK), indicating the matching authorization record was found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization list as not at end-of-file (AUTHS-NOT-EOF = TRUE), confirming the cursor is positioned at the saved authorization record and the system is ready to read subsequent authorization records sequentially in the forward direction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Successful Cursor Positioning at Saved Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization detail record matching the saved key is found, the system confirms the cursor is correctly positioned and marks the authorization list as active and ready for forward reading.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has executed a search for the authorization detail record using the saved authorization key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database search returns either a 'Segment Not Found' status or an 'End of Database' status, indicating no matching authorization record exists at the saved key position
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization list as end-of-file (AUTHS-EOF = TRUE), indicating there are no available authorization records to display from that position, effectively preventing further forward page navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Authorization List as Exhausted When Saved Record Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the saved authorization key no longer matches any existing record, or the end of the authorization list has been reached, the system must mark the authorization list as having no more available records to prevent further page navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is preparing to populate an authorization row on the summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the Approved Amount from the authorization record and stores it in the display amount field for subsequent formatting and screen population

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Approved Amount from Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When populating an authorization row on the summary screen, the system retrieves the approved amount from the pending authorization record and prepares it for display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record contains an origination time stored in raw HHMMSS format (6 characters, positions 1-2 = hours, 3-4 = minutes, 5-6 = seconds)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the authorization time for display on the summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts hours from positions 1-2, minutes from positions 3-4, and seconds from positions 5-6 of the raw time field, and assembles them into the display format HH:MM:SS (with colon separators at positions 3 and 6)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Authorization Time for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The raw authorization origination time stored as a 6-character HHMMSS string must be reformatted into a human-readable HH:MM:SS display format before being shown on the authorization summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record contains an origination date stored in raw YYMMDD format (6 characters, positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = month, 5-6 = day)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the authorization date for display on the summary screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the year (YY) from positions 1-2, month (MM) from positions 3-4, and day (DD) from positions 5-6 of the raw date field, and assembles them into the display format MM/DD/YY (with slash separators)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Authorization Date for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The raw authorization origination date stored as a 6-character YYMMDD string must be reformatted into a human-readable MM/DD/YY display format before being shown on the authorization summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the response code equals '00', the system sets the Approval Status to 'A' (Approved); if the response code is any value other than '00', the system sets the Approval Status to 'D' (Declined)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Authorization Approval Status
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each authorization record carries a response code that indicates whether the authorization was approved or declined. The system must evaluate this code and assign a single-character approval status indicator for display on the summary screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is being evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization response code is exactly '00'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Approval Status display field to 'A', indicating the authorization was Approved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Approval Status to Approved
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization response code indicates a successful approval (code '00'), the system marks the authorization record with an 'Approved' status for display on the summary list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved and its response code is being evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization response code is any value other than '00'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Approval Status display field to 'D', indicating the authorization was Declined

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Approval Status to Declined
