all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization response code indicates anything other than a successful approval, the system marks the authorization record with a 'Declined' status for display on the summary list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, its amount extracted, date formatted to MM/DD/YY, time formatted to HH:MM:SS, and approval status determined as 'A' or 'D'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row index is 1 (first row on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates Row 1 of the authorization summary screen with: Transaction ID, formatted Date (MM/DD/YY), formatted Time (HH:MM:SS), Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the authorization key for this record is saved as the key for position 1; and the selection field for Row 1 is made available for user input (unprotected)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row 1 on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current authorization record is the first record being displayed on the page, all its formatted fields are written into the first row of the authorization summary list on screen, and the row's selection field is made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, its amount extracted, date formatted to MM/DD/YY, time formatted to HH:MM:SS, and approval status determined as 'A' or 'D'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row index is 2 (second row on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates Row 2 of the authorization summary screen with: Transaction ID, formatted Date (MM/DD/YY), formatted Time (HH:MM:SS), Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the authorization key for this record is saved as the key for position 2; and the selection field for Row 2 is made available for user input (unprotected)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row 2 on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current authorization record is the second record being displayed on the page, all its formatted fields are written into the second row of the authorization summary list on screen, and the row's selection field is made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, its amount extracted, date formatted to MM/DD/YY, time formatted to HH:MM:SS, and approval status determined as 'A' or 'D'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row index is 3 (third row on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates Row 3 of the authorization summary screen with: Transaction ID, formatted Date (MM/DD/YY), formatted Time (HH:MM:SS), Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the authorization key for this record is saved as the key for position 3; and the selection field for Row 3 is made available for user input (unprotected)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row 3 on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current authorization record is the third record being displayed on the page, all its formatted fields are written into the third row of the authorization summary list on screen, and the row's selection field is made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, its amount extracted, date formatted to MM/DD/YY, time formatted to HH:MM:SS, and approval status determined as 'A' or 'D'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row index is 4 (fourth row on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates Row 4 of the authorization summary screen with: Transaction ID, formatted Date (MM/DD/YY), formatted Time (HH:MM:SS), Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the authorization key for this record is saved as the key for position 4; and the selection field for Row 4 is made available for user input (unprotected)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row 4 on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current authorization record is the fourth record being displayed on the page, all its formatted fields are written into the fourth row of the authorization summary list on screen, and the row's selection field is made available for user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization record has been retrieved, its amount extracted, date formatted to MM/DD/YY, time formatted to HH:MM:SS, and approval status determined as 'A' or 'D'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current row index is 5 (fifth row on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates Row 5 of the authorization summary screen with: Transaction ID, formatted Date (MM/DD/YY), formatted Time (HH:MM:SS), Authorization Type, Approval Status ('A' or 'D'), Match Status, and Approved Amount; the authorization key for this record is saved as the key for position 5; and the selection field for Row 5 is made available for user input (unprotected)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Row 5 on Summary Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the current authorization record is the fifth and final record being displayed on the page, all its formatted fields are written into the fifth row of the authorization summary list on screen, and the row's selection field is made available for user input.

description:
COPAUS0C is an online CICS COBOL program within the CardDemo Authorization Module that provides a summary view of pending authorization messages for a given account. It retrieves account, customer, and card cross-reference details from VSAM files, and reads pending authorization summary and detail segments from an IMS database, displaying up to 5 authorization records per page with forward and backward pagination support. Users can select an individual authorization record to navigate to the detail screen (COPAUS1C) or return to the main menu.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM, IMS - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Initialize flags, clear error messages, and set default screen values when the program starts for the first time (no communication area). 2: Screen Entry Point Detection - Determine whether the user is entering the screen for the first time or returning to it, and route processing accordingly. 3: Account ID Display Setup - When navigating from another program, populate the account ID field on the authorization summary screen from the shared communication area. 4: Enter Key Processing - Validate the account ID entered by the user: ensure it is not blank and is numeric before proceeding with authorization lookup. 5: Authorization Record Selection - Allow the user to select one of up to five displayed authorization records using a selection flag (S), and capture the selected authorization key for detail navigation. 6: Navigate to Authorization Detail - When a valid authorization record is selected with 'S', transfer control to the Authorization Detail program (COPAUS1C) passing the selected authorization key. 7: Invalid Selection Handling - Display an error message when the user enters an invalid selection value (anything other than 'S') for an authorization record. 8: Gather Account Details - Orchestrate retrieval of card cross-reference, account master, and customer master data for the entered account ID to populate the summary screen header. 9: Card Cross-Reference Lookup - Look up the card cross-reference file using the account ID to retrieve the associated customer ID and card number. 10: Account Master Data Retrieval - Retrieve the account master record using the account ID to obtain credit limit and cash credit limit information. 11: Customer Master Data Retrieval - Retrieve the customer master record using the customer ID to obtain customer name, address, and phone number. 12: Customer Information Display - Format and display customer name (first, middle initial, last), address lines, city/state/zip, and phone number on the summary screen. 13: Account Financial Summary Display - Display account credit limit, cash credit limit, current credit balance, and cash balance on the summary screen. 14: Authorization Summary Statistics Display - Display the count and total amount of approved authorizations and declined authorizations for the account. 15: IMS PSB Scheduling - Schedule the IMS Program Specification Block (PSBPAUTB) required to access the authorization database; handle re-scheduling if already scheduled. 16: Authorization Summary Segment Retrieval - Retrieve the pending authorization summary root segment from the IMS database for the given account ID, obtaining aggregate counts and amounts. 17: Authorization List Initialization - Clear all five authorization list rows on the screen (transaction ID, date, time, type, approval status, match status, amount) before populating with fresh data. 18: Forward Page Navigation (PF8) - Advance to the next page of authorization records by repositioning to the last displayed authorization key and loading the next set of up to five records. 19: Backward Page Navigation (PF7) - Navigate to the previous page of authorization records by retrieving the saved page key and reloading the prior set of up to five authorization records. 20: Top-of-List Detection - Inform the user with a message when they are already on the first page and attempt to scroll backward (PF7). 21: Bottom-of-List Detection - Inform the user with a message when they are already on the last page and attempt to scroll forward (PF8). 22: Authorization Records Paging - Retrieve up to five authorization detail child segments sequentially from the IMS database for display on the current page. 23: Authorization Record Repositioning - Reposition the IMS database cursor to a specific authorization key to support accurate forward and backward paging. 24: Next Page Availability Check - After filling the current page with five records, peek at the next record to determine whether a next page exists and set the next-page indicator accordingly. 25: Page Key Tracking - Save the authorization key of the first record on each page into a page-key array to enable accurate backward navigation. 26: Authorization Record Population - For each of the five list rows, populate transaction ID, date, time, authorization type, approval status (A=Approved / D=Declined), match status, and approved amount. 27: Authorization Date and Time Formatting - Convert the raw authorization origination date (YYMMDD) and time (HHMMSS) into display-formatted MM/DD/YY date and HH:MM:SS time strings. 28: Approval Status Derivation - Determine whether an authorization is Approved (response code '00') or Declined (any other response code) and set the display status indicator accordingly. 29: Return to Main Menu (PF3) - Transfer control back to the main menu program (COMEN01C) when the user presses PF3. 30: Invalid Key Handling - Display an error message when the user presses an unsupported function key. 31: Screen Header Population - Populate the screen header with application title, transaction ID, program name, current date, and current time before each screen send. 32: Authorization Summary Screen Display - Send the formatted authorization summary screen to the user terminal, using full erase on first display or overlay on subsequent displays. 33: Account Not Found Notification - Display a descriptive message to the user when the entered account ID is not found in the card cross-reference, account, or customer files. 34: Authorization Summary Not Found Handling - When no pending authorization summary segment exists for the account, display zero values for all authorization counts, amounts, and balances. 35: Session State Persistence - Save current page number, page key history, last authorization key, next-page flag, and selected authorization key in the communication area across screen interactions.
